pairs.he: גם צדיקים גדולים מאד יכולים לטעות בענין מחלוקת לחלוק על צדיק אחר ולרדוף אותו
pairs.en: Even very great tzaddikim can err in the matter of controversy, disputing another tzaddik and persecuting him

qualifiedAfter.he: גם צדיקים גדולים מאד יכולים לטעות בענין מחלוקת לחלוק על צדיק אחר ולרדוף אותו
qualifiedAfter.en: Even very great tzaddikim can err in the matter of controversy, disputing another tzaddik and persecuting him

pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת מַחֲלֹקֶת הַשְּׁבָטִים עִם יוֹסֵף שֶׁגָּרַם הַגָּלוּת וְהַחֻרְבָּן, כִּי יוֹסֵף הוּא בְּחִינַת הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת. וְהַשְּׁבָטִים אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהֵם כֻּלָּם קְדוֹשִׁים, אַךְ עַל פִּי כֵן קָפַץ הַשָּׂטָן בֵּינֵיהֶם וְהִטְעָה אוֹתָם בְּעֵצוֹת רָעוֹת כָּאֵלֶּה לִמְכֹּר אֶת יוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of the tribes’ controversy with Yosef, which caused the exile and destruction, for Yosef is the aspect of the true tzaddik. And although the tribes are all holy, nevertheless Satan leapt among them and misled them with such evil counsels, to sell Yosef the tzaddik.

qualifiedAfter.en: And this is the aspect of the tribes’ controversy with Yosef, which caused the exile and destruction, for Yosef is the aspect of the true tzaddik. And although the tribes are all holy, nevertheless Satan leapt among them and misled them with such evil counsels, to sell Yosef the tzaddik.

pairs.he: כִּי גַּם צַדִּיקִים גְּדוֹלִים צְרִיכִים לִשְׁמֹר עַצְמָם מְאֹד וּלְבַקֵּשׁ מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ מְאֹד לְהִנָּצֵל מֵעֵצוֹת נִבְעָרוֹת, בִּפְרָט מֵעִנְיַן מַחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁשָּׁם עִקַּר הִתְגַּבְּרוּת הַשָּׂטָן שֶׁמַּכְנִיס סְבָרוֹת בְּלֵב הַצַּדִּיקִים עַד שֶׁנִּדְמֶה לָהֶם שֶׁהֵם צְרִיכִים לִרְדֹּף אֶת הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת עַד לְחַיָּיו, וְהַכֹּל נִמְשָׁךְ מֵעֲצַת הַנָּחָשׁ שֶׁהִטְעָה אֶת אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן וְהִטְעָה אֶת קַיִן וְהָיָה בַּתְּחִלָּה גָּדוֹל בְּמַעֲלָה מְאֹד, (כמבואר בכתבי האר״י ובחז״ל לברכה) וְהִטְעָה אוֹתוֹ בְּעֵצוֹת רָעוֹת לַהֲרֹג אֶת הֶבֶל. וְכֵן הוּא בְּכָל הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת, וּבִפְרָט הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים קכט.
pairs.en: For even great tzaddikim must guard themselves very carefully and ask Hashem, blessed be He, very earnestly to be rescued from foolish counsels, particularly from the matter of controversy, where Satan’s chief ascendency is: he puts arguments into the hearts of the tzaddikim until it seems to them that they must persecute the true tzaddik to the point of [taking] his life. And it all proceeds from the serpent’s counsel, which misled Adam the first man and misled Kayin, who was initially very great in stature (as explained in the writings of the Ari and in [the words of] our Sages, of blessed memory), and misled him with evil counsels to kill Hevel. And so it is in every controversy, particularly controversy among tzaddikim [printed note marker: 129].

pairs.he: וְזֶהוּ ״וְיִשְׁלְחֵהוּ מֵעֵמֶק״. וְדָרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה מֵעֵצָה עֲמֻקָּה שֶׁל הַצַּדִּיק הַקָּבוּר בְּחֶבְרוֹן, כִּי אַתָּה מָרוֹם לְעוֹלָם ה׳ וְיָדוֹ עַל הָעֶלְיוֹנָה תָּמִיד. וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁמָּסַר הַבְּחִירָה לָאָדָם, וְעַל כֵּן הֻכְרַח לַעֲזֹר אֶת הָאָדָם שֶׁיִּבְחַר לוֹ עֵצָה כִּרְצוֹנוֹ, אַךְ עַל פִּי כֵן הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ גּוֹמֵר תָּמִיד כִּרְצוֹנוֹ. (ועין מזה במקום אחר) כִּי עֲצַת ה׳ לְעוֹלָם תַּעֲמֹד וּכְתִיב, כִּי ה׳ צְבָאוֹת יָעָץ וּמִי יָפֵר.
pairs.en: And this is “And he sent him from the valley.” And our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded: from the deep counsel of the tzaddik buried in Chevron, for “You are on high forever, Hashem,” and His hand always has the upper hand. And although He entrusted free choice to man, and therefore was compelled to help the person choose counsel for himself as he wishes, nevertheless Hashem, blessed be He, always brings matters to completion as He wills (and see concerning this elsewhere). For “the counsel of Hashem shall stand forever,” and it is written, “For Hashem of Hosts has counseled, and who shall annul it?”

pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן כְּשֶׁהִתְוַעֲדוּ הַשְּׁבָטִים עִם יוֹסֵף לֹא הָיָה אֶפְשָׁר לְיוֹסֵף לַחֲזֹר וּלְהִתְחַבֵּר עִמָּהֶם עַד שֶׁהֵבִיאוּ אֶת בִּנְיָמִין, כִּי בִּנְיָמִין הוּא עִקַּר בְּחִינַת תִּקּוּן הָעֵצָה הַשְּׁלֵמָה הָאֲמִתִּית, כִּי רַק הוּא נוֹלַד בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁשָּׁם הַבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ, שֶׁשָּׁם עִקַּר הָעֵצָה כַּנַּ״ל. וְעַל כֵּן נִקְרָא בִּנְיָמִין בֶּן יָמִין, בְּחִינַת עֵצוֹת אֲמִתִּיּוֹת שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת לֵב חָכָם לִימִינוֹ, הֵפֶךְ עֵצוֹת נִבְעָרוֹת, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת לֵב כְּסִיל לִשְׂמֹאלוֹ.
pairs.en: And therefore when the tribes met with Yosef, Yosef could not return and rejoin them until they brought Binyamin, for Binyamin is the chief aspect of the rectification of complete, true counsel; for only he was born in the Land of Israel, where the Holy Temple is, where counsel principally is, as above. And therefore he is called Binyamin, “son of the right,” the aspect of true counsels, which are the aspect of “a wise man’s heart is to his right,” the opposite of foolish counsels, which are the aspect of “a fool’s heart is to his left.”

qualifiedAfter.en: And therefore when the tribes met with Yosef, Yosef could not return and rejoin them until they brought Binyamin, for Binyamin is the chief aspect of the rectification of complete, true counsel; for only he was born in the Land of Israel, where the Holy Temple is, where counsel principally is, as above. And therefore he is called Binyamin, “son of the right,” the aspect of true counsels, which are the aspect of “a wise man’s heart is to his right,” the opposite of foolish counsels, which are the aspect of “a fool’s heart is to his left.”

pairs.he: כִּי י״ב הַשְּׁבָטִים הֵם בְּחִינַת שְׁלֵמוּת כְּלָלִיּוּת הָעֵצָה הַקְּדוֹשָׁה שֶׁהוּא כְּלַל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁנִּקְרֵאת עֵצָה כַּנַּ״ל, כִּי הֵם הֵם הַמִּטָּה שְׁלֵמָה שֶׁהֶעֱמִיד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ שֶׁמֵּהֶם יָצְאוּ כָּל זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁקִּבְּלוּ אֶת הַתּוֹרָה בְּהַר סִינַי שֶׁהוּא עִקַּר הָעֵצָה הַשְּׁלֵמָה כַּנַּ״ל, כִּי י״ב שְׁבָטִים הֵם בְּחִינַת י״ב אַבְנֵי יַעֲקֹב שֶׁנִּכְלְלוּ כֻּלָּם בְּאֶבֶן אַחַת (המובא שם בהתורה הנ״ל, עין שם). שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת מַה שֶּׁנִּכְלָלִים בְּאֶבֶן שְׁתִיָּה בְּחִינַת קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים שֶׁזּוֹכִין עַל יְדֵי אֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִתְרַבִּין הַסְּפָרִים הָאֲמִתִּיִּים שֶׁל הַתּוֹרָה הַקְּדוֹשָׁה, שֶׁכָּל זֶה הוּא בְּחִינַת שְׁלֵמוּת הָעֵצָה הָאֲמִתִּית, (כמבואר שם כל זה, עין שם).
pairs.en: For the twelve tribes are the aspect of the complete totality of holy counsel, which is the totality of the Torah called counsel, as above; for they themselves are the complete progeny that Yaakov our forefather established, from whom all the seed of Israel emerged, who received the Torah at Mount Sinai, which is the principal complete counsel, as above. For the twelve tribes are the aspect of Yaakov’s twelve stones, which were all incorporated into one stone (cited there in the aforesaid teaching; see there). This is the aspect of their being incorporated into the Foundation Stone, the aspect of the Holy of Holies, which one merits through faith in the sages; through this the true books of the holy Torah multiply. All this is the aspect of complete true counsel (as all this is explained there; see there).

qualifiedAfter.en: For the twelve tribes are the aspect of the complete totality of holy counsel, which is the totality of the Torah called counsel, as above; for they themselves are the complete progeny that Yaakov our forefather established, from whom all the seed of Israel emerged, who received the Torah at Mount Sinai, which is the principal complete counsel, as above. For the twelve tribes are the aspect of Yaakov’s twelve stones, which were all incorporated into one stone (cited there in the aforesaid teaching; see there). This is the aspect of their being incorporated into the Foundation Stone, the aspect of the Holy of Holies, which one merits through faith in the sages; through this the true books of the holy Torah multiply. All this is the aspect of complete true counsel (as all this is explained there; see there).

pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן הֶחֱרִיד יַעֲקֹב מְאֹד תֵּכֶף כְּשֶׁנּוֹלַד יוֹסֵף לִבְרֹחַ מִלָּבָן כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יִהְיֶה נִשְׁלָם, חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, מִטָּתוֹ הַקְּדוֹשָׁה בְּחוּץ לָאָרֶץ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ, הַיְנוּ כַּנַּ״ל. כִּי שְׁלֵמוּת מִטָּתוֹ הִיא שְׁלֵמוּת הָעֵצָה הַקְּדוֹשָׁה שֶׁנִּשְׁלְמָה עַל יְדֵי בִּנְיָמִין שֶׁהֻכְרַח שֶׁתִּהְיֶה נִשְׁלֶמֶת בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁשָּׁם הַבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וְקֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים, שֶׁשָּׁם עִקַּר הָעֵצָה הַשְּׁלֵמָה כַּנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And therefore Yaakov was greatly agitated immediately when Yosef was born, to flee from Lavan, so that his holy progeny should not be completed outside the Land, God forbid, as written in the holy Zohar; namely, as above. For the completion of his progeny is the completion of holy counsel, which was completed through Binyamin and had to be completed in the Land of Israel, where the Holy Temple and Holy of Holies are, where the complete counsel principally is, as above.

qualifiedAfter.en: And therefore Yaakov was greatly agitated immediately when Yosef was born, to flee from Lavan, so that his holy progeny should not be completed outside the Land, God forbid, as written in the holy Zohar; namely, as above. For the completion of his progeny is the completion of holy counsel, which was completed through Binyamin and had to be completed in the Land of Israel, where the Holy Temple and Holy of Holies are, where the complete counsel principally is, as above.

pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן כְּשֶׁבָּאוּ אַחֵי יוֹסֵף לְמִצְרַיִם וְרָאָה שֶׁהֵם שָׁבִים בִּתְשׁוּבָה עַל מְכִירָתוֹ וַאֲזַי צְרִיכִים לַחֲזֹר וּלְהִתְחַבֵּר עִמָּהֶם וְאָז הָיָה נִגְמָר וְנִשְׁלָם הָעֵצָה, עַל כֵּן לֹא רָצָה לְהִתְוַדֵּעַ לָהֶם עַד שֶׁהֵבִיאוּ אֶת בִּנְיָמִין. וְגַם אָז הוֹסִיף לְצַעֲרָם כְּדֵי שֶׁיָּשׁוּבוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה בְּיוֹתֵר. וְהָיָה מְצַעֲרָם עַל יְדֵי בִּנְיָמִין דַּיְקָא שֶׁצִּוָּה לְהַטְמִין הַגָּבִיעַ בְּאַמְתַּחְתּוֹ.
pairs.en: And therefore when Yosef’s brothers came to Egypt and he saw that they were repenting of selling him, and then one must return and rejoin them, and then counsel would have been finished and completed, therefore he did not wish to reveal himself to them until they brought Binyamin. And even then he added to their distress so that they would repent most completely. And he distressed them through Binyamin specifically, by commanding that the goblet be hidden in his sack.

qualifiedAfter.en: And therefore when Yosef’s brothers came to Egypt and he saw that they were repenting of selling him, and then one must return and rejoin them, and then counsel would have been finished and completed, therefore he did not wish to reveal himself to them until they brought Binyamin. And even then he added to their distress so that they would repent most completely. And he distressed them through Binyamin specifically, by commanding that the goblet be hidden in his sack.

pairs.he: וְזֶה רָמַז לָהֶם מַה שֶּׁפָּגְמוּ עַל יְדֵי מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת פְּגַם אֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים שֶׁגּוֹרְמִין עַל יְדֵי זֶה פְּגַם הָעֵצָה כַּנַּ״ל. שֶׁעִקַּר הַפְּגַם מַגִּיעַ לְבִנְיָמִין הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁהוּא עִקַּר שְׁלֵמוּת הָעֵצָה, כִּי הַבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בְּחֶלְקוֹ כַּנַּ״ל, כִּי בִּנְיָמִין הָיָה נָקִי לְגַמְרֵי מִפְּגַם הָעֵצוֹת רָעוֹת שֶׁנִּמְשָׁכִין מֵעֲצַת הַנָּחָשׁ כַּנַּ״ל שֶׁגָּרַם מִיתָה לָעוֹלָם, כִּי בִּנְיָמִין הָיָה נָקִי מִכָּל זֶה, כִּי הוּא מֵת בְּעֶטְיוֹ שֶׁל נָחָשׁ לְבַד, אֲבָל הוּא בְּעַצְמוֹ לֹא הָיָה לוֹ שׁוּם חֵלֶק בְּעֶטְיוֹ שֶׁל נָחָשׁ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה, וְעַל כֵּן זָכָה שֶׁנִּבְנָה הַבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וְקֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים בְּחֶלְקוֹ דַּיְקָא שֶׁשָּׁם עִקַּר תִּקּוּן הָעֵצָה וְכַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And by this he hinted to them at what they had blemished through selling Yosef the tzaddik, which is the aspect of blemishing faith in the sages, whereby they cause the blemish in counsel, as above. The chief blemish reaches Binyamin the tzaddik, who is the chief perfection of counsel, for the Holy Temple is in his portion, as above. For Binyamin was entirely clean of the blemish of evil counsels that proceed from the serpent’s counsel, as above, which caused death to the world, for Binyamin was clean of all this; he died only on account of the serpent, but he himself had no share at all in the serpent’s doing, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said. And therefore he merited that the Holy Temple and Holy of Holies were built specifically in his portion, where the principal rectification of counsel is, as above.

qualifiedAfter.en: And by this he hinted to them at what they had blemished through selling Yosef the tzaddik, which is the aspect of blemishing faith in the sages, whereby they cause the blemish in counsel, as above. The chief blemish reaches Binyamin the tzaddik, who is the chief perfection of counsel, for the Holy Temple is in his portion, as above. For Binyamin was entirely clean of the blemish of evil counsels that proceed from the serpent’s counsel, as above, which caused death to the world, for Binyamin was clean of all this; he died only on account of the serpent, but he himself had no share at all in the serpent’s doing, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said. And therefore he merited that the Holy Temple and Holy of Holies were built specifically in his portion, where the principal rectification of counsel is, as above.

pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן רָמַז לָהֶם יוֹסֵף הַפְּגַם עַל יְדֵי בִּנְיָמִין דַּיְקָא, הַיְנוּ שֶׁהַפְּגַם מַגִּיעַ לִבְחִינַת בִּנְיָמִין, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הַבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ, שֶׁהוּא עִקַּר בְּחִינַת שְׁלֵמוּת הָעֵצָה כַּנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And therefore Yosef hinted to them at the blemish through Binyamin specifically: namely, that the blemish reaches the aspect of Binyamin, which is the aspect of the Holy Temple, the chief aspect of complete counsel, as above.

qualifiedAfter.en: And therefore Yosef hinted to them at the blemish through Binyamin specifically: namely, that the blemish reaches the aspect of Binyamin, which is the aspect of the Holy Temple, the chief aspect of complete counsel, as above.

pairs.he: גַּם הֶרְאָה לָהֶם שֶׁעַל יְדֵי פְּגַם אֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים גּוֹרְמִים שֶׁמַּעֲלִילִים עַל הַצַּדִּיק אֱמֶת שֶׁהֵם בַּעֲלֵי עֵצָה בֶּאֱמֶת, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, וְתָהִין מִמֶּנּוּ עֵצָה, גּוֹרְמִים שֶׁבּוֹדִין עֲלֵיהֶם כְּזָבִים כְּאִלּוּ הֵם גַּנָּבִים וְרַמָּאִים חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, כְּאִלּוּ כָּל הִתְנַהֲגוּתָם בִּשְׁבִיל גְּנֵבָה וְרַמָּאוּת חַס וְשָׁלוֹם. וְאָז הִכִּירוּ הַשְּׁבָטִים גֹּדֶל פְּגָמָם עַד הֵיכָן מַגִּיעַ פְּגָמָם וְאָז שָׁבוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה בִּשְׁלֵמוּת, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, מַה נֹּאמַר מַה נְּדַבֵּר מַה נִּצְטַדָּק וְהָאֱלֹקִים מָצָא אֶת עֲוֹן עֲבָדֶיךָ וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: He also showed them that through a blemish in faith in the sages they cause accusations to be made against the true tzaddik, who are truly possessors of counsel, as it is written, “And take counsel from him”; they cause falsehoods to be fabricated against them, as though they were thieves and deceivers, God forbid, as though all their conduct were for theft and deceit, God forbid. And then the tribes recognized the magnitude of their blemish, how far their blemish reaches, and then repented completely, as it is written, “What shall we say, what shall we speak, how shall we justify ourselves? And God has found the iniquity of your servants,” etc.

pairs.he: וְאָז זָכוּ לְתַקֵּן עַל יְדֵי זֶה וְאָז הִתְוַדַּע לָהֶם יוֹסֵף וְחָזְרוּ וְנִכְלְלוּ יַחַד שֶׁזֶּה מְרַמֵּז עַל סוֹף הַתִּקּוּן הָאַחֲרוֹן כְּשֶׁיָּבוֹא מָשִׁיחַ שֶׁאָז יִתְתַּקֵּן הָעֵצָה בִּשְׁלֵמוּת, שֶׁאָז יַחֲזֹר וְיִתְאַחֵד מַלְכוּת בֵּית דָּוִד שֶׁנֶּחְלְקָה תְּחִלָּה שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת תִּקּוּן פְּגַם הָעֵצָה כַּנַּ״ל, בְּחִינַת וְלֹא יֵחָצוּ לִשְׁתֵּי מַמְלָכוֹת עוֹד, כִּי חֲלֻקַּת מַלְכוּת בֵּית דָּוִד וַחֲלֻקַּת הָעֵצָה הֵם בְּחִינָה אַחַת, (כמו שכתוב במקום אחר).
pairs.en: And then they merited to rectify through this, and then Yosef revealed himself to them, and they returned and were incorporated together; this alludes to the end of the final rectification when the Messiah comes, when counsel will be completely rectified, when the kingdom of the house of Dovid that was initially divided will return and become united, the aspect of rectifying the blemish in counsel, as above, the aspect of “And they shall no longer be divided into two kingdoms.” For the division of the kingdom of the house of Dovid and the division of counsel are one aspect (as written elsewhere).

qualifiedAfter.en: And then they merited to rectify through this, and then Yosef revealed himself to them, and they returned and were incorporated together; this alludes to the end of the final rectification when the Messiah comes, when counsel will be completely rectified, when the kingdom of the house of Dovid that was initially divided will return and become united, the aspect of rectifying the blemish in counsel, as above, the aspect of “And they shall no longer be divided into two kingdoms.” For the division of the kingdom of the house of Dovid and the division of counsel are one aspect (as written elsewhere).

This passage only: Native ועצה כזאת and closing ועל כן retain coordination. Eternal success, approach to sages/disciple/books, reversed counsels, the two powers with abbreviated merit/nonmerit and righteous/transgressor quotation, upright people and daily/constant counsel remain. Generic one/he is impersonal, not a named actor.

This passage only: Closing ועל כן retains a coordinated consequence. Destruction/exile, divided counsel, deficient faith, expulsion and inability to sweeten judgment through the Holy of Holies remain. “One cannot” is impersonal plural אין יכולין, not a counted/named-agent assertion.

This passage only: Native ודרשו retains coordinated exposition. Native לעזר supports “help,” not “leave,” despite conceptual tension: Hashem gives human choice and was compelled to help the person choose counsel as he wishes, yet completes matters by His own will. Human he versus divine He and the parenthetical after the second כרצונו remain. Divine counsel/annulment and all quoted clauses are retained; no canonical expansion is implied.

This passage only: Both ועל כן relations remain. Yosef cannot rejoin until Binyamin comes; Binyamin alone was born in the Land. Temple/counsel location, son-of-right and wise/right versus fool/left quotations remain.

This passage only: Native החריד יעקב מאד expresses great agitation/alarm, not merely speed. The purpose of fleeing Lavan immediately at Yosef’s birth, holy progeny/counsel completion through Binyamin, Land/Temple/Holy of Holies and Zohar attribution remain. This is contextual emotional force, not reconstructed Hebrew points.

This passage only: The brothers are antecedent of עמהם; Yosef sees their repentance. Generic צריכים לחזור ולהתחבר עמהם is rendered impersonally “one must,” not as naming Yosef grammatical subject or making the brothers rejoin themselves. Narrative he for seeing, withholding disclosure, intensified distress and goblet is Yosef. Repeated then and conditional would-have-been retain potential counsel-completion, not completion before Binyamin. No actor or optional smoothing is supplied.

This passage only: Final ועל כן retains coordination. בעטיו is rendered “on account of the serpent” and “in the serpent’s doing,” preserving consequence versus personal participation without asserting poison, a new event, specialist gloss or Binyamin’s direct temptation. Binyamin is clean of evil counsels and has no personal share; selling Yosef, faith/counsel blemish, Temple portion, innocence and Holy-of-Holies/counsel conclusion remain.

This passage only: For the affected paragraph, native ונתהין before ממנו עצה includes a nun absent from stored ותהין. Its exact operative meaning, voice and implied actor are unresolved; neither a remembered/canonical verse nor guessed points establishes “And take counsel from him.” The complete English and complete pointed Hebrew remain held, with no full replacement. Native singular הצדיק אמת followed by plural שהם/עליהם remains unharmonized. Thieves/deceivers are fabricated allegations in the paragraph, not narrator facts; repentance and quoted confession remain.

segments.he:
מחמת שרוצים להבין דרכי הצדיק ולא מבינים אז חולקים עליו

"וַיּוֹסִפוּ עוֹד שְׂנֹא אֹתוֹ עַל חֲלֹמֹתָיו וְעַל דְּבָרָיו"

(ל״ז, ח)

כָּל זֶה הוּא בְּחִינַת הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים וּבֵין הַכְּשֵׁרִים קְצָת, וְהָעִקַּר מֵחֲמַת שֶׁהַכֹּל רוֹצִים שֶׁיָּבִינוּ מִיָּד כָּל דַּרְכֵי הַצַּדִּיק וְהַשָּׂגוֹתָיו. כִּי אִם הָיוּ הַכֹּל רוֹאִים וּמְבִינִים מַה שֶׁהִשִּׂיג הַצַּדִּיק אֲפִלּוּ חֵלֶק אֶחָד מֵאֶלֶף, הָיוּ בְּוַדַּאי כֻּלָּם כְּרוּכִים אַחֲרָיו וְהָיוּ מִתְקָרְבִים אֵלָיו בְּכָל נַפְשָׁם וּמְאֹדָם.

אַךְ הַצַּדִּיק מִתְנַהֵג בְּחָכְמָה בִּשְׁבִיל הַבְּחִירָה וּמַעֲלִים עַצְמוֹ וּמַסְתִּיר עַצְמוֹ מֵהָעוֹלָם, רַק מְגַלֶּה לָהֶם מְעַט מִזְעָר, בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁיֵּדְעוּ וְיָבִינוּ שֶׁהַסּוֹד אֶצְלוֹ. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב שָׁם ז״ל עַל עִנְיַן סוֹד הָעִבּוּר, שֶׁהוּא כְּלַל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּהּ חָכְמָה שֶׁיְּכוֹלִין לְגַלּוֹת לָהֶם מַה שֶּׁמְּגַלִּין, וְאַף עַל פִּי כֵן יִהְיֶה הַסּוֹד נִשְׁאָר אֶצְלוֹ וְכוּ׳ שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת כִּי הוּא חָכְמַתְכֶם וּבִינַתְכֶם לְעֵינֵי הָעַמִּים דַּיְקָא וְכוּ׳. וְרַק עַל יְדֵי שֶׁמְּגַלִּין לָהֶם יָבִינוּ שֶׁהַסּוֹד אֶצְלוֹ, וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יֵשׁ לָהֶם בְּחִירָה.

כִּי בְּוַדַּאי אִם יִרְצוּ בֶּאֱמֶת לַאֲמִתּוֹ יְכוֹלִין לְהָבִין מֵרָחוֹק עַל יְדֵי זֶה שֶׁכְּבָר גִּלָּה לָהֶם שֶׁבְּוַדַּאי יוֹדֵעַ עוֹד מַה שֶּׁיּוֹדֵעַ בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁיִּתְקָרְבוּ לָנֶצַח. אַךְ לֹא יַחְפֹּץ כְּסִיל בִּתְבוּנָה וְכוּ׳. וְכֵן מִתְנַהֵג הַצַּדִּיק בְּכָל הַשָּׂגוֹתָיו עַד שֶׁבֶּאֱמֶת מִתְקָרְבִים הַחֲפֵצִים בֶּאֱמֶת, אֲבָל יֵשׁ שֶׁמַּרְבִּים לְהַקְשׁוֹת קֻשְׁיוֹת עָלָיו כִּי רוֹצִים לְהָבִין הַכֹּל. וַאֲפִלּוּ צַדִּיקִים מִתְגָּרֶה בָּהֶם הַבַּעַל דָּבָר וּמַכְנִיס בְּלִבָּם קֻשְׁיוֹת עָלָיו, כִּי בְּתַלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים וְהַצַּדִּיקִים מִתְגָּרֶה בְּיוֹתֵר שֶׁיַּחְלְקוּ עָלָיו, מֵחֲמַת שֶׁעֲלֵיהֶם מִסְתַּכְּלִים הַרְבֵּה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל.

וּבֶאֱמֶת יֵשׁ בָּזֶה נִסְתָּרוֹת הַרְבֵּה בְּעִנְיַן הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים בְּעַצְמָם כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר עַל פָּסוּק אֹזֶן שׁוֹמַעַת תּוֹכַחַת חַיִּים וְכוּ׳. כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר בסימן ה׳ לקוטי חלק א.

וְזֶה בְּחִינַת הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבֵּין הַשְּׁבָטִים עַל יוֹסֵף שֶׁהוּא גִּלָּה לָהֶם חֲלוֹמוֹתָיו כְּדֵי שֶׁיָּבִינוּ מֵרָחוֹק עֹצֶם גְּדֻלָּתוֹ, וְהֵם הוֹסִיפוּ שְׂנֹא אוֹתוֹ עַל חֲלוֹמוֹתָיו וְכוּ׳. וְכֵן מִתְנַהֵג עַכְשָׁו וְכַנַּ״ל.

(הלכות ראש חודש הלכה ו׳ אות מ״ט)
segments.en:
Because people want to understand the ways of the tzaddik and do not understand, they then dispute with him.

“And they continued to hate him still more on account of his dreams and on account of his words.”

(37:8)

All this is the aspect of the dispute between the tzaddikim and those who are somewhat upright. And the principal cause is that everyone wants to understand immediately all the ways of the tzaddik and his attainments. For if everyone saw and understood even one part in a thousand of what the tzaddik attained, they would certainly all be attached to him and would draw near to him with all their soul and their resources.

But the tzaddik conducts himself wisely for the sake of free choice, and conceals himself and hides himself from the world. He only reveals to them a very little, in such a manner that they will know and understand that the secret is with him. And this is as he wrote there, of blessed memory, concerning the mystery of intercalation, which is the general principle of the Torah, that it contains wisdom such that they can reveal to them what they reveal, and nevertheless the secret will remain with him, etc., which is the aspect of “For it is your wisdom and your understanding in the eyes of the nations”—specifically, etc. And only through what they reveal to them will they understand that the secret is with him; and through this they have free choice.

For certainly, if they truly desire in all truth, they can understand from afar, through what he has already revealed to them, that he certainly knows further what he knows, in such a manner that they will draw near forever. But a fool does not desire understanding, etc. And thus the tzaddik conducts himself in all his attainments, until those who truly desire do indeed draw near. But there are those who raise many difficult questions against him, because they want to understand everything. And even with tzaddikim the baal davar provokes them and introduces difficult questions against him into their hearts, for he provokes Torah scholars and tzaddikim especially to dispute with him, because many of Israel look to them.

And in truth there are many hidden matters here concerning the dispute among the tzaddikim themselves, as is explained on the verse “An ear that hears life-giving reproof,” etc., as is explained in section 5 of Likutay, Part One.

And this is the aspect of the dispute among the tribes against Yosef, that he revealed his dreams to them so that they would understand from afar the immensity of his greatness; and they continued to hate him on account of his dreams, etc. And thus it proceeds now, as stated above.

(Halachos of ראש חודש [The New Month], halacha 6, item 49)

segments.he:
"וְעַתָּה לְכוּ וְנַהַרְגֵהוּ"

(ל״ז, כ)

שָׁמַעְתִּי וְהֵבַנְתִּי מִפִּיו הַקָּדוֹשׁ זכר צדיק לברכה שֶׁאָמַר, שֶׁזֶּה יֵצֶר הָרַע גָּדוֹל אֵצֶל כַּמָּה בְּנֵי אָדָם, וּבִפְרָט הַגְּדוֹלִים בְּמַעֲלָה, שֶׁבִּשְׁבִיל דָּבָר אֶחָד שֶׁנִּדְמֶה לָהֶם שֶׁהוּא מִצְוָה, הֵם מַפְקִירִים הַכֹּל וּבָאִים עַל יְדֵי זֶה לְקִלְקוּלִים רַבִּים, וּבִפְרָט כְּשֶׁבָּאִים עַל יְדֵי זֶה לִידֵי מַחֲלֹקֶת.

וּכְשֶׁיְּעַיֵּן בְּכָל הַמַּעֲשִׂיּוֹת שֶׁהָיָה בֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר הַכֹּל הָיָה בִּבְחִינָה זֹאת, שֶׁהַבַּעַל דָּבָר הִטְעָה אוֹתָם כְּאִלּוּ שֶׁכְּנֶגְדּוֹ פּוֹגֵם הַרְבֵּה וּמִצְוָה לִמְסֹר נֶפֶשׁ לְרָדְפוֹ וְכוּ׳.

וּבֶאֱמֶת זֶהוּ פְּגָם מְאֹד, כִּי עַל יְדֵי הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת וְהַכַּעַס אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְתַקֵּן בְּשׁוּם אֹפֶן, רַק צְרִיכִין לְהִתְיַשֵּׁב הַרְבֵּה אֵיךְ לְהִתְנַהֵג בָּזֶה. וְהָעִקָּר לְבַקֵּשׁ מֵה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁיַּנְחֵהוּ בְּדֶרֶךְ הָאֱמֶת וּלְהִתְיַשֵּׁב עַצְמוֹ הַרְבֵּה אִם יֵשׁ לוֹ כֹּחַ לְרָדְפוֹ, וְאוּלַי כַּוָּנָתוֹ שֶׁל הַשֵּׁנִי לַשָּׁמַיִם רַק שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהָבִין דְּבָרָיו. וְגַם אָמְרוּ עָלָיו הַרְבֵּה שְׁקָרִים וּכְזָבִים בְּחִינַת אֲשֶׁר לֹא גָזַלְתִּי אָז אָשִׁיב. וְיֵשׁ בָּזֶה הַרְבֵּה לְדַבֵּר.

וְזֶה הָיָה בְּחִינַת הַפְּגָם שֶׁל רְאוּבֵן שֶׁכַּוָּנָתוֹ בְּוַדַּאי לַשָּׁמַיִם כִּי קִנֵּא קִנְאַת אִמּוֹ. אַף עַל פִּי כֵן פָּגַם בָּזֶה מְאֹד עַד שֶׁאָבַד עַל יְדֵי זֶה הַכְּהֻנָּה וְהַמַּלְכוּת וְכָל הַפְּגָם הָיָה בִּבְחִינַת דֹּחַק אֶת הַשָּׁעָה בְּחִינַת פַּחְדוֹ כְּמַיִם אַל תּוֹתַר וְכוּ׳.

וּבִפְרָט שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי פָּגְמוּ בָּזֶה הַרְבֵּה יוֹתֵר, כִּי מָכְרוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף שֶׁהַכֹּל הָיָה בִּבְחִינָה הַנַּ״ל שֶׁדָּחֲקוּ אֶת הַשָּׁעָה, וְסָבְרוּ שֶׁיִּתַּקְּנוּ הָעוֹלָם עַל יְדֵי מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף, כִּי רָאוּ שֶׁמֵּבִיא אֶת דִּבָּתָם רָעָה אֶל אֲבִיהֶם וְרָאוּ שֶׁיֵּצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ יָרָבְעָם וְאַחְאָב, עַל כֵּן לְפִי דַּעְתָּם רָצוּ לְהָרְגוֹ וְכַוָּנָתָם הָיָה בִּשְׁבִיל תִּקּוּן הָעוֹלָם שֶׁלֹּא יֵצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ יָרָבְעָם וְאַחְאָב כַּנַּ״ל. וְכֵן שְׁאָרֵי סְבָרוֹת שֶׁל טָעוּת שֶׁהָיָה לָהֶם בָּזֶה, כִּי בְּוַדַּאי הָיוּ צַדִּיקִים גְּדוֹלִים אַךְ שָׁגוּ הַרְבֵּה וְעִקַּר הַפְּגָם הָיָה בִּבְחִינַת דֹּחַק הַשָּׁעָה.

(הלכות גזילה הלכה ה׳ אות י׳)
segments.en:
“And now, let us go and kill him.”

(37:20)

I heard and understood from his holy mouth, may the memory of the righteous be for a blessing, that he said that this is a great evil inclination among some people, and especially those who are great in spiritual stature: for the sake of one thing that appears to them to be a mitzvah, they abandon everything, and through this they come to many forms of corruption, and especially when through this they come to dispute.

And when one examines all the accounts that took place among the tzaddikim in every generation, everything was in this aspect: that the baal davar misled them as though the one opposing him caused great damage, and it were a mitzvah to give up one’s life to persecute him, etc.

And in truth this is a very great blemish, for through dispute and anger it is impossible to rectify in any way. One must only deliberate thoroughly about how to conduct oneself in this. And the principal thing is to ask Hashem, blessed be He, to guide him in the way of truth, and to deliberate thoroughly within himself as to whether he has the strength to persecute him. And perhaps the other person’s intention is for the sake of Heaven, but it is impossible to understand his words. And they also said many lies and falsehoods about him, in the aspect of “That which I did not steal, I will then restore.” And there is much to say concerning this.

And this was the aspect of Reuven’s blemish, whose intention was certainly for the sake of Heaven, for he was zealous for his mother. Nevertheless, he caused very great damage by this, to the point that through this he lost the priesthood and the kingship. And all the damage was in the aspect of pressing the hour, in the aspect of “His fear, like water; do not exceed,” etc.

And especially Shimon and Levi caused much greater damage by this, for they sold Yosef; all of it was in the aspect stated above, that they pressed the hour, and they thought that they would rectify the world through the sale of Yosef. For they saw that he brought an evil report of them to their father, and they saw that Yeravam and Achav would come forth from him. Therefore, in their opinion they wanted to kill him, and their intention was for the rectification of the world, that Yeravam and Achav should not come forth from him, as stated above. And likewise the other mistaken arguments they had in this, for certainly they were great tzaddikim, but they erred greatly, and the principal damage was in the aspect of pressing the hour.

(Halachos of גזילה [Robbery], halacha 5, item 10)

Therefore, in their opinion they wanted to kill him, and their intention was for the rectification of the world, that Yeravam and Achav should not come forth from him, as stated above. And likewise the other mistaken arguments they had in this, for certainly they were great tzaddikim, but they erred greatly, and the principal damage was in the aspect of pressing the hour.

השבטים סברו שרוצה למשול במלוכה דס״א שנמשך מעשירות, ובאמת להיפך ממשלתו על ידי הדעת שזוכין ע״י להארת הרצון שזוכים באכילה, ולכן יהודה הציע שע״י שימכרו אותו יתקנו פגם הארת הרצון לפי דעתם

״מַה בֶּצַע כִּי נַהֲרֹג אֶת אָחִינוּ״ (ל״ז, כו) עַל פִּי הַתּוֹרָה כִּי מְרַחֲמָם יְנַהֲגֵם בְּלִקּוּטֵי תִנְיָנָא סִימָן ז, עַיֵּן שָׁם. מְבֹאָר שָׁם שֶׁעִקַּר הַחִיּוּב מַה שֶּׁהָאָדָם מְחֻיָּב לְהַשְׁאִיר אַחֲרָיו אֶת ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְכוּ׳, עַיֵּן שָׁם מֵעִנְיַן בֵּן וְתַלְמִיד שֶׁעַל יָדָם נִשְׁאָר דַּעְתּוֹ בָּעוֹלָם שֶׁזֶּה עִקַּר הִשָּׁאֲרוּתוֹ, כִּי אֵין נִשְׁאָר מֵהָאָדָם אַחַר מוֹתוֹ שׁוּם דָּבָר כִּי אִם הַדַּעַת שֶׁהֵאִיר בְּבָנִים וְתַלְמִידִים וְכוּ׳, עַיֵּן שָׁם כָּל זֶה הֵיטֵב.

וּמְבֹאָר שָׁם שֶׁעַל יְדֵי כְּלָלִיּוּת בֵּן וְתַלְמִיד עַל יְדֵי זֶה מִי שֶׁהוּא אִישׁ חַיִל יָכוֹל לְקַבֵּל בְּעֵת הָאֲכִילָה הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן וְכוּ׳, כִּי עִקַּר הַפַּרְנָסָה נִמְשָׁךְ מִיָּם הַחָכְמָה שֶׁנִּמְשָׁךְ עַל יְדֵי בֵּן וְתַלְמִיד וְכוּ׳, עַיֵּן שָׁם כָּל זֶה הֵיטֵב.

יַעֲקֹב מָסַר הַבְּכוֹרָה לִבְנוֹ לְיוֹסֵף, כִּי בֶן זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ, וְזֶהוּ זָקֵן קָנָה חָכְמָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה. וּמוּבָא בְּפֵרוּשׁ רש״י שֶׁכָּל מַה שֶּׁלָּמַד מִשֵּׁם וְעֵבֶר מָסַר לוֹ. וְעַל כֵּן מֵחֲמַת שֶׁמָּסַר לוֹ חָכְמָתוֹ וְדַעְתּוֹ הַקְּדוֹשָׁה עַל כֵּן מָסַר לוֹ הַבְּכוֹרָה שֶׁהִיא בְּחִינַת קְדֻשַּׁת הַדַּעַת שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק צָרִיךְ לְהַשְׁאִיר לְבָנָיו וּלְתַלְמִידָיו כַּנַּ״ל, כִּי הַבְּכוֹרָה הָיְתָה מַגִּיעַ לִרְאוּבֵן. אַךְ בְּחַלְּלוֹ יְצוּעֵי אָבִיו וְזֶה פְּגַם בְּהַדַּעַת עַל יְדֵי זֶה נָתַן בְּכוֹרָתוֹ לְיוֹסֵף שֶׁזָּכָה לִשְׁמֹר הַדַּעַת בִּשְׁלֵמוּת, כִּי עָמַד בְּנִסָּיוֹן שֶׁל תַּאֲוָה זֹאת שֶׁזֶּה עִקַּר שְׁמִירַת הַדַּעַת.

וְהַשְּׁבָטִים הִתְקַנְּאוּ בוֹ עַל שֶׁהוֹצִיא דִבָּה עֲלֵיהֶם. עַל כֵּן חָשְׁדוּ אוֹתוֹ עַל כָּל הַדְּבָרִים שֶׁדִּבֵּר עֲלֵיהֶם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה כָּל הַפּוֹסֵל בְּמוּמוֹ פּוֹסֵל. גַּם נִסְתַּכְּלוּ בְּרוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ שֶׁיֵּצְאוּ מִמֶּנּוּ יָרָבְעָם וְאַחְאָב שֶׁיַּעֲבִדוּ עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה. עַל כֵּן חָשְׁדוּ אוֹתוֹ שֶׁמַּטְעֶה אֶת אָבִיו כְּמוֹ עֵשָׂו עַד שֶׁהִתִּירוּ אֶת דָּמוֹ.

וְזֶה בְּחִינַת הַחֲלוֹם שֶׁסִּפֵּר לָהֶם, וְהִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים וְכוּ׳ וְהִנֵּה קָמָה אֲלֻמָּתִי וְגַם נִצָּבָה וְכוּ׳. וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אֶחָיו הֲמָלֹךְ תִּמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ אִם וְכוּ׳, כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת טָעוּ אֶחָיו בְּיוֹסֵף, כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת הָיָה צַדִּיק גָּדוֹל וְזָכָה לְקַבֵּל עִקַּר הַדַּעַת מֵאָבִיו. וְעַל כֵּן הֶרְאוּ לוֹ בַּחֲלוֹם שֶׁיִּמְלֹךְ וְיִמְשֹׁל, וְהֶרְאוּ לוֹ דַּיְקָא עַל יְדֵי תְּבוּאוֹת הַשָּׂדֶה שֶׁהָיָה מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים, הַיְנוּ עִנְיָן הַנַּ״ל שֶׁעַל יְדֵי הַדַּעַת זוֹכִין לְקַבֵּל הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן עַל יְדֵי הַמְּלוּכָה וְהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה.

עַל כֵּן הֶרְאוּ לוֹ שֶׁזָּכָה לָזֶה וְרָמְזוּ לוֹ דַּיְקָא בַּאֲלֻמּוֹת הַשָּׂדֶה שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת שֶׁפַע הַפַּרְנָסָה לְהוֹרוֹת שֶׁהוּא זָכָה לְמֶמְשָׁלָה וּמְלוּכָה שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה גְּדֵלִים אֲלֻמּוֹת הַשָּׂדֶה, דְּהַיְנוּ שֶׁפַע הַפַּרְנָסָה וְכוּ׳, וְזָכָה לָזֶה עַל יְדֵי גֹּדֶל הַדַּעַת הַנַּ״ל שֶׁקִּבֵּל מֵאָבִיו כַּנַּ״ל.

וְאֶחָיו הֵבִינוּ דַּעְתּוֹ שֶׁפָּתַר הַחֲלוֹם בְּעִנְיָן זֶה, עַל כֵּן הִתְקַנְּאוּ בוֹ וְאָמְרוּ לוֹ, הֲמָלֹךְ תִּמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ וְכוּ׳. כִּי אָמְרוּ שֶׁהוּא בַּהֵפֶךְ שֶׁמַּטְעֶה אֶת אָבִיו וְרוֹצֶה לִמְשֹׁל וְלִמְלֹךְ בְּמַלְכוּת דְּסִטְרָא אַחֲרָא כְּמוֹ יָרָבְעָם שֶׁיָּצָא מִמֶּנּוּ שֶׁמָּלַךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהֶחֱטִיא אוֹתָם מְאֹד עַל יְדֵי שְׁנֵי עֶגְלֵי זָהָב שֶׁעָשָׂה לָהֶם.

כִּי בְּהַמָּמוֹן וְהָעֲשִׁירוּת בִּקְדֻשָּׁה גָּבֹהַּ מְאֹד מְאֹד, כִּי נִמְשָׁךְ מֵהַיָּדַיִם שֶׁיֵּשׁ בְּיָם הַחָכְמָה וְכוּ׳ וְעַל כֵּן מֵאִיר שָׁם הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן כַּנַּ״ל, אֲבָל זֶה אֵין זוֹכֶה כִּי אִם הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת וְהַנִּלְוִים אֵלָיו בֶּאֱמֶת שֶׁמְּקַבְּלִים דַּעְתּוֹ הַנַּ״ל שֶׁמֵּאִיר בְּבֵן וְתַלְמִיד כַּנַּ״ל, אֲבָל לְהֵפֶךְ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם מִי שֶׁאֵין מְקַבֵּל הַדַּעַת הַנַּ״ל, מִכָּל שֶׁכֵּן מִי שֶׁחוֹלֵק עַל הַצַּדִּיק הַזֶּה שֶׁמֵּאִיר הַדַּעַת הַנַּ״ל כָּל נְפִילָתוֹ הוּא עַל יְדֵי הַמָּמוֹן וְהָעֲשִׁירוּת, כִּי לְמַטָּה נֶאֱחָזִים כָּל הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה בְּהַמָּמוֹן, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר (בסימן כג) כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, וְכֶסֶף הִרְבֵּיתִי לָהֶם וְזָהָב עָשׂוּ לַבָּעַל (עין מזה במקום אחר) וְעַל כֵּן טָעוּ הַשְּׁבָטִים וְאָמְרוּ שֶׁיוֹסֵף רוֹצֶה לִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם בְּמַלְכוּת הַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא הַנַּ״ל עַד שֶׁהִתִּירוּ אֶת דָּמוֹ.

וְזֶה שֶׁאָמַר לָהֶם יְהוּדָה, מַה בֶּצַע כִּי נַהֲרֹג אֶת אָחִינוּ וְכוּ׳ לְכוּ וְנִמְכְּרֶנּוּ לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים וְכוּ׳. וְהַדָּבָר תָּמוּהַּ מְאֹד וְכִי עָלָה עַל דַּעַת יְהוּדָה שֶׁרוֹצִים לַהֲרֹג אֶת יוֹסֵף בִּשְׁבִיל בֶּצַע וּמָמוֹן, עַד שֶׁאָמַר לָהֶם מַה בֶּצַע כִּי נַהֲרֹג וְכוּ׳, הֲלֹא יָדַע הָאֱמֶת שֶׁכַּוָּנָתָם לְשָׁמַיִם לְפִי טָעוּתָם שֶׁרוֹצִים לַהֲרְגוֹ שֶׁלֹּא יַטְעֶה אוֹתָם אוֹ אֲחֵרִים מֵהָאֱמוּנָה הָאֲמִתִּית שֶׁקִּבְּלוּ מֵאֲבִיהֶם, אֲבָל עַל כָּל פָּנִים חַס וְשָׁלוֹם אֵין כַּוָּנָתָם כְּלָל בִּשְׁבִיל אֵיזֶה מָמוֹן וּבֶצַע.

רַק יְהוּדָה רָמַז לָהֶם עִנְיָן הַנַּ״ל, מֵחֲמַת שֶׁלְּפִי דַּעְתְּכֶם רְצוֹנְכֶם לְבַעֲרוֹ כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יְקַלְקֵל אֶת הַדַּעַת הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁהִתְחִילוּ הָאָבוֹת לְהַמְשִׁיךְ בָּעוֹלָם. וַאֲזַי הוּכְלוּ אַתֶּם לְהַמְשִׁיךְ זֶה הַדַּעַת הַקָּדוֹשׁ, עַל כֵּן אָמַר לָהֶם מַה בֶּצַע וְכוּ׳ לְכוּ וְנִמְכְּרֶנּוּ וְכוּ׳, הַיְנוּ שֶׁלְּפִי זֶה טוֹב לְמָכְרוֹ וּלְקַבֵּל בַּעֲדוֹ מָמוֹן, וְאַתֶּם הַשְּׁבָטִים שֶׁכֻּלְּכֶם קְדוֹשִׁים, כְּשֶׁתְּקַבְּלוּ מָמוֹן בַּעֲדוֹ וּתְקַבְּלוּ עַל יְדֵי זֶה הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן שֶׁמֵּאִיר בְּהַמָּמוֹן כְּשֶׁמְּקַבְּלִים אוֹתוֹ כָּרָאוּי וַאֲזַי תְּתַקְּנוּ הַדָּבָר כָּרָאוּי.

כִּי מַה שֶּׁלְּפִי דַּעְתְּכֶם רָצָה יוֹסֵף לִפְגֹּם בְּהַדַּעַת הַנַּ״ל שֶׁהוּא פְּגַם הָרָצוֹן הַמֵּאִיר בְּהַמָּמוֹן שֶׁהוּא פְּגַם הַמַּלְכוּת וְהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה, עַל כֵּן טוֹב שֶׁתִּמְכְּרוּ אוֹתוֹ וּבָזֶה תַּפִּילוּ אוֹתוֹ מֵהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה וְשׁוּב לֹא יוּכַל לִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיכֶם בְּמַלְכוּת דְּסִטְרָא אַחֲרָא חַס וְשָׁלוֹם וּלְקַלְקֵל אֶת הַדַּעַת עַל יְדֵי רִבּוּי הָעֲשִׁירוּת כְּמוֹ יָרָבְעָם וְכוּ׳, אַדְּרַבָּא, תְּקַבְּלוּ דְּמֵי מְכִירָתוֹ וְאָז תּוּכְלוּ לְקַבֵּל וּלְהַעֲלוֹת הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן שֶׁנָּפַל אֵצֶל יוֹסֵף לְפִי טָעוּתָם, וְאַתֶּם תַּעֲלוּ אוֹתוֹ וּתְקַבְּלוּ הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן עַל יְדֵי הַמָּמוֹן שֶׁתְּקַבְּלוּ בִּדְמֵי מְכִירָתוֹ.

(הלכות פדיון בכור הלכה ה׳ אות י״ד)
segments.en:
The tribes thought that he wanted to rule with the kingship of the sitra achra, which proceeds from wealth; but in truth it is the reverse: his rule is through knowledge, through which one merits the illumination of will that is attained in eating. And therefore Yehudah proposed that by selling him they would rectify the blemish in the illumination of will, according to their understanding.

“What profit is there if we kill our brother?” (37:26), according to the teaching “For their compassionate One shall guide them,” in Likutay Tinyana, section 7; see there. It is explained there that the chief obligation, that which a person is obligated to leave after him, is Hashem, blessed be He, etc.; see there concerning a son and a disciple, through whom his knowledge remains in the world, which is his principal enduring remnant. For nothing remains of a person after his death except the knowledge he illuminated in children and disciples, etc.; see all this there carefully.

And it is explained there that through the incorporation of son and disciple, thereby one who is a man of valor can receive the illumination of will while eating, etc.; for sustenance is principally drawn from the sea of wisdom, which is drawn through son and disciple, etc.; see all this there carefully.

Yaakov handed the birthright to his son, to Yosef, for “he was a son of old age to him”; and this is “an elder”—one who has acquired wisdom, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said. And it is cited in Rashi’s commentary that everything he learned from Shem and Ever he handed over to him. And therefore, because he handed his wisdom and holy knowledge over to him, therefore he handed the birthright over to him, which is the aspect of the holiness of the knowledge that the tzaddik must leave to his children and disciples, as above. For the birthright was due to Reuven, but when he profaned his father’s couch, and this is a blemish in knowledge, through this he gave his birthright to Yosef, who merited to preserve knowledge completely, for he stood firm in the trial of this desire, which is the chief preservation of knowledge.

And the tribes became jealous of him because he brought an evil report about them. Therefore they suspected him of all the things he spoke against them, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said: whoever disqualifies, disqualifies through his own blemish. They also saw through the holy spirit that Yeravam and Achav would emerge from him and would serve idolatry. Therefore they suspected him of misleading his father like Esav, until they permitted his blood [to be shed].

And this is the aspect of the dream he told them: “And behold, we were binding sheaves,” etc., “and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright,” etc. And his brothers said to him, “Will you indeed reign over us, or,” etc. For in truth his brothers were mistaken about Yosef, for in truth he was a great tzaddik and merited to receive the principal knowledge from his father. And therefore they showed him in a dream that he would reign and rule, and they showed him specifically through the produce of the field, for they were binding sheaves: namely, the aforesaid matter, that through knowledge one merits to receive the illumination of will through kingship and rule.

Therefore they showed him that he merited this, and hinted to him specifically by the sheaves of the field, which are the aspect of the flow of sustenance, to indicate that he merited rule and kingship, through which the sheaves of the field grow—that is, the flow of sustenance, etc.—and he merited this through the greatness of the aforesaid knowledge that he received from his father, as above.

And his brothers understood his intention, that he interpreted the dream in this sense. Therefore they became jealous of him and said to him, “Will you indeed reign over us,” etc. For they said that it was the reverse: that he was misleading his father and wanted to rule and reign with the kingship of the sitra achra, like Yeravam who emerged from him, who reigned over Israel and caused them to sin greatly through the two golden calves he made for them.

For in money and wealth in holiness [the level] is very, very high, for it proceeds from the hands that are in the sea of wisdom, etc., and therefore the illumination of will shines there, as above. But none merits this except the true tzaddik and those who genuinely join him, who receive his aforesaid knowledge that he illuminates in son and disciple, as above. But conversely, God forbid, whoever does not receive the aforesaid knowledge, and all the more whoever disputes this tzaddik who illuminates the aforesaid knowledge—all his downfall is through money and wealth, for below, this entire world clings to money, as written elsewhere (in section 23), as it is written, “And I increased silver for them, and gold they made for Baal” (see concerning this elsewhere). And therefore the tribes erred and said that Yosef wanted to reign over them with the aforesaid kingship of the sitra achra, until they permitted his blood [to be shed].

And this is what Yehudah said to them: “What profit is there if we kill our brother,” etc., “Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites,” etc. And the matter is most astonishing: did it enter Yehudah’s mind that they wanted to kill Yosef for profit and money, so that he said to them, “What profit is there if we kill,” etc.? Did he not know the truth, that their intention was for Heaven, according to their error, that they wanted to kill him so that he would not mislead them or others away from the true faith they received from their father? But in any event, God forbid, their intention was not at all for any money and profit.

Rather, Yehudah hinted to them at the aforesaid matter: since, according to your understanding, your wish was to remove him so that he would not corrupt the holy knowledge that the forefathers began to draw into the world, and then you would be able to draw this holy knowledge, therefore he said to them, “What profit,” etc., “Come, let us sell him,” etc. That is, according to this it is good to sell him and receive money for him; and you, the tribes, who are all holy, when you receive money for him and thereby receive the illumination of will that shines in money when it is received properly, then you will rectify the matter properly.

For what, according to your understanding, Yosef wanted to blemish in the aforesaid knowledge is a blemish in the will that shines in money, which is a blemish in kingship and rule. Therefore it is good for you to sell him, and by this you will cast him down from rule, and he will no longer be able to reign over you with the kingship of the sitra achra, God forbid, and to corrupt knowledge through an abundance of wealth, like Yeravam, etc. On the contrary, you will receive the money from his sale, and then you will be able to receive and raise the illumination of will that fell with Yosef, according to their error; and you will raise it and receive the illumination of will through the money that you will receive as the price of his sale.

(Halachos of Redemption of the Firstborn, Halacha 5, item 14)

pairs.he: יַעֲקֹב מָסַר הַבְּכוֹרָה לִבְנוֹ לְיוֹסֵף, כִּי בֶן זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ, וְזֶהוּ זָקֵן קָנָה חָכְמָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה. וּמוּבָא בְּפֵרוּשׁ רש״י שֶׁכָּל מַה שֶּׁלָּמַד מִשֵּׁם וְעֵבֶר מָסַר לוֹ. וְעַל כֵּן מֵחֲמַת שֶׁמָּסַר לוֹ חָכְמָתוֹ וְדַעְתּוֹ הַקְּדוֹשָׁה עַל כֵּן מָסַר לוֹ הַבְּכוֹרָה שֶׁהִיא בְּחִינַת קְדֻשַּׁת הַדַּעַת שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק צָרִיךְ לְהַשְׁאִיר לְבָנָיו וּלְתַלְמִידָיו כַּנַּ״ל, כִּי הַבְּכוֹרָה הָיְתָה מַגִּיעַ לִרְאוּבֵן. אַךְ בְּחַלְּלוֹ יְצוּעֵי אָבִיו וְזֶה פְּגַם בְּהַדַּעַת עַל יְדֵי זֶה נָתַן בְּכוֹרָתוֹ לְיוֹסֵף שֶׁזָּכָה לִשְׁמֹר הַדַּעַת בִּשְׁלֵמוּת, כִּי עָמַד בְּנִסָּיוֹן שֶׁל תַּאֲוָה זֹאת שֶׁזֶּה עִקַּר שְׁמִירַת הַדַּעַת.
pairs.en: Yaakov handed the birthright to his son, to Yosef, for “he was a son of old age to him”; and this is “an elder”—one who has acquired wisdom, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said. And it is cited in Rashi’s commentary that everything he learned from Shem and Ever he handed over to him. And therefore, because he handed his wisdom and holy knowledge over to him, therefore he handed the birthright over to him, which is the aspect of the holiness of the knowledge that the tzaddik must leave to his children and disciples, as above. For the birthright was due to Reuven, but when he profaned his father’s couch, and this is a blemish in knowledge, through this he gave his birthright to Yosef, who merited to preserve knowledge completely, for he stood firm in the trial of this desire, which is the chief preservation of knowledge.

qualifiedAfter.en: Yaakov handed the birthright to his son, to Yosef, for “he was a son of old age to him”; and this is “an elder”—one who has acquired wisdom, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said. pairs.he: וְהַשְּׁבָטִים הִתְקַנְּאוּ בוֹ עַל שֶׁהוֹצִיא דִבָּה עֲלֵיהֶם. עַל כֵּן חָשְׁדוּ אוֹתוֹ עַל כָּל הַדְּבָרִים שֶׁדִּבֵּר עֲלֵיהֶם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה כָּל הַפּוֹסֵל בְּמוּמוֹ פּוֹסֵל. גַּם נִסְתַּכְּלוּ בְּרוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ שֶׁיֵּצְאוּ מִמֶּנּוּ יָרָבְעָם וְאַחְאָב שֶׁיַּעֲבִדוּ עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה. עַל כֵּן חָשְׁדוּ אוֹתוֹ שֶׁמַּטְעֶה אֶת אָבִיו כְּמוֹ עֵשָׂו עַד שֶׁהִתִּירוּ אֶת דָּמוֹ.
pairs.en: And the tribes became jealous of him because he brought an evil report about them. Therefore they suspected him of all the things he spoke against them, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said: whoever disqualifies, disqualifies through his own blemish. They also saw through the holy spirit that Yeravam and Achav would emerge from him and would serve idolatry. Therefore they suspected him of misleading his father like Esav, until they permitted his blood [to be shed].

qualifiedAfter.en: And the tribes became jealous of him because he brought an evil report about them. Therefore they suspected him of all the things he spoke against them, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said: whoever disqualifies, disqualifies through his own blemish. pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת הַחֲלוֹם שֶׁסִּפֵּר לָהֶם, וְהִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים וְכוּ׳ וְהִנֵּה קָמָה אֲלֻמָּתִי וְגַם נִצָּבָה וְכוּ׳. וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אֶחָיו הֲמָלֹךְ תִּמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ אִם וְכוּ׳, כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת טָעוּ אֶחָיו בְּיוֹסֵף, כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת הָיָה צַדִּיק גָּדוֹל וְזָכָה לְקַבֵּל עִקַּר הַדַּעַת מֵאָבִיו. וְעַל כֵּן הֶרְאוּ לוֹ בַּחֲלוֹם שֶׁיִּמְלֹךְ וְיִמְשֹׁל, וְהֶרְאוּ לוֹ דַּיְקָא עַל יְדֵי תְּבוּאוֹת הַשָּׂדֶה שֶׁהָיָה מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים, הַיְנוּ עִנְיָן הַנַּ״ל שֶׁעַל יְדֵי הַדַּעַת זוֹכִין לְקַבֵּל הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן עַל יְדֵי הַמְּלוּכָה וְהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of the dream he told them: “And behold, we were binding sheaves,” etc., “and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright,” etc. And his brothers said to him, “Will you indeed reign over us, or,” etc. For in truth his brothers were mistaken about Yosef, for in truth he was a great tzaddik and merited to receive the principal knowledge from his father. And therefore they showed him in a dream that he would reign and rule, and they showed him specifically through the produce of the field, for they were binding sheaves: namely, the aforesaid matter, that through knowledge one merits to receive the illumination of will through kingship and rule.

qualifiedAfter.en: And this is the aspect of the dream he told them: “And behold, we were binding sheaves,” etc., “and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright,” etc. And his brothers said to him, “Will you indeed reign over us, or,” etc. For in truth his brothers were mistaken about Yosef, for in truth he was a great tzaddik and merited to receive the principal knowledge from his father. And therefore they showed him in a dream that he would reign and rule, and they showed him specifically through the produce of the field, for they were binding sheaves: namely, the aforesaid matter, that through knowledge one merits to receive the illumination of will through kingship and rule.

pairs.he: עַל כֵּן הֶרְאוּ לוֹ שֶׁזָּכָה לָזֶה וְרָמְזוּ לוֹ דַּיְקָא בַּאֲלֻמּוֹת הַשָּׂדֶה שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת שֶׁפַע הַפַּרְנָסָה לְהוֹרוֹת שֶׁהוּא זָכָה לְמֶמְשָׁלָה וּמְלוּכָה שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה גְּדֵלִים אֲלֻמּוֹת הַשָּׂדֶה, דְּהַיְנוּ שֶׁפַע הַפַּרְנָסָה וְכוּ׳, וְזָכָה לָזֶה עַל יְדֵי גֹּדֶל הַדַּעַת הַנַּ״ל שֶׁקִּבֵּל מֵאָבִיו כַּנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: Therefore they showed him that he merited this, and hinted to him specifically by the sheaves of the field, which are the aspect of the flow of sustenance, to indicate that he merited rule and kingship, through which the sheaves of the field grow—that is, the flow of sustenance, etc.—and he merited this through the greatness of the aforesaid knowledge that he received from his father, as above.

qualifiedAfter.en: Therefore they showed him that he merited this, and hinted to him specifically by the sheaves of the field, which are the aspect of the flow of sustenance, to indicate that he merited rule and kingship, through which the sheaves of the field grow—that is, the flow of sustenance, etc.—and he merited this through the greatness of the aforesaid knowledge that he received from his father, as above.

pairs.he: וְאֶחָיו הֵבִינוּ דַּעְתּוֹ שֶׁפָּתַר הַחֲלוֹם בְּעִנְיָן זֶה, עַל כֵּן הִתְקַנְּאוּ בוֹ וְאָמְרוּ לוֹ, הֲמָלֹךְ תִּמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ וְכוּ׳. כִּי אָמְרוּ שֶׁהוּא בַּהֵפֶךְ שֶׁמַּטְעֶה אֶת אָבִיו וְרוֹצֶה לִמְשֹׁל וְלִמְלֹךְ בְּמַלְכוּת דְּסִטְרָא אַחֲרָא כְּמוֹ יָרָבְעָם שֶׁיָּצָא מִמֶּנּוּ שֶׁמָּלַךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהֶחֱטִיא אוֹתָם מְאֹד עַל יְדֵי שְׁנֵי עֶגְלֵי זָהָב שֶׁעָשָׂה לָהֶם.
pairs.en: And his brothers understood his intention, that he interpreted the dream in this sense. Therefore they became jealous of him and said to him, “Will you indeed reign over us,” etc. For they said that it was the reverse: that he was misleading his father and wanted to rule and reign with the kingship of the sitra achra, like Yeravam who emerged from him, who reigned over Israel and caused them to sin greatly through the two golden calves he made for them.

qualifiedAfter.en: And his brothers understood his intention, that he interpreted the dream in this sense. Therefore they became jealous of him and said to him, “Will you indeed reign over us,” etc. For they said that it was the reverse: that he was misleading his father and wanted to rule and reign with the kingship of the sitra achra, like Yeravam who emerged from him, who reigned over Israel and caused them to sin greatly through the two golden calves he made for them.

pairs.he: כִּי בְּהַמָּמוֹן וְהָעֲשִׁירוּת בִּקְדֻשָּׁה גָּבֹהַּ מְאֹד מְאֹד, כִּי נִמְשָׁךְ מֵהַיָּדַיִם שֶׁיֵּשׁ בְּיָם הַחָכְמָה וְכוּ׳ וְעַל כֵּן מֵאִיר שָׁם הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן כַּנַּ״ל, אֲבָל זֶה אֵין זוֹכֶה כִּי אִם הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת וְהַנִּלְוִים אֵלָיו בֶּאֱמֶת שֶׁמְּקַבְּלִים דַּעְתּוֹ הַנַּ״ל שֶׁמֵּאִיר בְּבֵן וְתַלְמִיד כַּנַּ״ל, אֲבָל לְהֵפֶךְ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם מִי שֶׁאֵין מְקַבֵּל הַדַּעַת הַנַּ״ל, מִכָּל שֶׁכֵּן מִי שֶׁחוֹלֵק עַל הַצַּדִּיק הַזֶּה שֶׁמֵּאִיר הַדַּעַת הַנַּ״ל כָּל נְפִילָתוֹ הוּא עַל יְדֵי הַמָּמוֹן וְהָעֲשִׁירוּת, כִּי לְמַטָּה נֶאֱחָזִים כָּל הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה בְּהַמָּמוֹן, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר (בסימן כג) כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, וְכֶסֶף הִרְבֵּיתִי לָהֶם וְזָהָב עָשׂוּ לַבָּעַל (עין מזה במקום אחר) וְעַל כֵּן טָעוּ הַשְּׁבָטִים וְאָמְרוּ שֶׁיוֹסֵף רוֹצֶה לִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם בְּמַלְכוּת הַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא הַנַּ״ל עַד שֶׁהִתִּירוּ אֶת דָּמוֹ.
pairs.en: For in money and wealth in holiness [the level] is very, very high, for it proceeds from the hands that are in the sea of wisdom, etc., and therefore the illumination of will shines there, as above. But none merits this except the true tzaddik and those who genuinely join him, who receive his aforesaid knowledge that he illuminates in son and disciple, as above. But conversely, God forbid, whoever does not receive the aforesaid knowledge, and all the more whoever disputes this tzaddik who illuminates the aforesaid knowledge—all his downfall is through money and wealth, for below, this entire world clings to money, as written elsewhere (in section 23), as it is written, “And I increased silver for them, and gold they made for Baal” (see concerning this elsewhere). And therefore the tribes erred and said that Yosef wanted to reign over them with the aforesaid kingship of the sitra achra, until they permitted his blood [to be shed].

pairs.he: וְזֶה שֶׁאָמַר לָהֶם יְהוּדָה, מַה בֶּצַע כִּי נַהֲרֹג אֶת אָחִינוּ וְכוּ׳ לְכוּ וְנִמְכְּרֶנּוּ לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים וְכוּ׳. וְהַדָּבָר תָּמוּהַּ מְאֹד וְכִי עָלָה עַל דַּעַת יְהוּדָה שֶׁרוֹצִים לַהֲרֹג אֶת יוֹסֵף בִּשְׁבִיל בֶּצַע וּמָמוֹן, עַד שֶׁאָמַר לָהֶם מַה בֶּצַע כִּי נַהֲרֹג וְכוּ׳, הֲלֹא יָדַע הָאֱמֶת שֶׁכַּוָּנָתָם לְשָׁמַיִם לְפִי טָעוּתָם שֶׁרוֹצִים לַהֲרְגוֹ שֶׁלֹּא יַטְעֶה אוֹתָם אוֹ אֲחֵרִים מֵהָאֱמוּנָה הָאֲמִתִּית שֶׁקִּבְּלוּ מֵאֲבִיהֶם, אֲבָל עַל כָּל פָּנִים חַס וְשָׁלוֹם אֵין כַּוָּנָתָם כְּלָל בִּשְׁבִיל אֵיזֶה מָמוֹן וּבֶצַע.
pairs.en: And this is what Yehudah said to them: “What profit is there if we kill our brother,” etc., “Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites,” etc. And the matter is most astonishing: did it enter Yehudah’s mind that they wanted to kill Yosef for profit and money, so that he said to them, “What profit is there if we kill,” etc.? Did he not know the truth, that their intention was for Heaven, according to their error, that they wanted to kill him so that he would not mislead them or others away from the true faith they received from their father? But in any event, God forbid, their intention was not at all for any money and profit.

Did he not know the truth, that their intention was for Heaven, according to their error, that they wanted to kill him so that he would not mislead them or others away from the true faith they received from their father? But in any event, God forbid, their intention was not at all for any money and profit.

pairs.he: רַק יְהוּדָה רָמַז לָהֶם עִנְיָן הַנַּ״ל, מֵחֲמַת שֶׁלְּפִי דַּעְתְּכֶם רְצוֹנְכֶם לְבַעֲרוֹ כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יְקַלְקֵל אֶת הַדַּעַת הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁהִתְחִילוּ הָאָבוֹת לְהַמְשִׁיךְ בָּעוֹלָם. וַאֲזַי הוּכְלוּ אַתֶּם לְהַמְשִׁיךְ זֶה הַדַּעַת הַקָּדוֹשׁ, עַל כֵּן אָמַר לָהֶם מַה בֶּצַע וְכוּ׳ לְכוּ וְנִמְכְּרֶנּוּ וְכוּ׳, הַיְנוּ שֶׁלְּפִי זֶה טוֹב לְמָכְרוֹ וּלְקַבֵּל בַּעֲדוֹ מָמוֹן, וְאַתֶּם הַשְּׁבָטִים שֶׁכֻּלְּכֶם קְדוֹשִׁים, כְּשֶׁתְּקַבְּלוּ מָמוֹן בַּעֲדוֹ וּתְקַבְּלוּ עַל יְדֵי זֶה הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן שֶׁמֵּאִיר בְּהַמָּמוֹן כְּשֶׁמְּקַבְּלִים אוֹתוֹ כָּרָאוּי וַאֲזַי תְּתַקְּנוּ הַדָּבָר כָּרָאוּי.
pairs.en: Rather, Yehudah hinted to them at the aforesaid matter: since, according to your understanding, your wish was to remove him so that he would not corrupt the holy knowledge that the forefathers began to draw into the world, and then you would be able to draw this holy knowledge, therefore he said to them, “What profit,” etc., “Come, let us sell him,” etc. That is, according to this it is good to sell him and receive money for him; and you, the tribes, who are all holy, when you receive money for him and thereby receive the illumination of will that shines in money when it is received properly, then you will rectify the matter properly.

pairs.he: כִּי מַה שֶּׁלְּפִי דַּעְתְּכֶם רָצָה יוֹסֵף לִפְגֹּם בְּהַדַּעַת הַנַּ״ל שֶׁהוּא פְּגַם הָרָצוֹן הַמֵּאִיר בְּהַמָּמוֹן שֶׁהוּא פְּגַם הַמַּלְכוּת וְהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה, עַל כֵּן טוֹב שֶׁתִּמְכְּרוּ אוֹתוֹ וּבָזֶה תַּפִּילוּ אוֹתוֹ מֵהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה וְשׁוּב לֹא יוּכַל לִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיכֶם בְּמַלְכוּת דְּסִטְרָא אַחֲרָא חַס וְשָׁלוֹם וּלְקַלְקֵל אֶת הַדַּעַת עַל יְדֵי רִבּוּי הָעֲשִׁירוּת כְּמוֹ יָרָבְעָם וְכוּ׳, אַדְּרַבָּא, תְּקַבְּלוּ דְּמֵי מְכִירָתוֹ וְאָז תּוּכְלוּ לְקַבֵּל וּלְהַעֲלוֹת הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן שֶׁנָּפַל אֵצֶל יוֹסֵף לְפִי טָעוּתָם, וְאַתֶּם תַּעֲלוּ אוֹתוֹ וּתְקַבְּלוּ הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן עַל יְדֵי הַמָּמוֹן שֶׁתְּקַבְּלוּ בִּדְמֵי מְכִירָתוֹ.
pairs.en: For what, according to your understanding, Yosef wanted to blemish in the aforesaid knowledge is a blemish in the will that shines in money, which is a blemish in kingship and rule. Therefore it is good for you to sell him, and by this you will cast him down from rule, and he will no longer be able to reign over you with the kingship of the sitra achra, God forbid, and to corrupt knowledge through an abundance of wealth, like Yeravam, etc. On the contrary, you will receive the money from his sale, and then you will be able to receive and raise the illumination of will that fell with Yosef, according to their error; and you will raise it and receive the illumination of will through the money that you will receive as the price of his sale.

segments.he:
קלא.

במגלה עמוקות (על ואתחנן אופן רנ״ב): זה ענין מכירת יוסף שראו השבטים שעתיד ירבעם לעמוד ממנו שהוא יהיה בסוד מרכבה טמאה, שהיא ׳כלב רע׳ ושמו של ירבעם מוכיח עליו שכן ירבעם עולה בחושבן ׳מרכבה טמאה׳ ׳כלב רע׳ ולכן אמרו ז״ל במדרש על פסוק ׳והנה בעל החלומות׳ שאמרו זה עתיד להשיאנו לבעלים ועתה נהרוג את הכלבים מדה כנגד מדה. וז״ש הפסוק וראו אותו מרחוק ויתנכלו אותו להמיתו, ר״ל שראו מה שלעתיד יצא מאתו, שירבעם יצא ממנו, ועתה לכו ונהרגהו, ר״ל עכשיו נהרגהו קודם שיצא ממנו. ע״כ.
segments.en:
131.

In Megaleh Amukos (on Vaeschanan, exposition 252): This is the matter of the sale of Yosef: the tribes saw that Yeravam was destined to arise from him, who would be in the mystery of an impure chariot, which is an ‘evil dog’; and Yeravam’s name demonstrates this concerning him, for Yeravam amounts, in numerical reckoning, to ‘impure chariot,’ ‘evil dog.’ And therefore our Sages, of blessed memory, said in the Midrash on the verse ‘And behold, the master of dreams’ that they said: This one is destined to lead us astray to the baals, and now let us kill the dogs, measure for measure. And this is what the verse says: “And they saw him from afar, and they conspired against him to put him to death,” meaning that they saw what would come forth from him in the future, that Yeravam would come forth from him; “and now, let us go and kill him,” meaning: Now let us kill him before he comes forth from him. Thus far.

מכירת יוסף ומחלוקת השבטים עליו נמשך ממעשה החילוף של בן המלך

״וַיִּמְכְּרוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים״ (ל״ז, כח) עַל פִּי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה שֶׁל הַבֶּן מֶלֶךְ שֶׁנִּתְחַלֵּף בְּבֶן הַשִּׁפְחָה וְכוּ׳, עַיֵּן שָׁם כָּל הַמַּעֲשֶׂה כֻּלָּהּ מֵרֹאשָׁהּ לְסוֹפָהּ וְהוּא פֶּלֶא, וְכוּ׳. וְהִנֵּה עִנְיַן הַמַּעֲשֶׂה נוֹרָאָה הַנַּ״ל שֶׁל הַבֶּן מֶלֶךְ שֶׁנִּתְחַלֵּף שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִדְמָה לְהָעוֹלָם שֶׁהוּא בֶּן הַשִּׁפְחָה, וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה הִתְגַּבֵּר עָלָיו הָעֶבֶד הַבֶּן הַשִּׁפְחָה בֶּאֱמֶת וְגֵרְשׁוֹ מִמְּקוֹמוֹ. וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נָפַל הַבֶּן הַמֶּלֶךְ הָאֱמֶת בְּדַעְתּוֹ עַד שֶׁבָּא לִידֵי רָעוֹת וְכוּ׳ וְכוּ׳.

כָּל עִנְיָן הַזֶּה מְבֹאָר וּמוּבָן הֵיטֵב לַמֵּבִין מְעַט, שֶׁזֶּה סוֹד כָּל עִנְיַן גָּלוּת יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁהֵם מְגֹרָשִׁים מֵאַרְצָם וּמִמְּקוֹמָם. וְהֵם כַּצִּפּוֹר נוֹדֶדֶת מִן קִנָּהּ כֵּן אִישׁ נוֹדֵד מִמְּקוֹמוֹ, וּמְפֻזָּרִים בֵּין הַגּוֹיִם. וְהַמַּלְכוּת וְהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה הִיא אֶצְלָם וְיִשְׂרָאֵל נֶחְשָׁבִים בַּעֲווֹנוֹתֵינוּ הָרַבִּים כַּעֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחוֹת, שֶׁכָּל זֶה נִמְשָׁךְ מִבְּחִינַת הַחִלּוּפִין הַנַּ״ל שֶׁל הַבֶּן מֶלֶךְ שֶׁנִּתְחַלֵּף וְכוּ׳ שֶׁזֶּה סוֹד בְּחִינַת הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת שֶׁשָּׁם נִתְחַלְּפִין לִפְעָמִים הַנְּשָׁמוֹת, כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְנוּ מִפִּיו הַקָּדוֹשׁ בְּפֵרוּשׁ קֹדֶם שֶׁסִּפֵּר הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הַנַּ״ל שֶׁדִּבֵּר מִקֹּדֶם מֵעִנְיַן הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת שֶׁנִּתְחַלְּפִין הַנְּשָׁמוֹת חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, וְאַחַר כָּךְ עַל עִנְיָן זֶה סִפֵּר הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הַנַּ״ל. וְאָמַר שֶׁכְּבָר פַּעַם אַחַת הָיָה מַעֲשֶׂה כָּזֹאת וְהִתְחִיל לְסַפֵּר כָּל הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הַנַּ״ל עַד שֶׁגְּמָרָהּ. וְנִמְצָא שֶׁהַמַּעֲשֶׂה הַנַּ״ל שֶׁל הַבֶּן מֶלֶךְ שֶׁנִּתְחַלֵּף, זֶה נִמְשָׁךְ מִבְּחִינַת הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת וְכוּ׳.

וְזֶה סוֹד כָּל גָּלוּת וְצָרוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּכְלָלִיּוּת וּבִפְרָטִיּוּת מַה שֶּׁעוֹבֵר עַל כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד. וְעִקַּר הוּא גָּלוּת וְצָרוֹת הַנֶּפֶשׁ מַה שֶּׁגָּלִינוּ בֵּין הָעַמִּים וְאָנוּ רְחוֹקִים מֵאָבִינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם וְכוּ׳, שֶׁכָּל זֶה נִמְשָׁךְ מִבְּחִינַת הַחִלּוּפִין הַנַּ״ל שֶׁל הַבֶּן מֶלֶךְ שֶׁנִּתְחַלֵּף, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת שֶׁזֶּה נִמְשָׁךְ מֵחֵטְא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן שֶׁאָכַל מֵעֵץ הַדַּעַת טוֹב וָרָע, שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה גָּרַם לְהִתְגַּבֵּר חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, בְּחִינַת לַהַט הַחֶרֶב הַמִּתְהַפֶּכֶת, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הִתְהַפְּכוּת מִמַּטֶּה לְנָחָשׁ וּמִנָּחָשׁ לְמַטֶּה, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת נְשָׁמוֹת הָעֲשׁוּקוֹת בְּטִיקְלָא בִּקְלִפַּת נֹגַהּ הַמִּתְגַּלְגְּלִין בְּגִלְגּוּלָא וְכוּ׳. וּמִשָּׁם נִמְשָׁכִין בְּחִינַת הַחִלּוּפִין וְהַתְּמוּרוֹת שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם שֶׁמִּשָּׁם עִקַּר אֲחִיזַת הַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא חַס וְשָׁלוֹם.

עַד שֶׁנִּמְשָׁכִין הַשִּׁנּוּיִים וְהַחִלּוּפִים בֵּין יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעַצְמָן שֶׁהָעוֹלָם מִתְנַהֵג בְּהֵפֶךְ מִן הָאֱמֶת, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (ישעיה ג׳) ״יְרַהֲבוּ הַנַּעַר בַּזָּקֵן וְהַנִּקְלֶה בַּנִּכְבָּד״. שֶׁהַיְרֵאִים וְהַכְּשֵׁרִים בֶּאֱמֶת מְבֻזִּים מְאֹד, וְהַקַּלִּים וְהַפְּחוּתִים מִתְגַּבְּרִים לִמְשֹׁל עֲלֵיהֶם. וְכַיּוֹצֵא בָּזֶה הַרְבֵּה הֲפָכִים בְּלִי שִׁעוּר שֶׁמִּתְנַהֵג בָּעוֹלָם שֶׁלֹּא כָּרָאוּי בֶּאֱמֶת.

וְגַם בִּימֵי הַתַּנָּאִים וְהָאֲמוֹרָאִים הָיָה מִתְנַהֵג מֵעֵין זֶה קְצָת כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בבא בתרא דף י׳) ״עוֹלָם הָפוּךְ רָאִיתִי עֶלְיוֹנִים לְמַטָּה וְתַחְתּוֹנִים לְמַעְלָה״ וְכוּ׳. מִכָּל שֶׁכֵּן עַכְשָׁו שֶׁהִתְגַּבֵּר הַשֶּׁקֶר בְּיוֹתֵר בְּלִי שִׁעוּר, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב ״וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ אֱמֶת אַרְצָה״. כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (סוטה מט) בְּעִקְבְתָא מְשִׁיחָא חֻצְפָּא יִסְגָּא וְהָאֱמֶת תְּהֵא נֶעְדֶּרֶת, שֶׁנַּעֲשֶׂה הָאֱמֶת עֲדָרִים עֲדָרִים. וְכָל אֶחָד אוֹמֵר שֶׁאֶצְלוֹ הָאֱמֶת וְכוּ׳.

וְכָל זֶה נִמְשָׁךְ מִבְּחִינַת הַחִלּוּף שֶׁל בֶּן הַמֶּלֶךְ הַנַּ״ל שֶׁלָּקַח בֶּן הַשִּׁפְחָה הַמְּלוּכָה לְעַצְמוֹ. וְאֶת בֶּן הַמֶּלֶךְ גֵּרֵשׁ וְכוּ׳. שֶׁמִּשָּׁם נִמְשָׁךְ בְּחִינַת חִלּוּף הַמְּלוּכָה עַכְשָׁו בִּכְלָלִיּוּת שֶׁהָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים יֵשׁ לָהֶם כָּל הַמְּלוּכָה וְהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל מְבֻזִּים וּשְׁפָלִים בַּגָּלוּת וְעַבְדוּת וּמְגֹרָשִׁים מֵאַרְצָם כַּנַּ״ל. וְגַם בֵּין יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעַצְמָן הָרְשָׁעִים וְהָאַפִּיקוֹרְסִים יֵשׁ לָהֶם מֶמְשָׁלָה וַעֲשִׁירוּת גָּדוֹל וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַכְּשֵׁרִים עֲנִיִּים וְדַלִּים וּמְבֻזִּים וּמַכְבִּידִים עֲלֵיהֶם עֹל הַמְּדִינוֹת, וְהֵם לְלַעַג וּלְקֶלֶס. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ, וּבְגָלוּתָא בַּתְרָאָה אָנוּן עֵרֶב רַב אָנוּן רֵישָׁא עַמָּא וְיִרְאֵי חַטָּא מְאִסֵי וְחַשּׁוּבִים כִּכְלָבִים בֵּינֵיהֶם, עַיֵּן שָׁם בר״מ וְכוּ׳.

וַאֲפִלּוּ בֵּין בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַכְּשֵׁרִים בְּעַצְמָן יֵשׁ מַחֲלֹקֶת וְעִרְבּוּבְיָא גְּדוֹלָה עַד שֶׁאֵין יוֹדְעִין הֵיכָן הָאֱמֶת, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר רַבֵּנוּ ז״ל (ליקוטי תנינא סימן מ״ד) שֶׁהַבַּעַל דָּבָר הִנִּיחַ עַצְמוֹ עַל זֶה מְאֹד עַכְשָׁו לְבַלְבֵּל אֶת הָעוֹלָם וְכוּ׳. וְהִכְנִיס מַחֲלֹקֶת בֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים וְהֵקִים בָּעוֹלָם מְפֻרְסָמִים הַרְבֵּה שֶׁל שֶׁקֶר. וְגַם בֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים הָאֲמִתִּיִּים הִכְנִיס מַחֲלֹקֶת גָּדוֹל עַד שֶׁאֵין אֶחָד יוֹדֵעַ הֵיכָן הָאֱמֶת, עַל כֵּן צְרִיכִין לְבַקֵּשׁ מְאֹד מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ לִזְכּוֹת לְהִתְקָרֵב לְצַדִּיקִים אֲמִתִּיִּים וְכוּ׳, עַיֵּן שָׁם. וְכָל זֶה נִמְשָׁךְ וְנִשְׁתַּלְשֵׁל מִבְּחִינַת הַחִלּוּף הַנַּ״ל, שֶׁמִּשָּׁם כָּל הַחִלּוּפִים וְהַשִּׁנּוּיִים שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם שֶׁרוֹצִים לְהַחֲלִיף הָאֱמֶת לְשֶׁקֶר חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, וְהַשֶּׁקֶר לֶאֱמֶת.

וְזֶה בְּחִינַת מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף, בְּחִינַת (תהלים ק״ה) לְעֶבֶד נִמְכַּר יוֹסֵף, שֶׁאָנוּ קוֹרִין בְּפַרְשִׁיּוֹת שֶׁל מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף וּגְאֻלָּתוֹ אַחַר כָּךְ בִּימֵי חֲנֻכָּה. שֶׁאָז קוֹרִין עַל פִּי רֹב פָּרָשַׁת מִקֵּץ וְלִפְעָמִים פָּרָשַׁת וַיֵּשֶׁב. שֶׁאֵלּוּ הַפַּרְשִׁיּוֹת מְדַבְּרִים מֵעִנְיַן יוֹסֵף, כִּי כָּל עִנְיַן מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף הוּא נִמְשָׁךְ מִסּוֹד הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הַנַּ״ל שֶׁל הַבֶּן הַמֶּלֶךְ שֶׁנִּתְחַלֵּף וְכוּ׳. שֶׁמִּשָּׁם כָּל הַבִּלְבּוּלִים וְהַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם, מַה שֶּׁהָרְשָׁעִים עוֹמְדִים כְּנֶגֶד הַצַּדִּיקִים, וְהָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים כְּנֶגֶד כְּלַל יִשְׂרָאֵל. וְכָל אֵלּוּ הַחוֹלְקִים עַל הָאֱמֶת נִדְמֶה לָהֶם וּלְהָעוֹלָם שֶׁהֵם הָעִקָּר, וְהָאֵלּוּ לָהֶם מַגִּיעַ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, הַמְּלוּכָה וְהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם וּמִתְגָּאִים וּמִשְׂתָּרְרִים עַל עַם דַּל הַכְּשֵׁרִים בְּחִנָּם, וְרוֹצִים לְגָרְשָׁם מִן הָעוֹלָם חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, ה׳ לֹא יַעַזְבֵנוּ בְיָדָם. וְכָל זֶה נִמְשָׁךְ מִבְּחִינַת הַחִלּוּף הַנַּ״ל, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת, שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה הָעוֹלָם הָפוּךְ עֶלְיוֹנִים לְמַטָּה וְתַחְתּוֹנִים לְמַעְלָה.

וְכָל כָּךְ נִתְבַּלְבֵּל הָעוֹלָם עַד שֶׁאֲפִלּוּ בֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים הָאֲמִתִּיִּים וְהַכְּשֵׁרִים בְּעַצְמָן נָפַל מַחֲלֹקֶת וּבִלְבּוּל גָּדוֹל, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב וְכוּ׳ שֶׁבֶּן דָּוִד בָּא קַטֵּגוֹרְיָא בֵּין תַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים. שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת מַחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבֵּין יוֹסֵף וְאֶחָיו, שֶׁכֻּלָּם הָיוּ צַדִּיקִים גְּדוֹלִים, וְאַף עַל פִּי כֵן הָיָה בֵּינֵיהֶם מַחֲלֹקֶת גָּדוֹל עַד שֶׁמָּכְרוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף לְעֶבֶד, כִּי אָמְרוּ שֶׁאֵינוֹ אִישׁ אֱמֶת וְלֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ לַחֲלוֹמוֹתָיו וְלִדְבָרָיו, כִּי סָבְרוּ שֶׁהוּא שֶׁקֶר חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, וְעַל כֵּן מְכָרוּהוּ לְעֶבֶד, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת שֶׁקֶר כַּנַּ״ל. וְהֶחֱלִיפוּ הַשִּׁיטָּה כְּאִלּוּ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, נִשְׁמָתוֹ הוּא מִבְּחִינַת עֶבֶד חַס וְשָׁלוֹם.

וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִתְגַּלְגֵּל הַדָּבָר וְיָרְדוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְמִצְרַיִם וְהָיוּ שָׁם עֲבָדִים לְפַרְעֹה בְּמִצְרַיִם, שֶׁכָּל זֶה הָיָה לְבָרֵר נִשְׁמָתָם מִבְּחִינַת עַבְדוּת שֶׁנֶּאֱחָז בָּהֶם עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת, עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת הַחִלּוּף הַנַּ״ל שֶׁנֶּאֱחָז בָּהֶם עַל יְדֵי חֵטְא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן שֶׁעִקַּר גָּלוּת מִצְרַיִם הָיָה בִּשְׁבִיל זֶה כַּיָּדוּעַ.

כִּי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הַנַּ״ל הִיא כּוֹלֶלֶת כָּל הַתּוֹרָה כֻּלָּהּ וְכָל הַדּוֹרוֹת כֻּלָּם, כָּל מַה שֶּׁעָבַר מִיּוֹם בְּרֹא אֱלֹקִים אָדָם עַל הָאָרֶץ וַיֶּחֱטָא וַיֹּאכַל מֵעֵץ הַדַּעַת טוֹב וָרָע וְגָרַם הִתְגַּבְּרוּת לַהַט הַחֶרֶב הַמִּתְהַפֶּכֶת, בְּחִינַת הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת כַּנַּ״ל. שֶׁמִּשָּׁם נִמְשָׁךְ כָּל הַגָּלוּת שֶׁמִּתְגַּבֵּר בְּכָל פַּעַם בֶּן הַשִּׁפְחָה עַל בֶּן הַמֶּלֶךְ כַּנַּ״ל. עַד שֶׁגַּם בֵּין יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעַצְמָן וַאֲפִלּוּ בֵּין הַתַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים בְּעַצְמָן נַעֲשָׂה מַחֲלֹקֶת, שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבֵּין יוֹסֵף וְאֶחָיו וּבֵין שָׁאוּל וְדָוִד וְכַיּוֹצֵא בָּהֶם, כִּי אֵין יוֹדְעִין בְּבֵרוּר הֵיכָן נְקֻדַּת הָאֱמֶת, כִּי בְּכָל דּוֹר יֵשׁ כַּמָּה צַדִּיקִים אֲמִתִּיִּים, אֲבָל יֵשׁ אֱמֶת לְמַעְלָה מֵאֱמֶת, כִּי בְּוַדַּאי אֵין מַדְרֵגוֹת כָּל הַצַּדִּיקִים שָׁוִין. וְכָל מַה שֶּׁמַּדְרֵגַת הַצַּדִּיק גָּדוֹל יוֹתֵר הָאֱמֶת שֶׁלּוֹ גָּדוֹל וּמְבֹרָר יוֹתֵר, כִּי עִקַּר הוּא הָאֱמֶת עַד שֶׁיֵּשׁ בְּכָל דּוֹר צַדִּיק אֲמִתִּי, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת נְקֻדַּת הָאֱמֶת שֶׁבֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים, אֲבָל מֵחֲמַת מְרִירַת הַגָּלוּת וְהִתְגַּבְּרוּת הַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא שֶׁמִּתְגַּבֵּר בְּחִינַת הַחִלּוּף וְהַשֶּׁקֶר שֶׁל הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת הַנַּ״ל, עַל יְדֵי זֶה קָשֶׁה מְאֹד מְאֹד לֵידַע הֵיכָן נְקֻדַּת הָאֱמֶת, עַד שֶׁעַל פִּי רֹב הַבַּעַל דָּבָר מִתְגָּרֶה בְּהַצַּדִּיקִים בְּעַצְמָן וּמַכְנִיס בֵּינֵיהֶם בְּעַצְמָן מַחֲלֹקֶת גָּדוֹל, כִּי הוּא מַכְנִיס בְּלֵב שְׁאָר הַצַּדִּיקִים כְּאִלּוּ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם זֶה הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת נְקֻדַּת הָאֱמֶת, כְּאִלּוּ הוּא נוֹטֶה חַס וְשָׁלוֹם מִדֶּרֶךְ הָאֱמֶת, עַד שֶׁמֵּסִית אוֹתָם שֶׁיַּחֲלֹקוּ עָלָיו לְשֵׁם שָׁמַיִם.

כְּמוֹ שֶׁמָּצִינוּ בְּכַמָּה דּוֹרוֹת, כְּמוֹ שָׁאוּל שֶׁרָדַף אֶת דָּוִד בְּחִנָּם. וְכֵן אֲחֵי יוֹסֵף שֶׁחָלְקוּ עָלָיו כָּל כָּךְ עַד שֶׁהִתִּירוּ אֶת דָּמוֹ. וּבְוַדַּאי כַּוָּנָתָם הָיָה לְשֵׁם שָׁמַיִם, כִּי סָבְרוּ שֶׁאֵינוֹ אִישׁ אֱמֶת וּמוֹצִיא דִבָּה וְכוּ׳. וּכְמוֹ כֵן הָיָה בְּדוֹרוֹת שֶׁלְּפָנֵינוּ וּבִפְרָט בְּדוֹרוֹת הַלָּלוּ בְּעִקְבְתָא דִמְשִׁיחָא שֶׁהִתְגַּבֵּר הַשֶּׁקֶר מְאֹד עַד שֶׁגַּם בֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים וְהַכְּשֵׁרִים בְּעַצְמָן נָפַל מַחֲלֹקֶת גָּדוֹל וְאֵין יוֹדְעִים הֵיכָן נְקֻדַּת הָאֱמֶת וּצְרִיכִין לְהִתְפַּלֵּל לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁיִּזְכֶּה לִמְצֹא הָאֱמֶת לַאֲמִתּוֹ.

(הלכות ברכות השחר הלכה ג׳)
segments.en:
The sale of Yosef and the tribes’ controversy against him proceed from the story of the exchange of the king’s son.

“And they sold Yosef to the Ishmaelites” (37:28), according to the story of the king’s son who was exchanged with the maidservant’s son, etc.; see there the entire story, all of it from beginning to end, and it is a wonder, etc. And behold, [this is] the matter of the aforesaid awesome story of the king’s son who was exchanged, through which it seemed to the world that he was the maidservant’s son, and through this the slave, who truly was the maidservant’s son, prevailed over him and drove him from his place; and through this the true king’s son became downcast in his mind until he came to evil things, etc., etc.

This entire matter is explained and well understood by one who understands a little: this is the secret of the entire matter of Israel’s exile, for they are driven from their land and place. And they are “like a bird wandering from her nest, so is a man wandering from his place,” and scattered among the nations. And kingship and rule are with them, and Israel, through our many sins, are considered slaves and maidservants. All this proceeds from the aspect of the aforesaid exchanges of the king’s son who was exchanged, etc., which is the secret of the aspect of the Chambers of Exchanges, where souls are sometimes exchanged, as we heard explicitly from his holy mouth before he told the aforesaid story. He first spoke about the Chambers of Exchanges, where souls are exchanged, God forbid, and afterward concerning this matter he told the aforesaid story. And he said that once before such an incident had occurred, and began to tell the entire aforesaid story until he completed it. And thus the aforesaid story of the king’s son who was exchanged proceeds from the aspect of the Chambers of Exchanges, etc.

And this is the secret of all Israel’s exile and troubles in general and in particular, what passes over each and every individual. The principal thing is the exile and troubles of the soul, that we have been exiled among the peoples and are far from our Father in Heaven, etc. All this proceeds from the aforesaid exchanges of the king’s son who was exchanged, which is the aspect of the Chambers of Exchanges, proceeding from the sin of Adam the first man, who ate from the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil. Through this he caused the aspect of the flame of the turning sword to prevail, God forbid, which is the aspect of the Chambers of Exchanges, the aspect of the transformation from staff to serpent and from serpent to staff, the aspect of the souls oppressed in the balance, in the klipah of Nogah, revolving through reincarnation, etc. From there proceed the exchanges and substitutions in the world, from which the sitra achra principally takes hold, God forbid.

Until changes and exchanges are drawn among Israel themselves, so that the world conducts itself contrary to truth, as it is written (Yeshaya 3), “The youth shall act arrogantly toward the elder, and the dishonored toward the honored.” Those who are genuinely God-fearing and upright are greatly despised, and the frivolous and lowly gain strength to rule over them. And similarly there are many opposites beyond measure by which the world conducts itself not as is truly fitting.

And even in the days of the Tannaim and Amoraim matters were conducted somewhat in this manner, as it is written (Bava Basra, folio 10), “I saw an inverted world: those above below, and those below above,” etc. All the more now, when falsehood has grown exceedingly strong beyond measure, as it is written, “And it cast truth to the ground.” And [this is] as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said (Sotah 49): in the footsteps of the Messiah insolence will increase, and truth will be absent—truth becomes flocks, flocks, and everyone says that truth is with him, etc.

And all this proceeds from the exchange of the aforesaid king’s son, that the maidservant’s son took kingship for himself and drove out the king’s son, etc. From there proceeds the exchange of kingship now in general: the idolaters possess all kingship and rule, while Israel are despised and lowly in exile and servitude and driven from their land, as above. And even among Israel themselves the wicked and heretics have rule and great wealth, while the upright children of Israel are poor, needy and despised, and they burden them with the yoke of the states, and they are an object of mockery and derision. And as it is written in the holy Zohar, in the final exile those of the mixed multitude are the heads of the people, and those who fear sin shall be despised and are considered like dogs among them; see there in Raaya Mehemna, etc.

And even among the upright children of Israel themselves there is great controversy and confusion, until people do not know where truth is, as Rabbainu, of blessed memory, said (Likutay Tinyana, section 44): the adversary has applied himself very greatly to this now, to confuse the world, etc., and has introduced controversy among the tzaddikim and established many false renowned figures in the world. And even among the true tzaddikim he has introduced great controversy until no one knows where truth is. Therefore one must ask Hashem, blessed be He, very earnestly to merit drawing close to true tzaddikim, etc.; see there. And all this proceeds and unfolds from the aforesaid exchange, from which all the exchanges and changes in the world proceed, seeking to exchange truth for falsehood, God forbid, and falsehood for truth.

And this is the aspect of the sale of Yosef, the aspect of (Tehillim 105), “Yosef was sold as a slave,” which we read in the portions concerning the sale of Yosef and his redemption afterward during the days of Chanukah. Then we generally read parsha Mikaitz and sometimes parsha Vayaishev, for these portions speak about Yosef. For the entire matter of Yosef’s sale proceeds from the secret of the aforesaid story of the king’s son who was exchanged, etc., from which all the confusions and controversy in the world proceed: that the wicked stand against the tzaddikim, and the idolaters against all Israel. And to all these who dispute truth, and to the world, it seems that they are the principal ones, and that to these belongs, God forbid, kingship and rule from Heaven; and they arrogantly lord it over the upright, poor people for no cause and wish to drive them from the world, God forbid. Hashem will not abandon us into their hands. And all this proceeds from the aforesaid exchange, which is the aspect of the Chambers of Exchanges, through which the world is inverted, those above below and those below above.

And the world became so confused that even among the true tzaddikim and upright people themselves great controversy and confusion arose, as it is written, etc., that when the son of Dovid comes, accusation [arises] among Torah scholars. This is the aspect of the controversy between Yosef and his brothers, all of whom were great tzaddikim, yet nevertheless there was great controversy among them, until they sold Yosef as a slave. For they said that he was not a man of truth and did not believe his dreams and his words, for they considered him falsehood, God forbid; and therefore they sold him as a slave, which is the aspect of falsehood, as above. And they exchanged the order, as though, God forbid, his soul were of the aspect of a slave, God forbid.

And through this the matter unfolded, and our forefathers descended to Egypt and were slaves there to Pharaoh in Egypt; all this was to refine their soul from the aspect of servitude that took hold of them through the Chambers of Exchanges, through the aforesaid exchange that took hold of them through the sin of Adam the first man; for the exile in Egypt was principally for this, as is known.

For the aforesaid story encompasses the whole Torah, all of it, and all generations, all of them, everything that has passed since the day God created man upon the earth and he sinned and ate from the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil and caused the flame of the turning sword to prevail, the aspect of the Chambers of Exchanges, as above. From there proceeds all the exile, for each time the maidservant’s son prevails over the king’s son, as above, until controversy arises even among Israel themselves and even among the Torah scholars themselves. This is the aspect of the controversy between Yosef and his brothers and between Shaul and Dovid and the like, for people do not know clearly where the point of truth is. For in every generation there are several true tzaddikim, but there is truth above truth, for certainly the levels of all the tzaddikim are not equal. And the greater the tzaddik’s level, the greater and clearer his truth, for the principal thing is truth, until in every generation there is a true tzaddik who is the aspect of the point of truth among the tzaddikim. But because of the bitterness of exile and the ascendency of the sitra achra, whereby the aspect of the exchange and falsehood of the aforesaid Chambers of Exchanges prevails, through this it is very, very difficult to know where the point of truth is, until generally the adversary provokes the tzaddikim themselves and puts great controversy among them themselves. For he puts into the hearts of the other tzaddikim [the notion] that this true tzaddik who is the aspect of the point of truth, God forbid, is supposedly deviating, God forbid, from the way of truth, until he incites them to dispute him for the sake of Heaven.

As we find in several generations, like Shaul, who persecuted Dovid without cause, and likewise Yosef’s brothers, who disputed him so greatly that they permitted his blood [to be shed]. And certainly their intention was for the sake of Heaven, for they considered him not a man of truth and one who brought an evil report, etc. And likewise it was in the generations before us, particularly in these generations, in the footsteps of the Messiah, when falsehood has grown very strong, until great controversy has arisen even among the tzaddikim and upright people themselves, and people do not know where the point of truth is. And one must pray to Hashem, blessed be He, that one merit to find truth in its utmost truth.

(Halachos of the Morning Blessings, Halacha 3)

pairs.he: וְזֶה סוֹד כָּל גָּלוּת וְצָרוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּכְלָלִיּוּת וּבִפְרָטִיּוּת מַה שֶּׁעוֹבֵר עַל כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד. וְעִקַּר הוּא גָּלוּת וְצָרוֹת הַנֶּפֶשׁ מַה שֶּׁגָּלִינוּ בֵּין הָעַמִּים וְאָנוּ רְחוֹקִים מֵאָבִינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם וְכוּ׳, שֶׁכָּל זֶה נִמְשָׁךְ מִבְּחִינַת הַחִלּוּפִין הַנַּ״ל שֶׁל הַבֶּן מֶלֶךְ שֶׁנִּתְחַלֵּף, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת שֶׁזֶּה נִמְשָׁךְ מֵחֵטְא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן שֶׁאָכַל מֵעֵץ הַדַּעַת טוֹב וָרָע, שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה גָּרַם לְהִתְגַּבֵּר חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, בְּחִינַת לַהַט הַחֶרֶב הַמִּתְהַפֶּכֶת, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הִתְהַפְּכוּת מִמַּטֶּה לְנָחָשׁ וּמִנָּחָשׁ לְמַטֶּה, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת נְשָׁמוֹת הָעֲשׁוּקוֹת בְּטִיקְלָא בִּקְלִפַּת נֹגַהּ הַמִּתְגַּלְגְּלִין בְּגִלְגּוּלָא וְכוּ׳. וּמִשָּׁם נִמְשָׁכִין בְּחִינַת הַחִלּוּפִין וְהַתְּמוּרוֹת שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם שֶׁמִּשָּׁם עִקַּר אֲחִיזַת הַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא חַס וְשָׁלוֹם.
