And similarly there are many opposites beyond measure by which the world conducts itself not as is truly fitting.

qualifiedAfter.en: Until changes and exchanges are drawn among Israel themselves, so that the world conducts itself contrary to truth, as it is written (Yeshaya 3), “The youth shall act arrogantly toward the elder, and the dishonored toward the honored.” Those who are genuinely God-fearing and upright are greatly despised, and the frivolous and lowly gain strength to rule over them. And similarly there are many opposites beyond measure by which the world conducts itself not as is truly fitting.

pairs.he: וְגַם בִּימֵי הַתַּנָּאִים וְהָאֲמוֹרָאִים הָיָה מִתְנַהֵג מֵעֵין זֶה קְצָת כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בבא בתרא דף י׳) ״עוֹלָם הָפוּךְ רָאִיתִי עֶלְיוֹנִים לְמַטָּה וְתַחְתּוֹנִים לְמַעְלָה״ וְכוּ׳. מִכָּל שֶׁכֵּן עַכְשָׁו שֶׁהִתְגַּבֵּר הַשֶּׁקֶר בְּיוֹתֵר בְּלִי שִׁעוּר, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב ״וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ אֱמֶת אַרְצָה״. כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (סוטה מט) בְּעִקְבְתָא מְשִׁיחָא חֻצְפָּא יִסְגָּא וְהָאֱמֶת תְּהֵא נֶעְדֶּרֶת, שֶׁנַּעֲשֶׂה הָאֱמֶת עֲדָרִים עֲדָרִים. וְכָל אֶחָד אוֹמֵר שֶׁאֶצְלוֹ הָאֱמֶת וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: And even in the days of the Tannaim and Amoraim matters were conducted somewhat in this manner, as it is written (Bava Basra, folio 10), “I saw an inverted world: those above below, and those below above,” etc. All the more now, when falsehood has grown exceedingly strong beyond measure, as it is written, “And it cast truth to the ground.” And [this is] as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said (Sotah 49): in the footsteps of the Messiah insolence will increase, and truth will be absent—truth becomes flocks, flocks, and everyone says that truth is with him, etc.

qualifiedAfter.en: And even in the days of the Tannaim and Amoraim matters were conducted somewhat in this manner, as it is written (Bava Basra, folio 10), “I saw an inverted world: those above below, and those below above,” etc. All the more now, when falsehood has grown exceedingly strong beyond measure, as it is written, “And it cast truth to the ground.” And [this is] as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said (Sotah 49): in the footsteps of the Messiah insolence will increase, and truth will be absent—truth becomes flocks, flocks, and everyone says that truth is with him, etc.

pairs.he: וְכָל זֶה נִמְשָׁךְ מִבְּחִינַת הַחִלּוּף שֶׁל בֶּן הַמֶּלֶךְ הַנַּ״ל שֶׁלָּקַח בֶּן הַשִּׁפְחָה הַמְּלוּכָה לְעַצְמוֹ. וְאֶת בֶּן הַמֶּלֶךְ גֵּרֵשׁ וְכוּ׳. שֶׁמִּשָּׁם נִמְשָׁךְ בְּחִינַת חִלּוּף הַמְּלוּכָה עַכְשָׁו בִּכְלָלִיּוּת שֶׁהָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים יֵשׁ לָהֶם כָּל הַמְּלוּכָה וְהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה וְיִשְׂרָאֵל מְבֻזִּים וּשְׁפָלִים בַּגָּלוּת וְעַבְדוּת וּמְגֹרָשִׁים מֵאַרְצָם כַּנַּ״ל. וְגַם בֵּין יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעַצְמָן הָרְשָׁעִים וְהָאַפִּיקוֹרְסִים יֵשׁ לָהֶם מֶמְשָׁלָה וַעֲשִׁירוּת גָּדוֹל וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַכְּשֵׁרִים עֲנִיִּים וְדַלִּים וּמְבֻזִּים וּמַכְבִּידִים עֲלֵיהֶם עֹל הַמְּדִינוֹת, וְהֵם לְלַעַג וּלְקֶלֶס. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ, וּבְגָלוּתָא בַּתְרָאָה אָנוּן עֵרֶב רַב אָנוּן רֵישָׁא עַמָּא וְיִרְאֵי חַטָּא מְאִסֵי וְחַשּׁוּבִים כִּכְלָבִים בֵּינֵיהֶם, עַיֵּן שָׁם בר״מ וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: And all this proceeds from the exchange of the aforesaid king’s son, that the maidservant’s son took kingship for himself and drove out the king’s son, etc. From there proceeds the exchange of kingship now in general: the idolaters possess all kingship and rule, while Israel are despised and lowly in exile and servitude and driven from their land, as above. And even among Israel themselves the wicked and heretics have rule and great wealth, while the upright children of Israel are poor, needy and despised, and they burden them with the yoke of the states, and they are an object of mockery and derision. And as it is written in the holy Zohar, in the final exile those of the mixed multitude are the heads of the people, and those who fear sin shall be despised and are considered like dogs among them; see there in Raaya Mehemna, etc.

pairs.he: וַאֲפִלּוּ בֵּין בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַכְּשֵׁרִים בְּעַצְמָן יֵשׁ מַחֲלֹקֶת וְעִרְבּוּבְיָא גְּדוֹלָה עַד שֶׁאֵין יוֹדְעִין הֵיכָן הָאֱמֶת, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר רַבֵּנוּ ז״ל (ליקוטי תנינא סימן מ״ד) שֶׁהַבַּעַל דָּבָר הִנִּיחַ עַצְמוֹ עַל זֶה מְאֹד עַכְשָׁו לְבַלְבֵּל אֶת הָעוֹלָם וְכוּ׳. וְהִכְנִיס מַחֲלֹקֶת בֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים וְהֵקִים בָּעוֹלָם מְפֻרְסָמִים הַרְבֵּה שֶׁל שֶׁקֶר. וְגַם בֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים הָאֲמִתִּיִּים הִכְנִיס מַחֲלֹקֶת גָּדוֹל עַד שֶׁאֵין אֶחָד יוֹדֵעַ הֵיכָן הָאֱמֶת, עַל כֵּן צְרִיכִין לְבַקֵּשׁ מְאֹד מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ לִזְכּוֹת לְהִתְקָרֵב לְצַדִּיקִים אֲמִתִּיִּים וְכוּ׳, עַיֵּן שָׁם. וְכָל זֶה נִמְשָׁךְ וְנִשְׁתַּלְשֵׁל מִבְּחִינַת הַחִלּוּף הַנַּ״ל, שֶׁמִּשָּׁם כָּל הַחִלּוּפִים וְהַשִּׁנּוּיִים שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם שֶׁרוֹצִים לְהַחֲלִיף הָאֱמֶת לְשֶׁקֶר חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, וְהַשֶּׁקֶר לֶאֱמֶת.
pairs.en: And even among the upright children of Israel themselves there is great controversy and confusion, until people do not know where truth is, as Rabbainu, of blessed memory, said (Likutay Tinyana, section 44): the adversary has applied himself very greatly to this now, to confuse the world, etc., and has introduced controversy among the tzaddikim and established many false renowned figures in the world. And even among the true tzaddikim he has introduced great controversy until no one knows where truth is. Therefore one must ask Hashem, blessed be He, very earnestly to merit drawing close to true tzaddikim, etc.; see there. And all this proceeds and unfolds from the aforesaid exchange, from which all the exchanges and changes in the world proceed, seeking to exchange truth for falsehood, God forbid, and falsehood for truth.

pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף, בְּחִינַת (תהלים ק״ה) לְעֶבֶד נִמְכַּר יוֹסֵף, שֶׁאָנוּ קוֹרִין בְּפַרְשִׁיּוֹת שֶׁל מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף וּגְאֻלָּתוֹ אַחַר כָּךְ בִּימֵי חֲנֻכָּה. שֶׁאָז קוֹרִין עַל פִּי רֹב פָּרָשַׁת מִקֵּץ וְלִפְעָמִים פָּרָשַׁת וַיֵּשֶׁב. שֶׁאֵלּוּ הַפַּרְשִׁיּוֹת מְדַבְּרִים מֵעִנְיַן יוֹסֵף, כִּי כָּל עִנְיַן מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף הוּא נִמְשָׁךְ מִסּוֹד הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הַנַּ״ל שֶׁל הַבֶּן הַמֶּלֶךְ שֶׁנִּתְחַלֵּף וְכוּ׳. שֶׁמִּשָּׁם כָּל הַבִּלְבּוּלִים וְהַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם, מַה שֶּׁהָרְשָׁעִים עוֹמְדִים כְּנֶגֶד הַצַּדִּיקִים, וְהָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים כְּנֶגֶד כְּלַל יִשְׂרָאֵל. וְכָל אֵלּוּ הַחוֹלְקִים עַל הָאֱמֶת נִדְמֶה לָהֶם וּלְהָעוֹלָם שֶׁהֵם הָעִקָּר, וְהָאֵלּוּ לָהֶם מַגִּיעַ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, הַמְּלוּכָה וְהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם וּמִתְגָּאִים וּמִשְׂתָּרְרִים עַל עַם דַּל הַכְּשֵׁרִים בְּחִנָּם, וְרוֹצִים לְגָרְשָׁם מִן הָעוֹלָם חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, ה׳ לֹא יַעַזְבֵנוּ בְיָדָם. וְכָל זֶה נִמְשָׁךְ מִבְּחִינַת הַחִלּוּף הַנַּ״ל, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת, שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה הָעוֹלָם הָפוּךְ עֶלְיוֹנִים לְמַטָּה וְתַחְתּוֹנִים לְמַעְלָה.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of the sale of Yosef, the aspect of (Tehillim 105), “Yosef was sold as a slave,” which we read in the portions concerning the sale of Yosef and his redemption afterward during the days of Chanukah. Then we generally read parsha Mikaitz and sometimes parsha Vayaishev, for these portions speak about Yosef. For the entire matter of Yosef’s sale proceeds from the secret of the aforesaid story of the king’s son who was exchanged, etc., from which all the confusions and controversy in the world proceed: that the wicked stand against the tzaddikim, and the idolaters against all Israel. And to all these who dispute truth, and to the world, it seems that they are the principal ones, and that to these belongs, God forbid, kingship and rule from Heaven; and they arrogantly lord it over the upright, poor people for no cause and wish to drive them from the world, God forbid. Hashem will not abandon us into their hands. And all this proceeds from the aforesaid exchange, which is the aspect of the Chambers of Exchanges, through which the world is inverted, those above below and those below above.

pairs.he: וְכָל כָּךְ נִתְבַּלְבֵּל הָעוֹלָם עַד שֶׁאֲפִלּוּ בֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים הָאֲמִתִּיִּים וְהַכְּשֵׁרִים בְּעַצְמָן נָפַל מַחֲלֹקֶת וּבִלְבּוּל גָּדוֹל, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב וְכוּ׳ שֶׁבֶּן דָּוִד בָּא קַטֵּגוֹרְיָא בֵּין תַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים. שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת מַחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבֵּין יוֹסֵף וְאֶחָיו, שֶׁכֻּלָּם הָיוּ צַדִּיקִים גְּדוֹלִים, וְאַף עַל פִּי כֵן הָיָה בֵּינֵיהֶם מַחֲלֹקֶת גָּדוֹל עַד שֶׁמָּכְרוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף לְעֶבֶד, כִּי אָמְרוּ שֶׁאֵינוֹ אִישׁ אֱמֶת וְלֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ לַחֲלוֹמוֹתָיו וְלִדְבָרָיו, כִּי סָבְרוּ שֶׁהוּא שֶׁקֶר חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, וְעַל כֵּן מְכָרוּהוּ לְעֶבֶד, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת שֶׁקֶר כַּנַּ״ל. וְהֶחֱלִיפוּ הַשִּׁיטָּה כְּאִלּוּ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, נִשְׁמָתוֹ הוּא מִבְּחִינַת עֶבֶד חַס וְשָׁלוֹם.
pairs.en: And the world became so confused that even among the true tzaddikim and upright people themselves great controversy and confusion arose, as it is written, etc., that when the son of Dovid comes, accusation [arises] among Torah scholars. This is the aspect of the controversy between Yosef and his brothers, all of whom were great tzaddikim, yet nevertheless there was great controversy among them, until they sold Yosef as a slave. For they said that he was not a man of truth and did not believe his dreams and his words, for they considered him falsehood, God forbid; and therefore they sold him as a slave, which is the aspect of falsehood, as above. And they exchanged the order, as though, God forbid, his soul were of the aspect of a slave, God forbid.

pairs.he: וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִתְגַּלְגֵּל הַדָּבָר וְיָרְדוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְמִצְרַיִם וְהָיוּ שָׁם עֲבָדִים לְפַרְעֹה בְּמִצְרַיִם, שֶׁכָּל זֶה הָיָה לְבָרֵר נִשְׁמָתָם מִבְּחִינַת עַבְדוּת שֶׁנֶּאֱחָז בָּהֶם עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת, עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת הַחִלּוּף הַנַּ״ל שֶׁנֶּאֱחָז בָּהֶם עַל יְדֵי חֵטְא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן שֶׁעִקַּר גָּלוּת מִצְרַיִם הָיָה בִּשְׁבִיל זֶה כַּיָּדוּעַ.
pairs.en: And through this the matter unfolded, and our forefathers descended to Egypt and were slaves there to Pharaoh in Egypt; all this was to refine their soul from the aspect of servitude that took hold of them through the Chambers of Exchanges, through the aforesaid exchange that took hold of them through the sin of Adam the first man; for the exile in Egypt was principally for this, as is known.

pairs.he: כִּי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הַנַּ״ל הִיא כּוֹלֶלֶת כָּל הַתּוֹרָה כֻּלָּהּ וְכָל הַדּוֹרוֹת כֻּלָּם, כָּל מַה שֶּׁעָבַר מִיּוֹם בְּרֹא אֱלֹקִים אָדָם עַל הָאָרֶץ וַיֶּחֱטָא וַיֹּאכַל מֵעֵץ הַדַּעַת טוֹב וָרָע וְגָרַם הִתְגַּבְּרוּת לַהַט הַחֶרֶב הַמִּתְהַפֶּכֶת, בְּחִינַת הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת כַּנַּ״ל. שֶׁמִּשָּׁם נִמְשָׁךְ כָּל הַגָּלוּת שֶׁמִּתְגַּבֵּר בְּכָל פַּעַם בֶּן הַשִּׁפְחָה עַל בֶּן הַמֶּלֶךְ כַּנַּ״ל. עַד שֶׁגַּם בֵּין יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעַצְמָן וַאֲפִלּוּ בֵּין הַתַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים בְּעַצְמָן נַעֲשָׂה מַחֲלֹקֶת, שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבֵּין יוֹסֵף וְאֶחָיו וּבֵין שָׁאוּל וְדָוִד וְכַיּוֹצֵא בָּהֶם, כִּי אֵין יוֹדְעִין בְּבֵרוּר הֵיכָן נְקֻדַּת הָאֱמֶת, כִּי בְּכָל דּוֹר יֵשׁ כַּמָּה צַדִּיקִים אֲמִתִּיִּים, אֲבָל יֵשׁ אֱמֶת לְמַעְלָה מֵאֱמֶת, כִּי בְּוַדַּאי אֵין מַדְרֵגוֹת כָּל הַצַּדִּיקִים שָׁוִין. וְכָל מַה שֶּׁמַּדְרֵגַת הַצַּדִּיק גָּדוֹל יוֹתֵר הָאֱמֶת שֶׁלּוֹ גָּדוֹל וּמְבֹרָר יוֹתֵר, כִּי עִקַּר הוּא הָאֱמֶת עַד שֶׁיֵּשׁ בְּכָל דּוֹר צַדִּיק אֲמִתִּי, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת נְקֻדַּת הָאֱמֶת שֶׁבֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים, אֲבָל מֵחֲמַת מְרִירַת הַגָּלוּת וְהִתְגַּבְּרוּת הַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא שֶׁמִּתְגַּבֵּר בְּחִינַת הַחִלּוּף וְהַשֶּׁקֶר שֶׁל הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת הַנַּ״ל, עַל יְדֵי זֶה קָשֶׁה מְאֹד מְאֹד לֵידַע הֵיכָן נְקֻדַּת הָאֱמֶת, עַד שֶׁעַל פִּי רֹב הַבַּעַל דָּבָר מִתְגָּרֶה בְּהַצַּדִּיקִים בְּעַצְמָן וּמַכְנִיס בֵּינֵיהֶם בְּעַצְמָן מַחֲלֹקֶת גָּדוֹל, כִּי הוּא מַכְנִיס בְּלֵב שְׁאָר הַצַּדִּיקִים כְּאִלּוּ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם זֶה הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת נְקֻדַּת הָאֱמֶת, כְּאִלּוּ הוּא נוֹטֶה חַס וְשָׁלוֹם מִדֶּרֶךְ הָאֱמֶת, עַד שֶׁמֵּסִית אוֹתָם שֶׁיַּחֲלֹקוּ עָלָיו לְשֵׁם שָׁמַיִם.
pairs.en: For the aforesaid story encompasses the whole Torah, all of it, and all generations, all of them, everything that has passed since the day God created man upon the earth and he sinned and ate from the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil and caused the flame of the turning sword to prevail, the aspect of the Chambers of Exchanges, as above. From there proceeds all the exile, for each time the maidservant’s son prevails over the king’s son, as above, until controversy arises even among Israel themselves and even among the Torah scholars themselves. This is the aspect of the controversy between Yosef and his brothers and between Shaul and Dovid and the like, for people do not know clearly where the point of truth is. For in every generation there are several true tzaddikim, but there is truth above truth, for certainly the levels of all the tzaddikim are not equal. And the greater the tzaddik’s level, the greater and clearer his truth, for the principal thing is truth, until in every generation there is a true tzaddik who is the aspect of the point of truth among the tzaddikim. But because of the bitterness of exile and the ascendency of the sitra achra, whereby the aspect of the exchange and falsehood of the aforesaid Chambers of Exchanges prevails, through this it is very, very difficult to know where the point of truth is, until generally the adversary provokes the tzaddikim themselves and puts great controversy among them themselves. For he puts into the hearts of the other tzaddikim [the notion] that this true tzaddik who is the aspect of the point of truth, God forbid, is supposedly deviating, God forbid, from the way of truth, until he incites them to dispute him for the sake of Heaven.

qualifiedAfter.en: For the aforesaid story encompasses the whole Torah, all of it, and all generations, all of them, everything that has passed since the day God created man upon the earth and he sinned and ate from the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil and caused the flame of the turning sword to prevail, the aspect of the Chambers of Exchanges, as above. From there proceeds all the exile, for each time the maidservant’s son prevails over the king’s son, as above, until controversy arises even among Israel themselves and even among the Torah scholars themselves. This is the aspect of the controversy between Yosef and his brothers and between Shaul and Dovid and the like, for people do not know clearly where the point of truth is. But because of the bitterness of exile and the ascendency of the sitra achra, whereby the aspect of the exchange and falsehood of the aforesaid Chambers of Exchanges prevails, through this it is very, very difficult to know where the point of truth is, until generally the adversary provokes the tzaddikim themselves and puts great controversy among them themselves. For he puts into the hearts of the other tzaddikim [the notion] that this true tzaddik who is the aspect of the point of truth, God forbid, is supposedly deviating, God forbid, from the way of truth, until he incites them to dispute him for the sake of Heaven.

pairs.he: כְּמוֹ שֶׁמָּצִינוּ בְּכַמָּה דּוֹרוֹת, כְּמוֹ שָׁאוּל שֶׁרָדַף אֶת דָּוִד בְּחִנָּם. וְכֵן אֲחֵי יוֹסֵף שֶׁחָלְקוּ עָלָיו כָּל כָּךְ עַד שֶׁהִתִּירוּ אֶת דָּמוֹ. וּבְוַדַּאי כַּוָּנָתָם הָיָה לְשֵׁם שָׁמַיִם, כִּי סָבְרוּ שֶׁאֵינוֹ אִישׁ אֱמֶת וּמוֹצִיא דִבָּה וְכוּ׳. וּכְמוֹ כֵן הָיָה בְּדוֹרוֹת שֶׁלְּפָנֵינוּ וּבִפְרָט בְּדוֹרוֹת הַלָּלוּ בְּעִקְבְתָא דִמְשִׁיחָא שֶׁהִתְגַּבֵּר הַשֶּׁקֶר מְאֹד עַד שֶׁגַּם בֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים וְהַכְּשֵׁרִים בְּעַצְמָן נָפַל מַחֲלֹקֶת גָּדוֹל וְאֵין יוֹדְעִים הֵיכָן נְקֻדַּת הָאֱמֶת וּצְרִיכִין לְהִתְפַּלֵּל לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁיִּזְכֶּה לִמְצֹא הָאֱמֶת לַאֲמִתּוֹ.
pairs.en: As we find in several generations, like Shaul, who persecuted Dovid without cause, and likewise Yosef’s brothers, who disputed him so greatly that they permitted his blood [to be shed]. And certainly their intention was for the sake of Heaven, for they considered him not a man of truth and one who brought an evil report, etc. And likewise it was in the generations before us, particularly in these generations, in the footsteps of the Messiah, when falsehood has grown very strong, until great controversy has arisen even among the tzaddikim and upright people themselves, and people do not know where the point of truth is. And one must pray to Hashem, blessed be He, that one merit to find truth in its utmost truth.

qualifiedAfter.en: As we find in several generations, like Shaul, who persecuted Dovid without cause, and likewise Yosef’s brothers, who disputed him so greatly that they permitted his blood [to be shed]. And certainly their intention was for the sake of Heaven, for they considered him not a man of truth and one who brought an evil report, etc. And likewise it was in the generations before us, particularly in these generations, in the footsteps of the Messiah, when falsehood has grown very strong, until great controversy has arisen even among the tzaddikim and upright people themselves, and people do not know where the point of truth is. And one must pray to Hashem, blessed be He, that one merit to find truth in its utmost truth.

segments.he:
"וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים" וגו׳

(ל״ז, ל״א)

אֵלּוּ הַשְּׁנֵי מִדּוֹת עַזּוּת וּבֹשֶׁת הֵם שְׁנֵי הֲפָכִים, אֲבָל שְׁנֵיהֶם צְרִיכִים אֶל הַקְּדֻשָּׁה מְאֹד, אַךְ צְרִיכִין לִזָּהֵר מְאֹד לְהִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ עִם כָּל מִדָּה וּמִדָּה בִּמְקוֹמָהּ כָּרָאוּי, אֲבָל לֹא לְהֵפֶךְ ח״ו. וּמִי שֶׁפּוֹגֵם בָּהֶם וּמְהַפֵּךְ הַסֵּדֶר שֶׁמִּשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בְּעַזּוּת בְּמָקוֹם שֶׁצְּרִיכִין בֹּשֶׁת, אוֹ שֶׁמִּתְבַּיֵּשׁ בְּמָקוֹם שֶׁצְּרִיכִין עַזּוּת הוּא מְקַלְקֵל בָּזֶה מְאֹד.

וְעַל כֵּן הַשְּׁבָטִים כְּשֶׁפָּגְמוּ בִּמְכִירַת יוֹסֵף שָׁחֲטוּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים, כִּי עִקַּר הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁלָּהֶם הָיָה בְּעִנְיַן הַמַּלְכוּת, שֶׁאָמְרוּ שֶׁיּוֹסֵף רוֹצֶה לִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם שֶׁלֹּא כַּדִּין וְכוּ׳. וּלְפִי דַּעְתָּם נִדְמֶה לָהֶם שֶׁיּוֹסֵף רוֹצֶה לִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם רַק עַל יְדֵי עַזּוּת חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, וְהֵם רָצוּ לְהִתְגַּבֵּר בְּעַזּוּת שֶׁלָּהֶם נֶגְדּוֹ, עַל כֵּן שָׁחֲטוּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת עַזּוּת.

(הלכות משא ומתן הלכה ד׳ אות ט׳)
segments.en:
“And they slaughtered a male goat,” etc.

(37:31)

These two traits, boldness and shame, are two opposites, but both of them are very much needed for holiness. However, one must be very careful to use each and every trait in its proper place, but not the reverse, Heaven forbid. And one who damages them and reverses the order, using boldness where shame is required, or being ashamed where boldness is required, causes very great harm by this.

And therefore, when the tribes caused a blemish through the sale of Yosef, they slaughtered a male goat, for the principal matter of their dispute was kingship: they said that Yosef wanted to rule over them unlawfully, etc. And in their opinion it appeared to them that Yosef wanted to rule over them only by means of boldness, Heaven forbid, and they wanted to overcome him with their own boldness. Therefore they slaughtered a male goat, which is an aspect of boldness.

(Halachos of משא ומתן [Business Transactions], halacha 4, item 9)

pairs.he: אֵלּוּ הַשְּׁנֵי מִדּוֹת עַזּוּת וּבֹשֶׁת הֵם שְׁנֵי הֲפָכִים, אֲבָל שְׁנֵיהֶם צְרִיכִים אֶל הַקְּדֻשָּׁה מְאֹד, אַךְ צְרִיכִין לִזָּהֵר מְאֹד לְהִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ עִם כָּל מִדָּה וּמִדָּה בִּמְקוֹמָהּ כָּרָאוּי, אֲבָל לֹא לְהֵפֶךְ ח״ו. וּמִי שֶׁפּוֹגֵם בָּהֶם וּמְהַפֵּךְ הַסֵּדֶר שֶׁמִּשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בְּעַזּוּת בְּמָקוֹם שֶׁצְּרִיכִין בֹּשֶׁת, אוֹ שֶׁמִּתְבַּיֵּשׁ בְּמָקוֹם שֶׁצְּרִיכִין עַזּוּת הוּא מְקַלְקֵל בָּזֶה מְאֹד.
pairs.en: These two traits, boldness and shame, are two opposites, but both of them are very much needed for holiness. However, one must be very careful to use each and every trait in its proper place, but not the reverse, Heaven forbid. And one who damages them and reverses the order, using boldness where shame is required, or being ashamed where boldness is required, causes very great harm by this.

qualifiedAfter.en: These two traits, boldness and shame, are two opposites, but both of them are very much needed for holiness. pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן הַשְּׁבָטִים כְּשֶׁפָּגְמוּ בִּמְכִירַת יוֹסֵף שָׁחֲטוּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים, כִּי עִקַּר הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁלָּהֶם הָיָה בְּעִנְיַן הַמַּלְכוּת, שֶׁאָמְרוּ שֶׁיּוֹסֵף רוֹצֶה לִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם שֶׁלֹּא כַּדִּין וְכוּ׳. וּלְפִי דַּעְתָּם נִדְמֶה לָהֶם שֶׁיּוֹסֵף רוֹצֶה לִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם רַק עַל יְדֵי עַזּוּת חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, וְהֵם רָצוּ לְהִתְגַּבֵּר בְּעַזּוּת שֶׁלָּהֶם נֶגְדּוֹ, עַל כֵּן שָׁחֲטוּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת עַזּוּת.
pairs.en: And therefore, when the tribes caused a blemish through the sale of Yosef, they slaughtered a male goat, for the principal matter of their dispute was kingship: they said that Yosef wanted to rule over them unlawfully, etc. And in their opinion it appeared to them that Yosef wanted to rule over them only by means of boldness, Heaven forbid, and they wanted to overcome him with their own boldness. Therefore they slaughtered a male goat, which is an aspect of boldness.

qualifiedAfter.en: And therefore, when the tribes caused a blemish through the sale of Yosef, they slaughtered a male goat, for the principal matter of their dispute was kingship: they said that Yosef wanted to rule over them unlawfully, etc. And in their opinion it appeared to them that Yosef wanted to rule over them only by means of boldness, Heaven forbid, and they wanted to overcome him with their own boldness. segments.he:
״וְאֵיךְ אֶעֱשֶׂה הָרָעָה הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת וְחָטָאתִי לֵאלֹקִים״ (ל״ט, ט) יוֹסֵף הוּא בְּחִינַת תִּקּוּן הַמִּשְׁפָּט, בְּחִינַת ׳מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹקֵי יַעֲקֹב עֵדוּת בִּיהוֹסֵף שָׂמוֹ׳ וְכוּ׳, כִּי יַעֲקֹב וְיוֹסֵף כַּחֲדָא חֲשִׁיבֵי, וְיַעֲקֹב הוּא בְּחִינַת מִשְׁפָּט, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּמִּקְרָא זֶה, וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב ״מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה בְּיַעֲקֹב אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ״. וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה זָכָה יוֹסֵף לַעֲמֹד בְּנִסָּיוֹן גָּדוֹל וְלֹא פָּגַם בַּבְּרִית.

כִּי עִקַּר כְּבִישַׁת הַיֵּצֶר זוֹכִין עַל יְדֵי מִשְׁפָּט, עַל יְדֵי שֶׁשּׁוֹפְטִין וְדָנִין אֶת עַצְמוֹ בְּעַצְמוֹ שֶׁבְּוַדַּאי אֵינוֹ כְּדַאי לַחֲטֹא נֶגְדּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ הַגּוֹמֵל לוֹ כָּל הַטּוֹבוֹת וְעָתִיד לְהִפָּרַע מִמֶּנּוּ עַל הַכֹּל, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר יוֹסֵף ״אֵיךְ אֶעֱשֶׂה הָרָעָה הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת וְחָטָאתִי לֵאלֹקִים״, וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה כָּבַשׁ אֶת יִצְרוֹ וּמָנַע אֶת עַצְמוֹ מִן הָעֲבֵרָה.

כִּי זֶה עִקַּר הַמִּשְׁפָּט שֶׁהָאָדָם צָרִיךְ לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת עַצְמוֹ, דְּהַיְנוּ שֶׁיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת עַצְמוֹ תָּמִיד אֵיךְ רָאוּי לוֹ לְהִתְנַהֵג בְּכָל יוֹם וָיוֹם, וּבִפְרָט כְּשֶׁבָּא לִידֵי אֵיזֶה נִסָּיוֹן וּמִשְׁקָל שֶׁהַיֵּצֶר מְסִיתוֹ לְאֵיזֶה תַּאֲוָה אוֹ מִדָּה רָעָה, שֶׁאָז עִקַּר הַמִּשְׁפָּט שֶׁצָּרִיךְ לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת עַצְמוֹ אִם כֵּן רָאוּי לוֹ לַעֲשׂוֹת.

וְעִקַּר הַנִּסָּיוֹן וְהַמִּשְׁקָל הוּא בְּתַאֲוַת נִאוּף, שֶׁהוּא רַע הַכּוֹלֵל, וְשָׁם עִקַּר הַמִּשְׁפָּט שֶׁצָּרִיךְ הָאָדָם לְהִתְיָרֵא מְאֹד מִמִּשְׁפָּטוֹ וְדִינוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְלִשְׁפֹּט אֶת עַצְמוֹ בְּעַצְמוֹ וְלִבְרֹחַ מִן הָעֲבֵרָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ הֱוֵי מְחַשֵּׁב הֶפְסֵד מִצְוָה כְּנֶגֶד שְׂכָרָהּ וּשְׂכַר עֲבֵרָה כְּנֶגֶד הֶפְסֵדָהּ. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב ״חִשַּׁבְתִּי דְרָכַי וָאָשִׁיבָה רַגְלַי וְכוּ׳״. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב אֲדוֹנֵנוּ מוֹרֵנוּ וְרַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה שֶׁצָּרִיךְ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לְהָאָדָם יִשּׁוּב הַדַּעַת שֶׁיַּחֲשֹׁב אֶת עַצְמוֹ הֵיטֵב מַה תַּכְלִית מִכָּל הַתַּאֲווֹת וְכוּ׳ קלב, שֶׁכָּל זֶה הוּא בְּחִינַת מִשְׁפָּט הַנַּ״ל שֶׁעִקָּרוֹ הוּא בְּתַאֲוָה הַנַּ״ל וְיוֹסֵף זָכָה לִבְחִינַת מִשְׁפָּט בִּשְׁלֵמוּת שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה עָמַד בְּנִסָּיוֹן וְכַנַּ״ל.

(הלכות הרשאה הלכה ד׳ אות כ׳)
segments.en:
“And how shall I do this great evil and sin against God?” (39:9). Yosef is the aspect of rectifying judgment, the aspect of “a judgment for the God of Yaakov; He placed it as testimony in Yehosef,” etc., for Yaakov and Yosef are considered as one, and Yaakov is the aspect of judgment, as written in this verse, and as it is written, “Judgment and righteousness in Yaakov You have made.” And through this Yosef merited to stand firm in a great trial and did not blemish the covenant.

For one merits the principal subjugation of the inclination through judgment, by judging and trying oneself oneself: certainly it is not worthwhile to sin against Him, blessed be He, who bestows all good things upon him and will exact payment from him for everything, as Yosef said, “How shall I do this great evil and sin against God?” And through this he subdued his inclination and restrained himself from the transgression.

For this is the principal judgment by which a person must judge himself: that is, he must constantly judge himself as to how it is fitting for him to conduct himself each and every day, particularly when he comes to some trial and weighing, when the inclination incites him to some desire or bad trait. Then judgment is principally needed: he must judge himself whether it is thus fitting for him to act.

And the principal trial and weighing are in the desire for illicit relations, which is the all-encompassing evil. And there judgment is principally needed: a person must greatly fear His judgment and verdict, blessed be He, and judge himself himself and flee from the transgression, as they said: calculate the loss of a mitzvah against its reward, and the reward of a transgression against its loss. And this is as it is written, “I considered my ways and turned my feet,” etc. And this is as our master, teacher and Rabbi, of blessed memory, wrote: a person must have a settled mind, to compose himself carefully—what is the purpose of all the desires, etc. [printed note marker: 132]? All this is the aspect of the aforesaid judgment, which is principally in the aforesaid desire. And Yosef merited the aspect of complete judgment, through which he stood firm in the trial, as above.

(Halachos of Authorization, Halacha 4, item 20)

pairs.he: וְעִקַּר הַנִּסָּיוֹן וְהַמִּשְׁקָל הוּא בְּתַאֲוַת נִאוּף, שֶׁהוּא רַע הַכּוֹלֵל, וְשָׁם עִקַּר הַמִּשְׁפָּט שֶׁצָּרִיךְ הָאָדָם לְהִתְיָרֵא מְאֹד מִמִּשְׁפָּטוֹ וְדִינוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְלִשְׁפֹּט אֶת עַצְמוֹ בְּעַצְמוֹ וְלִבְרֹחַ מִן הָעֲבֵרָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ הֱוֵי מְחַשֵּׁב הֶפְסֵד מִצְוָה כְּנֶגֶד שְׂכָרָהּ וּשְׂכַר עֲבֵרָה כְּנֶגֶד הֶפְסֵדָהּ. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב ״חִשַּׁבְתִּי דְרָכַי וָאָשִׁיבָה רַגְלַי וְכוּ׳״. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב אֲדוֹנֵנוּ מוֹרֵנוּ וְרַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה שֶׁצָּרִיךְ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לְהָאָדָם יִשּׁוּב הַדַּעַת שֶׁיַּחֲשֹׁב אֶת עַצְמוֹ הֵיטֵב מַה תַּכְלִית מִכָּל הַתַּאֲווֹת וְכוּ׳ קלב, שֶׁכָּל זֶה הוּא בְּחִינַת מִשְׁפָּט הַנַּ״ל שֶׁעִקָּרוֹ הוּא בְּתַאֲוָה הַנַּ״ל וְיוֹסֵף זָכָה לִבְחִינַת מִשְׁפָּט בִּשְׁלֵמוּת שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה עָמַד בְּנִסָּיוֹן וְכַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And the principal trial and weighing are in the desire for illicit relations, which is the all-encompassing evil. And there judgment is principally needed: a person must greatly fear His judgment and verdict, blessed be He, and judge himself himself and flee from the transgression, as they said: calculate the loss of a mitzvah against its reward, and the reward of a transgression against its loss. And this is as it is written, “I considered my ways and turned my feet,” etc. And this is as our master, teacher and Rabbi, of blessed memory, wrote: a person must have a settled mind, to compose himself carefully—what is the purpose of all the desires, etc. [printed note marker: 132]? All this is the aspect of the aforesaid judgment, which is principally in the aforesaid desire. And Yosef merited the aspect of complete judgment, through which he stood firm in the trial, as above.

segments.he:
יוסף הפשיט מעצמו בשלימות אחיזת בגדים הצואים

"וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂהוּ בְּבִגְדוֹ וגו׳ וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ בְּיָדָהּ וַיָּנָס וַיֵּצֵא הַחוּצָה"

(ל״ט, י״ב)

זֶה שֶׁכָּתוּב שָׁם בְּעֵת הַנִּסָּיוֹן ׳וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂהוּ בְּבִגְדוֹ׳. ׳בְּבִגְדוֹ׳ דַּיְקָא, כִּי רָצְתָה לְהִתְאַחֵז בִּבְגָדָיו חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּתְלַבֵּשׁ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם בִּבְגָדִים צוֹאִים. אֲבָל יוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק עָמַד בְּנִסָּיוֹן וְלֹא רָצָה לְטַמֵּאוֹת נִשְׁמָתוֹ עַל יְדֵי בְּגָדִים צוֹאִים הַנִּמְשָׁכִין עַל יְדֵי נִאוּף. וְעַל כֵּן ׳וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ בְּיָדָהּ וַיָּנָס וַיֵּצֵא הַחוּצָה׳. וְאָז דַּיְקָא בְּאוֹתָהּ הָרֶגַע הִפְשִׁיט מֵעַצְמוֹ בִּשְׁלֵמוּת כָּל אֲחִיזַת הַבְּגָדִים הַצּוֹאִים שֶׁהָיוּ נֶאֱחָזִין בִּבְגָדָיו.

כִּי אֲפִלּוּ הַצַּדִּיקִים הַגְּדוֹלִים כָּל זְמַן שֶׁלֹּא עָמְדוּ בְּנִסָּיוֹן כָּרָאוּי לָהֶם עֲדַיִן יֵשׁ בָּהֶם אֵיזֶה אֲחִיזָה מֵהַבְּגָדִים הַצּוֹאִים. וְעַל כֵּן כְּשֶׁעָמַד יוֹסֵף בְּנִסָּיוֹן אָז דַּיְקָא הִפְשִׁיט מֵעַצְמוֹ בְּחִינַת אֲחִיזַת הַבְּגָדִים הַצּוֹאִים בִּבְחִינַת ׳וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ בְּיָדָהּ וַיָּנָס׳ וְכוּ׳. שֶׁהַבֶּגֶד שֶׁהָיָה לָהּ אֲחִיזָה בּוֹ עָזַב בְּיָדָהּ. וְהִפְשִׁיט אֶת עַצְמוֹ מִבְּגָדִים אֵלּוּ בִּשְׁלֵמוּת.

וְאָז זָכָה אַחַר כָּךְ לִבְגָדִים נְקִיִּים וִיקָרִים בִּבְחִינַת ׳וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ בִּגְדֵי שֵׁשׁ׳ וְכוּ׳.

וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ יוֹסֵף מִדִּלֵּהּ נָטַל וְכוּ׳. וּמִגֹּדֶל עֹצֶם צִדְקָתוֹ שֶׁעָמַד בְּנִסָּיוֹן בָּזֶה זָכָה לְהַמְשִׁיךְ בְּחִינַת בְּגָדִים נְקִיִּים לְכָל אֶחָיו בִּבְחִינַת ׳לְכֻלָּם נָתַן לָאִישׁ חֲלִפוֹת שְׂמָלֹת׳ וְכוּ׳. שֶׁמֵּרֹב שֶׁהָיָה לוֹ כֹּחַ לְתַקֵּן כֻּלָּם לְהַמְשִׁיךְ לָהֶם בְּחִינַת בְּגָדִים נְקִיִּים. וְעַל כֵּן וּלְבִנְיָמִין נָתַן וְכוּ׳ וְחָמֵשׁ חֲלִפֹת שְׂמָלֹת, שֶׁמְּרַמֵּז עַל בִּגְדֵי כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל שֶׁהָיָה מַחֲלִיף בְּגָדָיו חֲמִשָּׁה פְּעָמִים בְּיוֹם כִּפּוּר כְּשֶׁנִּכְנַס לְבֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ שֶׁהָיָה בָּנוּי בְּחֶלְקוֹ כַּמּוּבָא. כִּי עִקַּר בְּחִינַת בְּגָדִים נְקִיִּים בְּגָדִים לְבָנִים זָכָה הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל. שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה הָיָה מְכַפֵּר עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל.

(הלכות סעודה הלכה ה׳ אות כ׳)
segments.en:
Yosef completely stripped from himself the hold of the filthy garments.

“And she seized him by his garment, etc.; and he left his garment in her hand, and fled and went outside.”

(39:12)

This is what is written there at the time of the trial: ‘And she seized him by his garment.’ Specifically ‘by his garment,’ for she wanted to fasten herself onto his garments, Heaven forbid, so that he would be clothed, Heaven forbid, in filthy garments. But Yosef the righteous stood firm in the trial and did not want to defile his soul by means of filthy garments that are drawn forth through adultery. And therefore, ‘And he left his garment in her hand, and fled and went outside.’ And then, precisely at that moment, he completely stripped from himself every hold of the filthy garments that had fastened themselves onto his garments.

For even the great righteous people, so long as they have not stood firm in a trial as befits them, still have in them some hold of the filthy garments. And therefore, when Yosef stood firm in the trial, then precisely he stripped from himself the aspect of the hold of the filthy garments, in the aspect of ‘And he left his garment in her hand and fled,’ etc.: the garment in which she had a hold he left in her hand, and he completely stripped himself of these garments.

And then he afterward merited clean and precious garments, in the aspect of ‘And he clothed him in garments of fine linen,’ etc.

And [this is] as is stated in the holy Zohar, “Yosef took from his own,” etc. And through the greatness of the immensity of his righteousness—in that he stood firm in the trial— through this he merited to draw forth the aspect of clean garments for all his brothers, in the aspect of ‘To all of them he gave each man changes of clothing,’ etc.—for he had so much power to rectify them all, to draw forth for them the aspect of clean garments. And therefore, [it is stated:] “and to Binyamin he gave,” etc., “and five changes of clothing,” which alludes to the garments of the High Priest, who changed his garments five times on Yom Kippur when he entered the Temple, which was built in [Binyamin’s] portion, as is cited. For the High Priest merited the principal aspect of clean garments, white garments; for through this he would atone for all Israel.

(Halachos of סעודה [The Meal], halacha 5, item 20)

pairs.he: כִּי אֲפִלּוּ הַצַּדִּיקִים הַגְּדוֹלִים כָּל זְמַן שֶׁלֹּא עָמְדוּ בְּנִסָּיוֹן כָּרָאוּי לָהֶם עֲדַיִן יֵשׁ בָּהֶם אֵיזֶה אֲחִיזָה מֵהַבְּגָדִים הַצּוֹאִים. וְעַל כֵּן כְּשֶׁעָמַד יוֹסֵף בְּנִסָּיוֹן אָז דַּיְקָא הִפְשִׁיט מֵעַצְמוֹ בְּחִינַת אֲחִיזַת הַבְּגָדִים הַצּוֹאִים בִּבְחִינַת ׳וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ בְּיָדָהּ וַיָּנָס׳ וְכוּ׳. שֶׁהַבֶּגֶד שֶׁהָיָה לָהּ אֲחִיזָה בּוֹ עָזַב בְּיָדָהּ. וְהִפְשִׁיט אֶת עַצְמוֹ מִבְּגָדִים אֵלּוּ בִּשְׁלֵמוּת.
pairs.en: For even the great righteous people, so long as they have not stood firm in a trial as befits them, still have in them some hold of the filthy garments. And therefore, when Yosef stood firm in the trial, then precisely he stripped from himself the aspect of the hold of the filthy garments, in the aspect of ‘And he left his garment in her hand and fled,’ etc.: the garment in which she had a hold he left in her hand, and he completely stripped himself of these garments.

pairs.he: וְאָז זָכָה אַחַר כָּךְ לִבְגָדִים נְקִיִּים וִיקָרִים בִּבְחִינַת ׳וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ בִּגְדֵי שֵׁשׁ׳ וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: And then he afterward merited clean and precious garments, in the aspect of ‘And he clothed him in garments of fine linen,’ etc.

qualifiedAfter.en: And then he afterward merited clean and precious garments, in the aspect of ‘And he clothed him in garments of fine linen,’ etc.

pairs.he: וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ יוֹסֵף מִדִּלֵּהּ נָטַל וְכוּ׳. וּמִגֹּדֶל עֹצֶם צִדְקָתוֹ שֶׁעָמַד בְּנִסָּיוֹן בָּזֶה זָכָה לְהַמְשִׁיךְ בְּחִינַת בְּגָדִים נְקִיִּים לְכָל אֶחָיו בִּבְחִינַת ׳לְכֻלָּם נָתַן לָאִישׁ חֲלִפוֹת שְׂמָלֹת׳ וְכוּ׳. שֶׁמֵּרֹב שֶׁהָיָה לוֹ כֹּחַ לְתַקֵּן כֻּלָּם לְהַמְשִׁיךְ לָהֶם בְּחִינַת בְּגָדִים נְקִיִּים. וְעַל כֵּן וּלְבִנְיָמִין נָתַן וְכוּ׳ וְחָמֵשׁ חֲלִפֹת שְׂמָלֹת, שֶׁמְּרַמֵּז עַל בִּגְדֵי כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל שֶׁהָיָה מַחֲלִיף בְּגָדָיו חֲמִשָּׁה פְּעָמִים בְּיוֹם כִּפּוּר כְּשֶׁנִּכְנַס לְבֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ שֶׁהָיָה בָּנוּי בְּחֶלְקוֹ כַּמּוּבָא. כִּי עִקַּר בְּחִינַת בְּגָדִים נְקִיִּים בְּגָדִים לְבָנִים זָכָה הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל. שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה הָיָה מְכַפֵּר עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל.
pairs.en: And [this is] as is stated in the holy Zohar, “Yosef took from his own,” etc. And through the greatness of the immensity of his righteousness—in that he stood firm in the trial— through this he merited to draw forth the aspect of clean garments for all his brothers, in the aspect of ‘To all of them he gave each man changes of clothing,’ etc.—for he had so much power to rectify them all, to draw forth for them the aspect of clean garments. And therefore, [it is stated:] “and to Binyamin he gave,” etc., “and five changes of clothing,” which alludes to the garments of the High Priest, who changed his garments five times on Yom Kippur when he entered the Temple, which was built in [Binyamin’s] portion, as is cited. For the High Priest merited the principal aspect of clean garments, white garments; for through this he would atone for all Israel.

segments.he:
קלב.

בליקוטי מוהר״ן (חלק שני סימן י׳): מה שהעולם רחוקים מהשם יתברך ואינם מתקרבים אליו יתברך, הוא רק מחמת שאין להם ישוב הדעת, ואינם מישבין עצמם. והעקר להשתדל לישב עצמו היטב. מה התכלית מכל התאוות ומכל עניני העולם הזה, הן תאוות הנכנסות לגוף, הן תאוות שחוץ לגוף, כגון כבוד, ואז בודאי ישוב אל ה׳. ע״כ.
segments.en:
132.

In Likutay Moharan (Part Two, section 10): That people are far from Hashem, blessed be He, and do not draw near to Him, blessed be He, is only because they do not have settled understanding, and they do not settle their minds. And the essential thing is to endeavor to settle one’s mind thoroughly. What is the ultimate purpose of all the desires and of all the affairs of this world, both desires that enter the body and desires outside the body, such as honor? And then one will certainly return to Hashem. Thus far.

segments.he:
הבעל דבר מטריד את האדם בטרדת הבגדים

"וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂהוּ בְּבִגְדוֹ"

(ל״ט, י״ב)

שֶׁהַבַּעַל דָּבָר וְהַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא תּוֹפֶסֶת אֶת הָאָדָם בְּבִגְדוֹ, הַיְנוּ שֶׁמַּטְרִיד אוֹתוֹ בְּטִרְדַת בְּגָדָיו וּמַלְבּוּשָׁיו. כִּי טִרְחַת הִצְטָרְכוּת מַלְבּוּשִׁים וּבְגָדִים שֶׁל אָדָם הֵם מְבַלְבְּלִין מְאֹד אֶת הָאָדָם וּמוֹנְעִים אוֹתוֹ עַל יְדֵי זֶה מֵעֲבוֹדַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְזֶהוּ "וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂהוּ בְּבִגְדוֹ". אַךְ מִי שֶׁהוּא בַּעַל נֶפֶשׁ וְלִבּוֹ חָזָק בָּהּ, אֵינוֹ מַשְׁגִּיחַ גַּם עַל זֶה. אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאֵין לוֹ בֶּגֶד לִלְבֹּשׁ, אַף עַל פִּי כֵן אֵינוֹ מַטְרִיד עַצְמוֹ בָּזֶה וְאֵינוֹ רוֹצֶה לְהַנִּיחַ עַצְמוֹ לְבַלְבֵּל בָּזֶה. וְזֶהוּ "וַיַּנַּח בִּגְדוֹ אֶצְלָהּ וַיָּנָס" וְכוּ׳. שֶׁמַּנִּיחַ בְּגָדוֹ וּמַלְבּוּשָׁיו וְנָס וּבוֹרֵחַ מֵהֶם וְאֵינוֹ מַשְׁגִּיחַ כְּלָל עַל זֶה. רַק עוֹשֶׂה אֶת שֶׁלּוֹ בַּעֲבוֹדַת ה׳ כְּפִי מַה שֶּׁיָּכוֹל.

(שיחות הר״ן סימן ק׳)
segments.en:
The baal davar troubles a person with the preoccupation of clothing.

“And she seized him by his garment.”

(39:12)

For the baal davar and the sitra achra seize a person by his garment, meaning that they trouble him with the preoccupation of his clothes and garments. For the trouble of needing a person’s clothes and garments greatly confuses the person, and through this they prevent him from serving Hashem, blessed be He. And this is “And she seized him by his garment.” But one who is a person of soul, and whose heart is strong in it, pays no heed even to this. Even though he has no garment to wear, nevertheless he does not trouble himself over this, and he does not want to allow himself to be confused by this. And this is “And he left his garment with her and fled,” etc.: he leaves his clothes and garments and flees and runs away from them, and pays no heed at all to this. He only does his part in the service of Hashem, according to what he can do.

(Sichos HaRan, section 100)

segments.he:
רוב תאות הממון הוא בשביל הבגדים

"וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂהוּ בְּבִגְדוֹ"

(ל״ט, י״ב)

רֹב תַּאֲוַת מָמוֹן הוּא בִּשְׁבִיל הַמַּלְבּוּשִׁים וְהַבְּגָדִים. כַּאֲשֶׁר יָכוֹל כָּל אֶחָד לְהָבִין מֵעַצְמוֹ שֶׁרֹב יְגִיעוֹת וְטִרְדוֹת הַפַּרְנָסָה הוּא בִּשְׁבִיל הַבְּגָדִים וְהַמַּלְבּוּשִׁים שֶׁל כְּבוֹד לוֹ וּלְאִשְׁתּוֹ וּלְבָנָיו וְלִבְנוֹתָיו, וּבִפְרָט בְּעֵת הַנִּשּׂוּאִין שֶׁצָּרִיךְ לְהַשִּׂיאָם, שֶׁכָּל רִבּוּי הַהוֹצָאָה הוּא עַל הַמַּלְבּוּשִׁים. וְהוּא הַמַּטְרִיד אֶת רֹב בְּנֵי אָדָם בְּפַרְנָסָתָם מֵחֲמַת שֶׁכָּל אֶחָד רוֹדֵף אַחַר הַכָּבוֹד וְרוֹצֶה מַלְבּוּשִׁים גְּבוֹהִים מֵעֶרְכּוֹ וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נַעֲשֶׂה בַּעַל חוֹב וּמַכְחִישׁ מָמוֹן חֲבֵרוֹ.

וּכְמוֹ שֶׁשָּׁמַעְתִּי מִפִּיו הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁהַמַּלְבּוּשִׁים מַטְרִידִין מְאֹד אֶת הָאָדָם, כִּי אֲכִילָה שְׁתִיָּה יָכוֹל הָאָדָם לְהִתְפַּרְנֵס בְּהוֹצָאָה קַלָּה אֲבָל הַמַּלְבּוּשׁ מַטְרִיד מְאֹד, וּכְמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר עַל פָּסוּק "וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂהוּ בְּבִגְדוֹ", שֶׁהַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא תּוֹפֶסֶת אֶת הָאָדָם בְּבִגְדוֹ דַּיְקָא וְכוּ׳, עַיֵּן שָׁם בְּסֵפֶר שיחות הר״ן.

הַיְנוּ כַּנַּ״ל כִּי עִקַּר פְּגַם תַּאֲוַת מָמוֹן שֶׁמְּכַלֶּה יְמֵי הָאָדָם נִמְשָׁךְ מִפְּגַם הַלְּבוּשִׁין כַּנַּ״ל, וְעִקָּרוֹ מֵחֲמַת חֶסְרוֹן אֱמוּנָתוֹ שֶׁאֵינוֹ מַאֲמִין שֶׁבְּכָל דָּבָר יֵשׁ פְּנִימִיּוּת חָכְמָה וְכוּ׳ כַּנַּ״ל וְסוֹמֵךְ עַל חָכְמָתוֹ וְעָרְמָתוֹ כְּאִלּוּ כְּבָר הִשִּׂיג אֶת כָּל הַחָכְמָה וְיוֹדֵעַ אֵיךְ לִמְצֹא לְהַשִּׂיג מָמוֹן עַל יְדֵי הַתַּחְבּוּלוֹת וְעָרְמוֹת הָאֵלּוּ. כִּי אִם הָיָה שָׂם לִבּוֹ אֶל דְּבַר ה׳ הַמְלֻבָּשׁ בְּכָל דָּבָר וְהָיָה מַאֲמִין שֶׁהַכֹּל בְּהַשְׁגָּחָה פְּרָטִית וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהָאָדָם צָרִיךְ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֵיזֶה עֵסֶק בִּשְׁבִיל פַּרְנָסָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב "וּבֵרַכְךָ ה׳ אֱלֹקֶיךָ בְּכָל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶךָ", אַף עַל פִּי כֵן אֵין חָכְמָה וְאֵין תְּבוּנָה וְאֵין עֵצָה לְנֶגֶד ה׳ כִּי לֹא מִמּוֹצָא וּמִמַּעֲרָב וְלֹא מִמִּדְבַּר הָרִים וְכוּ׳ כִּי "לֹא בְכֹחַ יִגְבַּר אִישׁ וְכוּ׳".

(הלכות חזקת מטלטלין הלכה ד׳ אות ו׳)
segments.en:
Most desire for money is on account of clothing.

“And she seized him by his garment.”

(39:12)

Most desire for money is on account of clothes and garments, as everyone can understand for himself: most of the toil and preoccupation of earning a livelihood is on account of the clothes and garments of honor for himself and his wife and his sons and his daughters, and especially at the time of marriage, when he must marry them off, when all the abundance of expenditure is on garments. And this is what troubles most people in their livelihood, because everyone pursues honor and wants garments above his station; and through this he becomes a debtor and denies his fellow’s money.

And as I heard from his holy mouth, garments trouble a person greatly, for a person can obtain his food and drink at little expense, but clothing troubles him greatly. And as is explained on the verse “And she seized him by his garment,” the sitra achra seizes a person specifically by his garment, etc.; see there in the book Sichos HaRan.

That is, as stated above, for the principal damage of desire for money, which consumes a person’s days, is drawn from damage to the garments, as stated above; and its principal cause is his lack of faith, that he does not believe that within everything there is an inward wisdom, etc., as stated above. And he relies on his wisdom and his cunning as if he had already attained all wisdom and knows how to find and obtain money through these stratagems and artifices. For if he set his heart upon the word of Hashem that is clothed within everything, and believed that everything is under particular providence—and even though a person must conduct some business for his livelihood, as it is written, “And Hashem your God will bless you in all the work of your hand”—nevertheless, there is no wisdom and no understanding and no counsel against Hashem, for it is not from the east and from the west and not from the wilderness of mountains, etc.; for “Not by strength shall a man prevail,” etc.

(Halachos of חזקת מטלטלין [Presumptive Possession of Movable Property], halacha 4, item 6)

pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת כְּלַל הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבְּכָל דּוֹר עַל הַצַּדִּיקִים הַשְּׁלֵמִים הָעוֹסְקִים לְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת הָרְחוֹקִים לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, שֶׁרַבִּים מְאֹד קָמִים עֲלֵיהֶם, וְגַם רַבִּים מִגְּדוֹלֵי הַצַּדִּיקִים חוֹלְקִים עֲלֵיהֶם מֵחֲמַת שֶׁמִּדַּת הַדִּין מִתְלַבֵּשׁ בָּהֶם וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִכְנָס בְּלִבָּם שִׂנְאָה עַד שֶׁנִּדְמֶה לָהֶם כְּאִלּוּ אֵינוֹ מִתְנַהֵג כָּרָאוּי וְחוֹלְקִים עָלָיו.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of the totality of the dispute in every generation against the complete tzaddikim who occupy themselves with drawing distant souls near to the Lord, blessed be He: very many rise against them, and also many of the great tzaddikim dispute with them, because the attribute of judgment clothes itself in them. And through this hatred enters their hearts, until it seems to them as though he does not conduct himself properly, and they dispute with him.

qualifiedAfter.en: And this is the aspect of the totality of the dispute in every generation against the complete tzaddikim who occupy themselves with drawing distant souls near to the Lord, blessed be He: very many rise against them, and also many of the great tzaddikim dispute with them, because the attribute of judgment clothes itself in them. And through this hatred enters their hearts, until it seems to them as though he does not conduct himself properly, and they dispute with him.

pairs.he: כַּאֲשֶׁר כְּבָר הָיָה לְעוֹלָמִים בְּרֹב הַדּוֹרוֹת. וּבִפְרָט בְּיָמֵינוּ בְּעִקְבוֹת מְשִׁיחָא שֶׁנִּתְרַבָּה הַקַּטֵּגוֹרְיָא בֵּין הַתַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים מְאֹד. וּבְיוֹתֵר עַל רַבֵּנוּ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא זצוק״ל עַל אֲשֶׁר מָסַר נַפְשׁוֹ מִנֶּגֶד וְעָסַק כָּל יָמָיו לְרַחֵם עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל כָּל הָרְחוֹקִים לְקָרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ.
pairs.en: As has already happened in former times in most generations. And particularly in our days, in the footsteps of the Messiah, when contention among the Torah scholars has greatly increased; and especially against our great and awesome Rabbainu, of blessed holy and righteous memory, because he put his soul in jeopardy and occupied himself all his days with having compassion upon Israel, upon all the distant ones, to draw them near to the Lord, blessed be He.

qualifiedAfter.en: As has already happened in former times in most generations. And particularly in our days, in the footsteps of the Messiah, when contention among the Torah scholars has greatly increased; and especially against our great and awesome Rabbainu, of blessed holy and righteous memory, because he put his soul in jeopardy and occupied himself all his days with having compassion upon Israel, upon all the distant ones, to draw them near to the Lord, blessed be He.

pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת מַחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁל הַשְּׁבָטִים עַל יוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק, כִּי יוֹסֵף הוּא בְּחִינַת הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁעוֹסֵק לְקָרֵב לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עַל יְדֵי שֶׁמּוֹסִיף וְהוֹלֵךְ הָאוֹר בְּכָל יוֹם, כִּי עוֹשֶׂה בְּכָל פַּעַם צִמְצוּמִים וְכֵלִים נִפְלָאִים בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁיּוּכְלוּ לְהִתְקָרֵב כָּל מִי שֶׁיִּרְצֶה בָּעוֹלָם. וְעַל שֵׁם זֶה נִקְרָא יוֹסֵף, בְּחִינַת מוֹסִיף וְהוֹלֵךְ כַּנַּ״ל. וְהַשְּׁבָטִים אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁכֻּלָּם קְדוֹשִׁים, כִּי הָיוּ כֻּלָּם צַדִּיקִים גְּדוֹלִים, חָלְקוּ עָלָיו בִּשְׁבִיל זֶה.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of the dispute of the tribes against Yosef the tzaddik, for Yosef is the aspect of the tzaddik who occupies himself with drawing people near to the Lord, blessed be He, through continually adding to the light each day. For each time he makes wondrous contractions and vessels, in a manner in which anyone in the world who wishes can draw near. And on account of this he is called Yosef, the aspect of continually adding, as above. And the tribes, although they were all holy, for they were all great tzaddikim, disputed with him because of this.

pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת ׳וַיֵּשֶׁב יַעֲקֹב בְּאֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו׳ וְדָרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (מדרש רבה) שֶׁהָיָה מְגַיֵּר גֵּרִים, (כמובא בדבריו ז"ל ח"א סימן רכ"ח). וְזֶה ׳אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף׳. הַיְנוּ שֶׁיּוֹסֵף הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אָבִיו יַעֲקֹב וְהָיָה עוֹסֵק גַּם כֵּן לְגַיֵּר גֵּרִים וּלְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת הָרְחוֹקוֹת, כִּי כָּל מַה שֶּׁאֵרַע לְיַעֲקֹב אֵרַע לְיוֹסֵף, שֶׁזֶּה פֵּרוּשׁ אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף, כְּמוֹ שֶׁפֵּרֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י שָׁם. שֶׁכָּל מַה שֶּׁקִּבֵּל מִשֵּׁם וָעֵבֶר מָסַר לוֹ, וְכָל מַה שֶּׁאֵרַע יַעֲקֹב אֵרַע לְיוֹסֵף וְכוּ׳. וְכָל זֶה נִסְמָךְ לְפָסוּק ׳מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו׳ שֶׁהוּא מַה שֶּׁהָיָה יַעֲקֹב מְגַיֵּר גֵּרִים. וְתֵכֶף נִסְמָךְ אֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף, שֶׁפֵּרוּשׁוֹ שֶׁמָּסַר לוֹ כָּל חָכְמָתוֹ כַּנַּ״ל, הַיְנוּ כַּנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of “And Yaakov dwelt in the land of his father’s sojournings”; and our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded (Midrash Rabbah) that he would convert converts (as cited in his words, of blessed memory, part 1, section 228). And this is “These are the offspring of Yaakov: Yosef.” Namely, Yosef walked in the way of his father Yaakov and also occupied himself with converting converts and drawing distant souls near, for everything that happened to Yaakov happened to Yosef. This is the explanation of “These are the offspring of Yaakov: Yosef,” as Rash״i explained there: that everything that he had received from Shem and Ever he transmitted to him, and everything that happened to Yaakov happened to Yosef, etc. And all this is placed beside the verse “his father’s sojournings,” which is Yaakov’s converting converts; and immediately “These are the offspring of Yaakov: Yosef” is placed beside it, meaning that he transmitted all his wisdom to him, as above—namely, as above.

qualifiedAfter.en: And this is the aspect of “And Yaakov dwelt in the land of his father’s sojournings”; and our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded (Midrash Rabbah) that he would convert converts (as cited in his words, of blessed memory, part 1, section 228). And this is “These are the offspring of Yaakov: Yosef.” Namely, Yosef walked in the way of his father Yaakov and also occupied himself with converting converts and drawing distant souls near, for everything that happened to Yaakov happened to Yosef. This is the explanation of “These are the offspring of Yaakov: Yosef,” as Rash״i explained there: that everything that he had received from Shem and Ever he transmitted to him, and everything that happened to Yaakov happened to Yosef, etc. And all this is placed beside the verse “his father’s sojournings,” which is Yaakov’s converting converts; and immediately “These are the offspring of Yaakov: Yosef” is placed beside it, meaning that he transmitted all his wisdom to him, as above—namely, as above.

pairs.he: כְּמוֹ שֶׁיַּעֲקֹב גִּיֵּר גֵּרִים עַל יְדֵי עֹצֶם חָכְמָתוֹ שֶׁהָיָה יוֹדֵעַ לַעֲשׂוֹת צִמְצוּמִים כָּאֵלֶּה עַד שֶׁיּוּכַל לְרַפְּאוֹת הַחוֹלִים בְּיוֹתֵר, כְּמוֹ כֵן הָיָה יוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק עוֹסֵק בָּזֶה תָּמִיד, כִּי יַעֲקֹב מָסַר לוֹ כָּל חָכְמָתוֹ, כִּי עִקַּר הַחָכְמָה הוּא לְהַכְנִיס הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת בָּעוֹלָם לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָיו וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: Just as Yaakov converted converts through the might of his wisdom, for he knew how to make such contractions until he could heal those who were most ill, so Yosef the tzaddik continually occupied himself with this, for Yaakov transmitted all his wisdom to him. For the principal wisdom is to bring apprehensions of Godliness into the world, to make His mighty deeds known to the sons of man, etc.

For the principal wisdom is to bring apprehensions of Godliness into the world, to make His mighty deeds known to the sons of man, etc.

pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף בֶּן שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה הָיָה רוֹעֶה אֶת אֶחָיו בַּצֹּאן, ׳רוֹעֶה צֹאן׳ זֶה בְּחִינַת מַנְהִיג הַדּוֹר שֶׁנִּקְרָא בְּכָל מָקוֹם בְּשֵׁם רוֹעֶה צֹאן. וְזֶה ׳בֶּן שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה הָיָה׳ וְכוּ׳. שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא ׳טוֹב׳ כַּמּוּבָא, הַיְנוּ שֶׁיּוֹסֵף הָיָה טוֹב לַכֹּל וְהָיָה כֻּלּוֹ טוֹב וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה הָיָה יָכוֹל לְקָרֵב הַכֹּל, כִּי מָצָא מִגֹּרַע שֶׁבַּגְּרוּעִים נְקֻדּוֹת טוֹבוֹת וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה קֵרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of “Yosef, seventeen years old, was shepherding his brothers among the sheep”: “shepherd of sheep” is the aspect of the leader of the generation, who is everywhere called a shepherd of sheep. And this is “he was seventeen years old,” etc. Seventeen is the numerical value of “good,” as cited; namely, Yosef was good to everyone and was wholly good. And through this he could draw everyone near, for he found good points in the worst of the worst, and through this drew them near to the Lord, blessed be He.

And this is “he was seventeen years old,” etc. Seventeen is the numerical value of “good,” as cited; namely, Yosef was good to everyone and was wholly good. And through this he could draw everyone near, for he found good points in the worst of the worst, and through this drew them near to the Lord, blessed be He.

pairs.he: וְזֶה ׳וְהוּא נַעַר אֶת בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וְאֶת בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה וְכוּ׳ שֶׁהֵם בְּנֵי הַשְּׁפָחוֹת הֵם בְּחִינַת מִשְׁפָּחוֹת הַיְּרוּדוֹת שֶׁבְּיִשְׂרָאֵל, שֶׁהָיָה מוֹרִיד אֶת עַצְמוֹ אֲלֵיהֶם בְּיוֹתֵר כְּדֵי לְקָרְבָם. וְעַל שֵׁם זֶה נִקְרָאִים הָרְחוֹקִים בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וּבְנֵי זִלְפָּה, זֶה רֶמֶז שֶׁנֶּאֱחַז בָּהֶם בְּיוֹתֵר הַבַּעַל דָּבָר וְחֵילוֹתָיו. שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת ׳בְּנֵי בִלְהָה׳, בְּחִינַת בַּלָּהוֹת אֶתֵּן אוֹתָךְ וְכוּ׳ (יחזקאל כו) וּפֵרֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י שָׁם, שֵׁדִים, הַיְנוּ חֵילוֹת הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע שֶׁהֵם שֵׁדִים וּקְלִפּוֹת, שֶׁהֵם מְבַלְבְּלִים וּמְבַהֲלִים וּמַרְשִׁיעִים אֶת הָאָדָם. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת ׳בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה׳ בְּחִינַת ׳זַלְעָפָה אֲחָזַתְנִי מֵרְשָׁעִים׳ (תהלים קיט). כִּי חֵילוֹת הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע הֵם בְּחִינַת בַּלָּהוֹת וְזַלְעָפוֹת וְכָל הַנֶּאֱחָזִים וְהַנִּמְשָׁכִים נִקְרָאִים בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וּבְנֵי זִלְפָּה.
pairs.en: And this is “And he was a youth with the sons of Bilhah and with the sons of Zilpah,” etc.: they are the sons of the bondwomen, the aspect of the lowly families among Israel, to whom he would lower himself especially in order to draw them near. And on account of this the distant ones are called sons of Bilhah and sons of Zilpah: this hints that the adversary and his forces have an especially strong hold on them. This is the aspect of “sons of Bilhah,” the aspect of “I shall make you terrors,” etc. (Ezekiel 26); and Rash״i explained there: demons—namely, the forces of the evil inclination, which are demons and klipos, that confuse, terrify, and cause a person to act wickedly. And this is the aspect of “sons of Zilpah,” the aspect of “Horror has seized me because of the wicked” (Psalms 119). For the forces of the evil inclination are the aspect of terrors and horrors, and all those held and drawn by them are called sons of Bilhah and sons of Zilpah.

pairs.he: וְהַצַּדִּיק הַגָּדוֹל, בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף, עוֹסֵק עִמָּהֶם וּמוֹרִיד אֶת עַצְמוֹ אֲלֵיהֶם כְּדֵי לְקָרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְזֶה ׳וְהוּא נַעַר אֶת בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וְאֶת בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה׳ וְכוּ׳. וּפֵרֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י שֶׁהָיָה עוֹשֶׂה מַעֲשֶׂה נַעֲרוּת וְכוּ׳. כִּי הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת בְּעֹצֶם חָכְמָתוֹ מוֹרִיד אֶת עַצְמוֹ אֲלֵיהֶם כָּל כָּךְ עַד שֶׁנִּדְמֶה כְּאִלּוּ עוֹשֶׂה מַעֲשֶׂה נַעֲרוּת, כִּי מְדַבֵּר עִמָּהֶם שִׂיחַת חֻלִּין וְאוֹכֵל וְשׁוֹתֶה עִמָּהֶם וּפְעָמִים מְטַיֵּל וּמְשַׂחֵק עִמָּהֶם וְכָל כַּוָּנָתוֹ כְּדֵי לְקָרְבָם עַל יְדֵי זֶה לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְכַמּוּבָן בִּדְבָרָיו ז״ל בְּכַמָּה מְקוֹמוֹת (ח״א סימן ר״ב ח״ב סימן עח) כַּמָּה וְכַמָּה הַצַּדִּיק מוֹרִיד אֶת עַצְמוֹ אֶל הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁכָּל זֶה נֶחְשָׁב אֶצְלוֹ מַעֲשֵׂה נַעֲרוּת, אֲבָל כַּוָּנָתוֹ רְצוּיָה לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁבִּשְׁבִיל לְקָרֵב הָרְחוֹקִים מְאֹד לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְקָרְבָם כִּי אִם עַל יְדֵי זֶה. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת וְהוּא נַעַר אֶת בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וְאֶת בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה וְכוּ׳ וְכַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And the great tzaddik, the aspect of Yosef, occupies himself with them and lowers himself to them in order to draw them near to the Lord, blessed be He. And this is “And he was a youth with the sons of Bilhah and with the sons of Zilpah,” etc. And Rash״i explained that he would engage in youthful conduct, etc. For the true tzaddik, in the might of his wisdom, lowers himself to them so much that it seems as though he engages in youthful conduct: for he speaks ordinary conversation with them, eats and drinks with them, and sometimes strolls and plays with them. And his entire intention is to draw them near through this to the Lord, blessed be He. And it is understood from his words, of blessed memory, in several places (part 1, section 202; part 2, section 78), how very much the tzaddik lowers himself to the world, all of which is regarded by him as youthful conduct; but his intention is desired by the Lord, blessed be He, for it is to draw those very distant, who cannot be drawn near except through this, near to the Lord, blessed be He. And this is the aspect of “And he was a youth with the sons of Bilhah and with the sons of Zilpah,” etc., as above.

pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן נִקְרָא יוֹסֵף, בְּחִינַת ׳אָסַף אֱלֹקִים אֶת חֶרְפָּתִי׳ שֶׁמְּאַסֵּף וּמְבַטֵּל כָּל הַחֲרָפוֹת וּבּוּשׁוֹת מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל, כִּי מַחֲזִירָם בִּתְשׁוּבָה וּמְקָרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת ׳יוֹסֵף ה׳ לִי בֵּן׳ שֶׁעַל שֵׁם זֶה נִקְרָא יוֹסֵף, הַיְנוּ שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק עוֹסֵק תָּמִיד לְהוֹסִיף וּלְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת חֲדָשׁוֹת בְּכָל פַּעַם וּמְבַקֵּשׁ תָּמִיד מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עַל זֶה, בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף ה׳ לִי בֵּן אַחֵר, שֶׁיּוֹסֵף ה׳ לוֹ בְּכָל פַּעַם תַּלְמִיד חָדָשׁ שֶׁנִּקְרָא בֵּן, כִּי כָּל הַמְלַמֵּד בֶּן חֲבֵרוֹ תּוֹרָה כְּאִלּוּ יְלָדוֹ (סנהדרין צט). וְהוּא מְחַפֵּשׂ וּמְבַקֵּשׁ תָּמִיד לְהוֹסִיף וּלְקָרֵב חֲדָשִׁים בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף ה׳ לִי בֵּן אַחֵר.
pairs.en: And therefore he is called Yosef, the aspect of “God has gathered away my reproach,” for he gathers away and nullifies all the reproaches and shames from Israel, because he brings them back in repentance and draws them near to the Lord, blessed be He. And this is the aspect of “May the Lord add a son for me,” on account of which he is called Yosef. Namely, the tzaddik continually occupies himself with adding and drawing new souls near each time, and continually asks the Lord, blessed be He, for this: the aspect of “May the Lord add another son for me”—that the Lord should add for him each time a new student, who is called a son, for whoever teaches his fellow’s son Torah is as though he begot him (Sanhedrin 99). And he continually searches and seeks to add and draw new ones near, the aspect of “May the Lord add another son for me.”

pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן ׳וְיִשְׂרָאֵל אָהַב אֶת יוֹסֵף מִכָּל בָּנָיו כִּי בֶן זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ׳ שֶׁאָהַב אוֹתוֹ בִּשְׁבִיל זֶה מְאֹד, כִּי הוּא חָפֵץ בָּזֶה לְרַחֵם עַל הַכֹּל וְלַעֲשׂוֹת תַּחְבּוּלוֹת לְקָרֵב הַכֹּל. וְזֶה ׳כִּי בֶן זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ׳. זָקֵן זֶה בְּחִינַת רַחֲמִים גְּדוֹלִים מְאֹד בְּחִינַת זָקֵן מָלֵא רַחֲמִים, בְּחִינַת תְּלֵיסַר תִּקּוּנֵי דִּיקְנָא שֶׁהֵם רַחֲמִים גְּדוֹלִים מְאֹד. הַיְנוּ שֶׁקִּבֵּל מִמֶּנּוּ כָּל שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה מִדּוֹת שֶׁל רַחֲמִים, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת זָקֵן כַּנַּ״ל, שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה הוּא מְרַחֵם עַל הַכֹּל וּמְקָרֵב כֻּלָּם. וְזֶה שֶׁתִּרְגֵּם אֻנְקְלוֹס, כִּי בֶן זְקֻנִים, כִּי בַר חַכִּים הוּא לֵיהּ. בַּר חַכִּים וַדַּאי, כִּי צְרִיכִין לָזֶה חָכְמָה גְּדוֹלָה חָכְמָה נִפְלָאָה חָכְמָה עֲמֻקָּה מְאֹד מְאֹד כְּדֵי שֶׁיּוּכַל לַעֲשׂוֹת כֵּלִים וְצִמְצוּמִים כָּאֵלֶּה שֶׁיּוּכַל לְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת רְחוֹקוֹת כָּאֵלֶּה חוֹלִים כָּאֵלֶּה וּלְהַכְנִיס בָּהֶם הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת וְכַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And therefore “And Israel loved Yosef more than all his sons, for he was a son of old age to him”: he loved him very much because of this, for he desires this, to have compassion upon everyone and to devise stratagems to draw everyone near. And this is “For he was a son of old age to him.” An elder is the aspect of very great mercies, the aspect of an elder full of mercies, the aspect of the thirteen rectifications of the beard, which are very great mercies. Namely, he received from him all thirteen attributes of mercy, which are the aspect of an elder, as above, for through this he has compassion upon everyone and draws them all near. And this is what Onkelos translated: “For he was a son of old age”—“for he was a wise son to him.” A wise son indeed, for this requires great wisdom, wondrous wisdom, very, very deep wisdom, so that he can make such vessels and contractions that he can draw such distant souls near, such ill people, and bring apprehensions of Godliness into them, as above.

qualifiedAfter.en: And therefore “And Israel loved Yosef more than all his sons, for he was a son of old age to him”: he loved him very much because of this, for he desires this, to have compassion upon everyone and to devise stratagems to draw everyone near. pairs.he: וְזֶה ׳וְעָשָׂה לוֹ כְּתֹנֶת פַּסִּים׳. שֶׁפֵּרוּשׁוֹ כְּלִי מֵילַת שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ גְּוָנִין יָפִים, בְּחִינַת צֶמֶר וּתְכֵלֶת, הַיְנוּ מֵחֲמַת שֶׁהָיָה עוֹסֵק בָּזֶה לְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת הָרְחוֹקוֹת, עַל כֵּן עָשָׂה לוֹ לְבוּשִׁים נִפְלָאִים שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּם גְּוָנִין יָפִים וּנְכוֹנִים וְנִפְלָאִים בְּחִינַת כְּתֹנֶת פַּסִּים. הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת צִמְצוּמִים נִפְלָאִים, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת כֵּלִים וּלְבוּשִׁים כְּדֵי שֶׁיּוּכַל לְהַמְשִׁיךְ עַל יָדָם הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת אֲפִלּוּ לְהָרְחוֹקִים מְאֹד וְכַנַּ״ל. כִּי בְּחִינַת הַצִּמְצוּמִים הַנַּ״ל שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת חָכְמָה תַּתָּאָה הַנַּ״ל הֵם כְּלוּלִים מִכָּל הַגְּוָנִין, שֶׁהֵם כְּלַל כָּל הַכֵּלִים וְהַלְּבוּשִׁין שֶׁל הַקְּדֻשָּׁה שֶׁעַל יָדָם מַשִּׂיגִין אֱלֹקוּתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ כַּמָּה פְּעָמִים, וְאִיהִי כְּלִילָא מִכָּל הַגְּוָנִין.
pairs.en: And this is “And he made him a striped tunic,” whose meaning is a garment of fine wool with beautiful colors, the aspect of wool and blue thread. Namely, because he occupied himself with this, drawing distant souls near, therefore he made him wondrous garments with beautiful, proper, and wondrous colors, the aspect of a striped tunic. Namely, the aspect of wondrous contractions, which are the aspect of vessels and garments, so that through them he can draw apprehensions of Godliness even to those very distant, as above. For the aspect of these contractions, which are the aspect of the lower wisdom mentioned above, comprise all the colors, which are the totality of all the vessels and garments of holiness through which His Godliness, blessed be He, is apprehended, as is written in the holy Zohar several times: “And she comprises all the colors.”

Namely, because he occupied himself with this, drawing distant souls near, therefore he made him wondrous garments with beautiful, proper, and wondrous colors, the aspect of a striped tunic. Namely, the aspect of wondrous contractions, which are the aspect of vessels and garments, so that through them he can draw apprehensions of Godliness even to those very distant, as above. For the aspect of these contractions, which are the aspect of the lower wisdom mentioned above, comprise all the colors, which are the totality of all the vessels and garments of holiness through which His Godliness, blessed be He, is apprehended, as is written in the holy Zohar several times: “And she comprises all the colors.”

pairs.he: וְזֶה שֶׁחָלְמוּ ׳וְהִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים בְּתוֹךְ הַשָּׂדֶה׳ שֶׁפֵּרוּשׁוֹ קְשָׁרִים, הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת צִמְצוּמִים הַנַּ״ל שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת קְשָׁרִים, כִּי הַצִּמְצוּם בְּחִינַת קֶשֶׁר. הַיְנוּ שֶׁכֻּלָּם הָיוּ עוֹסְקִים בָּזֶה, שֶׁהָיוּ מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים וְעוֹשִׂים קְשָׁרִים וְצִמְצוּמִים כְּדֵי לְהַמְשִׁיךְ עַל יָדָם הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת, אֲבָל הַצִּמְצוּמִים וְהַכֵּלִים שֶׁל יוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק עָלָה עַל כֻּלָּם, בִּבְחִינַת (שם) ׳וְהִנֵּה קָמָה אֲלֻמָּתִי וְגַם נִצָּבָה׳ וְכוּ׳ שֶׁהַקֶּשֶׁר וְהַצִּמְצוּם שֶׁלּוֹ קָמָה וְגַם נִצְּבָה לָעַד וּלָנֶצַח.
pairs.en: And this is what they dreamed: “And behold, we are binding sheaves within the field,” whose meaning is bonds—namely, the aspect of the contractions mentioned above, which are the aspect of bonds, for contraction is the aspect of a bond. Namely, they all occupied themselves with this, binding sheaves and making bonds and contractions in order to draw through them apprehensions of Godliness. But the contractions and vessels of Yosef the tzaddik surpassed them all, in the aspect of (ibid.) “And behold, my sheaf arose and also stood,” etc., for his bond and contraction arose and also stood for all time and eternity.

But the contractions and vessels of Yosef the tzaddik surpassed them all, in the aspect of (ibid.) “And behold, my sheaf arose and also stood,” etc., for his bond and contraction arose and also stood for all time and eternity.

pairs.he: ׳וְהִנֵּה תְסֻבֶּינָה אֲלֻמּוֹתֵיכֶם וַתִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶיןָ לַאֲלֻמָּתִי׳. שֶׁכֻּלָּם צְרִיכִין לְקַבֵּל מִמֶּנּוּ הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת עַל יְדֵי הַצִּמְצוּמִים נִפְלָאִים שֶׁעוֹשֶׂה בְּחָכְמָתוֹ הָעֲמֻקָּה עַל יְדֵי שֶׁעוֹסֵק לְקָרֵב נְפָשׁוֹת תָּמִיד. שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה זָכָה שֶׁאֲפִלּוּ הַצַּדִּיקִים הַגְּדוֹלִים שֶׁעוֹסְקִין בָּזֶה לְהַשִּׂיג הַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת עַל יְדֵי הַצִּמְצוּמִים, גַּם הֵם צְרִיכִין לְקַבֵּל מִמֶּנּוּ, כִּי שֶׁלּוֹ עוֹלֶה עַל כֻּלָּם בִּבְחִינַת (משלי לא) ׳רַבּוֹת בָּנוֹת עָשׂוּ חָיִל וְאַתְּ עָלִית עַל כֻּלָּנָה׳ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר עַל הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת הַגָּדוֹל בְּיוֹתֵר שֶׁעוֹסֵק לַעֲשׂוֹת כֵּלִים וּלְבוּשִׁים וּלְהַמְשִׁיךְ תּוֹרָה בְּחָכְמָה אֲמִתִּית כָּזֹאת עַד שֶׁיּוּכְלוּ לְהִתְקָרֵב הַכֹּל לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת הַשֶּׁבַח שֶׁל אֵשֶׁת חַיִל וְכוּ׳. בְּחִינַת דָּרְשָׁה צֶמֶר וּפִשְׁתִּים, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת כֵּלִים וּלְבוּשִׁים לְהַשָּׂגוֹת אֱלֹקוּת וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: “And behold, your sheaves came around and bowed to my sheaf”: that they all need to receive from him apprehensions of Godliness through the wondrous contractions that he makes with his deep wisdom, through continually occupying himself with drawing souls near. Through this he attained that even the great tzaddikim who occupy themselves with this, to attain apprehensions of Godliness through contractions, also need to receive from him, for his surpasses them all, in the aspect of (Proverbs 31) “Many daughters have done valiantly, but you have surpassed them all.” This is said concerning the greatest true tzaddik, who occupies himself with making vessels and garments and drawing Torah with such true wisdom that everyone can draw near to the Lord, blessed be He. This is the aspect of the praise of a woman of valor, etc., the aspect of “She sought wool and flax,” which are the aspect of vessels and garments for apprehensions of Godliness, etc.

Through this he attained that even the great tzaddikim who occupy themselves with this, to attain apprehensions of Godliness through contractions, also need to receive from him, for his surpasses them all, in the aspect of (Proverbs 31) “Many daughters have done valiantly, but you have surpassed them all.” This is said concerning the greatest true tzaddik, who occupies himself with making vessels and garments and drawing Torah with such true wisdom that everyone can draw near to the Lord, blessed be He. This is the aspect of the praise of a woman of valor, etc., the aspect of “She sought wool and flax,” which are the aspect of vessels and garments for apprehensions of Godliness, etc.

pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת ׳הָיְתָה כָּאֳנִיּוֹת סוֹחֵר מִמֶּרְחָק׳ וְכוּ׳ וַתָּקָם בְּעוֹד לַיְלָה וַתִּתֵּן טֶרֶף לְבֵיתָהּ׳ וְכוּ׳. שֶׁבְּתוֹקֶף חֶשְׁכַת לֵיל הַגָּלוּת שֶׁל נְפָשׁוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל הִיא נוֹתֶנֶת לָהֶם טֶרֶף וְכוּ׳. וְכֵן הוֹלֵךְ וְסוֹבֵב כָּל הַשֶּׁבַח הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַזֶּה. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת ׳נוֹדַע בַּשְּׁעָרִים בַּעְלָהּ׳, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת שְׁעָרִין דְּאָתְוַון דְּאוֹרַיְתָא, הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת צִמְצוּמִים הַנַּ״ל שֶׁהוּא מַמְשִׁיךְ בְּחָכְמָתוֹ, שֶׁעַל יָדָם נוֹדַע הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בָּעוֹלָם, בְּחִינַת נוֹדַע בַּשְּׁעָרִים בַּעְלָהּ וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of “She was like merchant ships, from afar,” etc., “And she arose while it was still night and gave food to her household,” etc. For in the intensity of the darkness of the night of exile of the souls of Israel, she gives them food, etc. And thus this entire holy praise proceeds and revolves. And this is the aspect of “Her husband is known in the gates,” which are the aspect of gates of the letters of Torah—namely, the aspect of these contractions which he draws with his wisdom, through which the Lord, blessed be He, is known in the world, the aspect of “Her husband is known in the gates,” etc.

qualifiedAfter.en: And this is the aspect of “She was like merchant ships, from afar,” etc., “And she arose while it was still night and gave food to her household,” etc. For in the intensity of the darkness of the night of exile of the souls of Israel, she gives them food, etc. And thus this entire holy praise proceeds and revolves. And this is the aspect of “Her husband is known in the gates,” which are the aspect of gates of the letters of Torah—namely, the aspect of these contractions which he draws with his wisdom, through which the Lord, blessed be He, is known in the world, the aspect of “Her husband is known in the gates,” etc.

pairs.he: וְזֶה ׳פִּיהָ פָּתְחָה בְחָכְמָה וְתוֹרַת חֶסֶד עַל לְשׁוֹנָהּ׳. וְדָרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (סוטה מ״ט) זֶה הַלּוֹמֵד תּוֹרָה עַל מְנַת לְלַמְּדָהּ, הַיְנוּ כַּנַּ״ל, שֶׁמְּלַמֵּד תּוֹרָתוֹ לַאֲחֵרִים לְקָרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְזֶה ׳צוֹפִיָּה הֲלִיכוֹת בֵּיתָהּ׳, שֶׁצּוֹפֶה הָלוֹךְ בֵּיתוֹ אֵיךְ יִתְנַהֵג לָעוֹלָם בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁלֹּא תִּכְבֶּה נֵרוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד שֶׁיִּהְיֶה נִשְׁאָר הַשְׁאַרַת חָכְמָתוֹ לְדוֹרֵי דּוֹרוֹת לָנֶצַח. כִּי ׳וְלֶחֶם עַצְלוּת לֹא תֹאכֵל׳, כִּי לַחְמוֹ וְתוֹרָתוֹ אֵינוֹ לֶחֶם עַצְלוּת ח״ו, כִּי הָיָה זָרִיז מְאֹד מְאֹד בַּעֲבוֹדָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ עַל כֵּן ׳קָמוּ בָנֶיהָ וַיְאַשְּׁרוּהָ׳, הֵם הַתַּלְמִידִים שֶׁנִּקְרָאִים בָּנִים שֶׁקֵּרְבָם לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ. ׳בַּעְלָהּ וַיְהַלְלָהּ׳ זֶה הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, כִּי הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ מַסְכִּים עַל זֶה, כִּי חָפֵץ בָּזֶה שֶׁיְּקָרְבוּ כֻּלָּם אֵלָיו, כִּי חָפֵץ חֶסֶד הוּא. וְעַל כֵּן רַבּוֹת בָּנוֹת עָשׂוּ חָיִל וְאַתְּ עָלִית עַל כֻּלָּנָה וְכַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And this is “She opened her mouth with wisdom, and the Torah of kindness is upon her tongue.” And our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded (Sotah 49): this is one who studies Torah in order to teach it—namely, as above, who teaches his Torah to others to draw them near to the Lord, blessed be He. And this is “She watches the ways of her household”: he watches the course of his household, how he should conduct himself forever in a manner in which his lamp will never be extinguished, and in which the enduring remainder of his wisdom will remain for generations of generations, forever. For “And she shall not eat the bread of idleness,” for his bread and his Torah are not the bread of idleness, Heaven forbid, for he was very, very diligent in His service, blessed be He. Therefore “her sons arose and called her fortunate”: these are the students, called sons, whom he drew near to the Lord, blessed be He. “Her husband, and he praised her”—this is the Lord, blessed be He, for the Lord, blessed be He, agrees to this, for He desires this, that they should draw everyone near to Him, for He desires kindness. And therefore “Many daughters have done valiantly, but you have surpassed them all,” as above.

pairs.he: ״וַיֵּשֶׁב יַעֲקֹב בְּאֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו״
pairs.en: “And Yaakov dwelt in the land of his father’s sojournings.”

pairs.he: דָּרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בְּמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה ׳מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו׳ לְשׁוֹן גֵּרִים שֶׁהָיָה יַעֲקֹב מְגַיֵּר גֵּרִים. וְאִיתָא בִּדְבָרָיו זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה בְּסִימָן רכח שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בִּקֵּשׁ יַעֲקֹב לֵישֵׁב בְּשַׁלְוָה קָפַץ עָלָיו רָגְזוֹ שֶׁל יוֹסֵף, כִּי זֶה שֶׁעוֹסֵק לְגַיֵּר גֵּרִים, בְּהֶכְרֵחַ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לוֹ יִסּוּרִים וּמַחֲלֹקֶת וְכוּ׳ וְכֵן הוּא בְּכָל אָדָם.
pairs.en: Our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded in Midrash Rabbah “his father’s sojournings” as an expression of converts, for Yaakov would convert converts. And it is stated in his words, of blessed memory, in section 228 [candidate printed numeral רכח], that this is the aspect of what our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said: Yaakov wished to dwell in tranquility; the trouble of Yosef sprang upon him. For one who occupies himself with converting converts necessarily has suffering and dispute, etc.; and so it is with every person.

qualifiedAfter.en: Our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded in Midrash Rabbah “his father’s sojournings” as an expression of converts, for Yaakov would convert converts. For one who occupies himself with converting converts necessarily has suffering and dispute, etc.; and so it is with every person.

pairs.he: שֶׁאֵלּוּ הַגֵּרִים וּבַעֲלֵי הַתְּשׁוּבָה הָרוֹצִים לָשׁוּב אֶל ה׳ עַל יְדֵי הַצַּדִּיק, בְּהֶכְרֵחַ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה עֲלֵיהֶם גַּם כֵּן כַּמָּה מִינֵי מַחֲלֹקֶת וְיִסּוּרִים וְהִתְגַּבְּרוּת וְכוּ׳ בְּכָל פַּעַם, כִּי אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהִתְקָרֵב בֶּאֱמֶת לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ כִּי אִם עַל יְדֵי זֶה, כַּמְבֹאָר בִּדְבָרֵינוּ הַרְבֵּה בָּזֶה. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר בְּסִימָן ע״ב שֶׁהוּא לְהִתְחַזֵּק בְּכָל פַּעַם כְּנֶגֶד הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע וְכוּ׳ עַיֵּן שָׁם.
pairs.en: For these converts and penitents who wish to return to the Lord through the tzaddik necessarily also undergo several kinds of dispute, suffering, and overpowering, etc., each time. For it is impossible to draw near in truth to the Lord, blessed be He, except through this, as explained at length in our words on this. And as explained in section 72, which is to strengthen oneself each time against the evil inclination, etc.; see there.

qualifiedAfter.en: For these converts and penitents who wish to return to the Lord through the tzaddik necessarily also undergo several kinds of dispute, suffering, and overpowering, etc., each time.
