qualifiedAfter.en: Therefore he told them his praises, so that they would know to bind themselves with him.

pairs.he: שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת מַה שֶּׁסִּפֵּר לָהֶם חֲלוֹמוֹ שֶׁרָאָה, וְהִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים בְּתוֹךְ הַשָּׂדֶה וְהִנֵּה תְסֻבֶּינָה אֲלֻמּוֹתֵיכֶם וַתִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶיןָ לַאֲלֻמָּתִי. הַיְנוּ שֶׁרָאָה שֶׁכֻּלָּם עוֹסְקִים בַּעֲבוֹדָתָם וּמְיַחֲדִים יִחוּדִים וּמְקַשְּׁרִים קְשָׁרִים דַּרְגָּא בְּדַרְגָּא וְעוֹלָם בְּעוֹלָם שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים, שֶׁהֵם קְשָׁרִים וַאֲגֻדּוֹת בְּחִינַת יִחוּדִים וּקְשָׁרִים קְדוֹשִׁים שֶׁנַּעֲשִׂים בְּעוֹלָמוֹת עֶלְיוֹנִים עַל יְדֵי עֲבוֹדַת הַצַּדִּיקִים הָאֲמִתִּיִּים.
pairs.en: This is the aspect of what he told them of his dream that he saw: “And behold, we are binding sheaves within the field, and behold, your sheaves came around and bowed to my sheaf.” Namely, he saw that they all occupied themselves with their service, effecting unifications and binding bonds, level to level and world to world. This is the aspect of binding sheaves, which are bonds and bundles, the aspect of holy unifications and bonds made in the upper worlds through the service of the true tzaddikim.

This is the aspect of binding sheaves, which are bonds and bundles, the aspect of holy unifications and bonds made in the upper worlds through the service of the true tzaddikim.

pairs.he: ״וְהִנֵּה תְסֻבֶּינָה אֲלֻמּוֹתֵיכֶם וַתִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶיןָ לַאֲלֻמָּתִי״, שֶׁכָּל עֲבוֹדָתָם צְרִיכִין לָבוֹא לְהַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת וּלְהִכָּלֵל בּוֹ, כִּי עִקַּר הַתַּכְלִית כָּל הַקְּשָׁרִים וְהַיִּחוּדִים הוּא לְהַעֲלוֹת הַכֹּל לְהַשְּׁכִינָה, שֶׁזֶּה נַעֲשֶׂה רַק עַל יְדֵי הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת בְּחִינַת יוֹסֵף כַּנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: “And behold, your sheaves came around and bowed to my sheaf”: that all their service needs to come to the true tzaddik and be incorporated within him. For the principal ultimate purpose of all the bonds and unifications is to raise everything to the Shechinah, which is done only through the true tzaddik, the aspect of Yosef, as above.

pairs.he: אֲבָל הֵם לֹא רָצוּ לְהַאֲמִין בָּזֶה וְאָמְרוּ ״הֲמָלֹךְ תִּמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ אִם מָשׁוֹל תִּמְשֹׁל בָּנוּ וַיּוֹסִפוּ עוֹד שְׂנֹא אֹתוֹ עַל חֲלֹמֹתָיו וְעַל דְּבָרָיו״. כִּי אוֹמְרִים שֶׁכָּל מַה שֶּׁהַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת מְגַלֶּה תּוֹרָתוֹ וְחִדּוּשָׁיו וְהִתְעוֹרְרוּתוֹ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, כַּוָּנָתוֹ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם בִּשְׁבִיל הִתְנַשְּׂאוּת לִמְלֹךְ וְלִמְשֹׁל בָּהֶם, וְחוֹלְקִין עָלָיו וְרוֹדְפִין אוֹתוֹ בְּכָל מִינֵי רְדִיפוֹת כְּמוֹ אֲחֵי יוֹסֵף שֶׁרָצוּ לְהָרְגוֹ וּלְהַשְׁלִיכוֹ לַבּוֹר.
pairs.en: But they did not want to believe this and said, “Shall you indeed reign over us, or indeed rule over us? And they added further to hating him for his dreams and for his words.” For they say that everything that the true tzaddik reveals—his Torah, his new insights, and his awakening—to the children of Israel, his intention, Heaven forbid, is for self-exaltation, to reign and to rule over them. And they dispute with him and pursue him with every kind of persecution, like Yosef’s brothers, who wanted to kill him and cast him into the pit.

pairs.he: וַאֲפִלּוּ הָאוֹחֲזִין עִמּוֹ קְצָת וּמְרַחֲמִין עָלָיו אוֹמְרִים לְמָכְרוֹ בְּעֶשְׂרִים כָּסֶף, דְּהַיְנוּ שֶׁמּוֹכְרִין אֶת הַצַּדִּיק וּמַעֲלִימִין אוֹתוֹ מִן הָעוֹלָם בִּשְׁבִיל הַכֶּסֶף בִּשְׁבִיל תַּאֲוַת מָמוֹן, כִּי כְּשֶׁפּוֹגְמִין בְּהַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת אֲזַי אֵינוֹ עוֹלֶה לִמּוּדוֹ לְהַצַּדִּיק, וְאָז נַעֲשֶׂה מִלִּמּוּדוֹ ל״ט מְלָאכוֹת כַּנַּ״ל שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת בְּזֵעַת אַפֶּיךָ תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת תַּאֲוַת מָמוֹן. וְנִמְצָא שֶׁעַל יְדֵי שֶׁפּוֹגֵם בְּהַצַּדִּיק נוֹפֵל לְתַאֲוַת מָמוֹן, וְכַמְבֹאָר עִנְיַן זֶה בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר בְּהַתּוֹרָה ׳צִוִּיתָ צֶדֶק׳ (סימן כג), שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף בְּכֶסֶף, כִּי נוֹפְלִים לְתַאֲוַת מָמוֹן עַל יְדֵי שֶׁפּוֹגְמִין בִּכְבוֹד הַצַּדִּיק וְכַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And even those who side with him somewhat and have compassion on him say to sell him for twenty pieces of silver: namely, they sell the tzaddik and conceal him from the world for the money, for the desire for money. For when one blemishes the true tzaddik, then his study does not ascend to the tzaddik, and then his study becomes the thirty-nine labors, as above, which is the aspect of “By the sweat of your brow you shall eat bread,” which is the aspect of the desire for money. And thus, by blemishing the tzaddik he falls into the desire for money, and as this matter is explained elsewhere in the Torah teaching “You commanded righteousness” (section 23), this is the aspect of the selling of Yosef for money, for one falls into the desire for money through blemishing the honor of the tzaddik, as above.

pairs.he: כתב הרמח״ל (אוצרות רמח״ל) פרשת שמיני וז״ל: אמרו חז״ל כשם שהעוף אינו פורח אלא בכנפיו כך ישראל אינם יכולים לעשות שום דבר בלתי חוקים. והסוד הוא, ישראל עושים תיקונים. אבל אולי לא יעלו ויפרחו למקומם שהס״א תעכב. לזה צריך כח החוקים שממש עושים פעולת העוף הפורח בכנפיו, ובכח התקנה שלהם מעמידים אורות אלו להציל התיקונים מיד הס״א ולהעלותם למקומם. ע״כ.
pairs.en: The Ramchal wrote (Otzros HaRamchal), parsha Shemini, and these are his words: Our Sages, of blessed memory, said: Just as a bird does not fly except with its wings, so Israel cannot do anything without statutes. And the secret is this: Israel perform rectifications. But perhaps they will not rise and fly to their place, for the sitra achra would obstruct. For this the power of the statutes is needed, which actually perform the action of a bird flying with its wings; and by the power of their enactment they set up these lights to save the rectifications from the hand of the sitra achra and to raise them to their place. Thus far.

pairs.he: ועוד כתב הרמח״ל בפרשת פקודי שם: התיקונים הראשיים הם צריכים להעשות על ידי היותר חשובים שבישראל, והם מתקנים בשביל כל ישראל. ולכן בצלאל עשה המשכן שהיה משבט יהודה, החשוב שבשבטים והוא תיקן בשביל כולם. ע״כ. וכתב הרמח״ל בתיקונים חדשים (תיקון ז׳): וכל חכם לב בכם יבואו ויעשו, לאתקנא בגין כלא, ואית דאיהו לחודיה יכיל לאתקנא בגין כל ישראל, כד״א ויקם משה את המשכן, דהא כל אלין עברין אתעבידו בתיקונא דכל חד בדיליה, אבל כלא לא אשתלים ולא אתתקן אלא ע״י דמשה דאיהו שקיל ככל ישראל. מצדיקי הרבים אלין חכמי לב דאתמר דמתקני תיקוניה לכלהו ישראל, אבל המשכילים אלין משה ותרין משיחין דקיימין לאשתא על כלהו אחרנין, בגין ויביאו את המשכן אל משה, דהא איהו נטיל תדיר כל תיקונא דכלהו לאשלמא מילין כדקא יאות.
pairs.en: And the Ramchal further wrote there in the parsha Pekuday: The principal rectifications must be performed by the most distinguished among Israel, and they rectify on behalf of all Israel. And therefore Betzalel made the Tabernacle, for he was from the tribe of Yehudah, the most distinguished of the tribes, and he rectified on behalf of all of them. Thus far. And the Ramchal wrote in Tikunim Chadashim (tikun 7): “And every wise-hearted person among you shall come and make”—to rectify on behalf of all; and there is one who by himself can rectify on behalf of all Israel, as it is said, “And Moshe erected the Tabernacle.” For all these limbs were made in the rectification of each individual in his own [part], but the whole was not completed and not rectified except through Moshe, who is equal to all Israel. “Those who bring the many to righteousness”—these are the wise-hearted of whom it is said that they prepare its rectifications for all Israel; but “the enlightened”—these are Moshe and the two Messiahs who stand to oversee all the others [following the cited source; the anthology’s verb differs], because “And they brought the Tabernacle to Moshe,” for he continually takes all the rectification of them all, to complete matters as is fitting.

And therefore Betzalel made the Tabernacle, for he was from the tribe of Yehudah, the most distinguished of the tribes, and he rectified on behalf of all of them. Thus far. pairs.he: וכתב רבי אברהם אזולאי ז״ל בחסד לאברהם (מעין א׳ נהר שביעי): אפילו בדורות האחרונים כל מי שמזכך עצמו השכינה עמו, והיא נוטלת שבח כל התחתונים ושאר כשרי ישראל ותפילתם ועבודתם על ידי הכשר ההוא ראש הדגל. ע״כ. וכתב היערות דבש (חלק א׳ דרוש ט׳ לפני סופו): כמעט אבדה תקוה להעלות התפילה לשמים, אמנם בחסדו הותיר לנו שריד אשר אין דור שאין בו צדיקים מבני עליה לא יחסרו מל״ו צדיקים, א״כ כל התפלות סובבות לתפילתן של צדיקים ומתדבקות בתפילתן, והוא שאין מסך מבדיל בינו לבין השם, ע״י תפילתו גם תפילת אחרים עולה. ע״כ.
pairs.en: And Rabbi Avraham Azulai, of blessed memory, wrote in Chesed L’Avraham (spring 1, seventh stream): Even in the later generations, everyone who purifies himself has the Shechinah with him; and she takes the praise of all those below and the other upright people of Israel, and their prayer and their service, through that upright person, the head of the banner. Thus far. And Yaaros Devash wrote (Part One, discourse 9, before its conclusion): Hope of raising prayer to Heaven has nearly been lost. However, in His kindness He left us a remnant, for there is no generation in which there are not tzaddikim who are people of ascent; they will not be fewer than thirty-six tzaddikim. Therefore all the prayers revolve around the prayer of the tzaddikim and cleave to their prayer; and he is one for whom there is no screen separating him from Hashem. Through his prayer the prayer of others also rises. Thus far.

pairs.he: במגלה עמוקות כאן פרשת וישב (ויגער בו אביו) כתב: רב ברכות לראש צדיק, הן הן שלשה תפילות ביום א׳, שהוא המקבל ועושה עטרה לראש צדיק דלעילא יסוד עולם. שעל זה אמר יהודה מה בצע כי נהרוג את אחינו, ר״ל, מה נעשה מן ג׳ ברכות שבכל יום ויום שרמוזין במלת בצ״ע, ערב בוקר צהרים, ר״ל היאך יעלו ברכות שלנו בכל ג׳ תפילות שבכל יום בוקר צהרים ערבית, כשנהרוג את אחינו. כמ״ש יהודה איך אעלה אל אבי והנער איננו אתי. וכן גדול הבית צווח. הילד איננו ואני אנה אני בא, הלא דרך השער אנו נכנסים. וזה סוד כי ׳בן זקונים׳, ר״ל, מה תקנו אבות העולם שהוא התפילות, ׳הוא לו׳ הכל הולך דרך יוסף. ע״כ.
pairs.en: In Megaleh Amukos here, parsha Vayaishev (“And his father rebuked him”), he wrote: “Abundant blessings upon the head of the righteous”—these are the three prayers in one day, for he is the receiver and makes a crown for the head of the supernal tzaddik, the foundation of the world. Concerning this Yehudah said, “What profit is there if we kill our brother,” meaning: What shall we do with the three blessings that are in each and every day, which are alluded to in the word בצ״ע—“evening, morning, noon”—meaning: How will our blessings ascend in all three prayers in each day, morning, noon, evening, if we kill our brother? As Yehudah said, “How shall I go up to my father, and the youth is not with me?” And likewise the eldest of the household cries out: “The child is not here, and I, where shall I go?”—do we not enter through the gate? And this is the secret of “for [he was] a son of old age.” Meaning: What the fathers of the world instituted, namely the prayers—“he is to him”—everything goes through Yosef. Thus far.

pairs.he: ״וַיּוֹסִפוּ עוֹד שְׂנֹא אֹתוֹ עַל חֲלֹמֹתָיו וְעַל דְּבָרָיו״ (ל״ז, ח) עַל פִּי הַתּוֹרָה ״חֲדִי רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן״, עַיֵּן שָׁם בְּסִימָן סא וְשָׁם מְבֹאָר שֶׁעַל יְדֵי פְּגַם אֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים עוֹלִים עֲשָׁנִים סְרוּחִים וְכוּ׳, וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נֶחְלְקָה עֲצָתוֹ וְכוּ׳. וְזֶה עִקַּר מְרִירַת הַצָּרָה שֶׁל חֻרְבַּן בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וְגָלוּת יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַרְצָם, שֶׁהַכֹּל הָיָה עַל יְדֵי שֶׁפָּגְמוּ בֶּאֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב וַיִּהְיוּ מַלְעִבִים בְּמַלְאֲכֵי הָאֱלֹקִים, וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בְּמַסֶּכֶת שַׁבָּת. וּמֵאָז אֵין לָנוּ שׁוּם עֵצָה. כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב אָבְדָה עֵצָה מִבָּנִים וְכוּ׳. וְזֶהוּ אָבְדָה עֵצָה מִבָּנִים נִסְרְחָה חָכְמָתָם, הַיְנוּ עַל יְדֵי עֲשָׁנִים סְרוּחִים שֶׁמְּבַלְבְּלִין הַחָכְמָה שֶׁבַּמֹּחַ בְּחִינַת נִסְרְחָה חָכְמָתָם, עַל יְדֵי זֶה אָבְדָה עֵצָה מִבָּנִים וְכַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: “And they continued still further to hate him on account of his dreams and on account of his words” (37:8), according to the teaching “Chadi Rabbi Shimon”; see there in section 61, where it is explained that through a blemish in faith in the sages, foul vapors rise, etc., and through this his counsel becomes divided, etc. And this is the chief bitterness of the distress of the destruction of the Holy Temple and Israel’s exile from their land, for it all came about through their blemishing faith in the sages, as it is written, “And they mocked the messengers of God,” and as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said in Tractate Shabbos. And since then we have no counsel at all, as it is written, “Counsel has been lost from the children,” etc. And this is “Counsel has been lost from the children; their wisdom has become foul”: namely, through foul vapors that confuse the wisdom in the mind, the aspect of “their wisdom has become foul,” through this “counsel has been lost from the children,” as above.

pairs.he: וְעַל זֶה צוֹעֵק דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם, עַד אָנָה אָשִׁית עֵצוֹת בְּנַפְשִׁי וְכוּ׳, שֶׁזֶּה נֶאֱמַר עַל הָאַרְבַּע גָּלֻיּוֹת, כְּמוֹ שֶׁפֵּרֵשׁ רש״י שָׁם שֶׁעִקַּר הַצָּרָה מַה שֶּׁאֵין יְכוֹלִין לָשִׁית עֵצוֹת בְּנַפְשׁוֹ כָּל אֶחָד עַל מַה שֶּׁצָּרִיךְ.
pairs.en: And concerning this King Dovid, peace be upon him, cries out, “How long shall I set counsels in my soul,” etc.; this was said about the four exiles, as Rashi explained there: the chief distress is that people cannot set counsels in their souls, each concerning what he needs.

pairs.he: כִּי הָאָדָם צָרִיךְ עֵצוֹת הַרְבֵּה בָּזֶה הָעוֹלָם כָּל יְמֵי חַיָּיו כְּדֵי שֶׁיּוּכַל לְהַצִּיל עַצְמוֹ מִמַּה שֶּׁצָּרִיךְ לְהִנָּצֵל שֶׁלֹּא יְאַבֵּד שְׁתֵּי עוֹלָמוֹת חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, כִּי מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ מֹחַ בְּקָדְקֳדוֹ רָאוּי לָשִׁית לֵב עַל אוֹדוֹתָיו מַה נַעֲשֶׂה עִמּוֹ בָּזֶה הָעוֹלָם. וְעַל מַה בָּא לָזֶה הָעוֹלָם לַעֲבֹר בְּדַאֲגוֹת וְצָרוֹת וִיגוֹנוֹת וְכַעַס וּמַכְאוֹבוֹת כָּאֵלֶּה וְסוֹפוֹ לֶעָפָר יָשׁוּב לִמְקוֹם עָפָר רִמָּה וְתוֹלֵעָה. וּמִי יוֹדֵעַ אֵיךְ יֵצֵא מִשְׁפָּטוֹ וְדִינוֹ בְּיוֹם הַדִּין הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא, כִּי גָּדוֹל יוֹם ה׳ הוּא וְנוֹרָא מְאֹד, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, אָיֹם וְנוֹרָא הוּא וּמִי יְכִילֶנּוּ. בְּוַדַּאי צָרִיךְ כָּל אָדָם לְפַקֵּחַ עַל עֲסָקָיו וְלָשִׁית עֵצוֹת בְּנַפְשׁוֹ אוּלַי יוּכַל לְמַלֵּט נַפְשׁוֹ.
pairs.en: For a person needs many counsels in this world throughout all the days of his life, so that he can rescue himself from what he must escape, lest he lose both his worlds, God forbid. For whoever has a mind in his head ought to give thought to his affairs: what is happening to him in this world, and for what did he come into this world—to pass through such anxieties, troubles, griefs, anger and pains, and in the end return to dust, to a place of dust, maggots and worms? And who knows how his judgment and verdict will come out on the great and awesome Day of Judgment? For “great is the day of Hashem, and very awesome,” as it is written, “It is fearsome and awesome, and who can endure it?” Certainly every person must oversee his affairs and set counsels in his soul; perhaps he can deliver his soul.

And who knows how his judgment and verdict will come out on the great and awesome Day of Judgment? For “great is the day of Hashem, and very awesome,” as it is written, “It is fearsome and awesome, and who can endure it?” Certainly every person must oversee his affairs and set counsels in his soul; perhaps he can deliver his soul.

pairs.he: וְעִקַּר הָעֵצָה שְׁלֵמָה בֶּאֱמֶת הוּא כְּשֶׁזּוֹכֶה לְהַצְלִיחַ עַל יָדָהּ בָּעוֹלָם הַנִּצְחִי. וְעֵצָה כָּזֹאת אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהַשִּׂיג כִּי אִם עַל יְדֵי אֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים וּלְהִתְקָרֵב אֲלֵיהֶם וּלְתַלְמִידֵיהֶם וּלְסִפְרֵיהֶם הַקְּדוֹשִׁים שֶׁהֵם מְלֵאִים עֵצוֹת אֲמִתִּיּוֹת עֵצוֹת עֲמֻקּוֹת. כִּי גַּם בַּעֲבוֹדַת ה׳ בְּעַצְמוֹ יֵשׁ כַּמָּה וְכַמָּה עֵצוֹת שֶׁהַבַּעַל דָּבָר מְעֹרָב בָּהֶם וּמְהַפֵּךְ אוֹתָם לְרַעָה, כִּי הַתּוֹרָה יֵשׁ בָּהּ שְׁנֵי כֹּחוֹת, זָכָה וְכוּ׳, לֹא זָכָה וְכוּ׳ כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, צַדִּיקִים יֵלְכוּ בָם וּפֹשְׁעִים יִכָּשְׁלוּ בָם. וְעַל כֵּן צְרִיכִין לְשַׁמֵּשׁ הַרְבֵּה צַדִּיקִים וּכְשֵׁרִים אֲמִתִּיִּים כְּדֵי לִזְכּוֹת לְעֵצוֹת שְׁלֵמוֹת אֲמִתִּיּוֹת בְּכָל יוֹם וּבְכָל עֵת.
pairs.en: And the essence of genuinely complete counsel is when one merits to succeed through it in the eternal world. And such counsel cannot be attained except through faith in the sages and by drawing close to them, their disciples and their holy books, which are full of true counsels, deep counsels. For even in the service of Hashem itself there are many, many counsels in which the adversary is involved, turning them to evil, for the Torah has two powers within it: if he merits, etc.; if he does not merit, etc., as it is written, “The righteous shall walk in them, and transgressors shall stumble in them.” And therefore one must attend upon many true tzaddikim and upright people in order to merit complete, true counsels every day and at every time.

qualifiedAfter.en: And the essence of genuinely complete counsel is when one merits to succeed through it in the eternal world. pairs.he: כִּי עִקַּר הַקִּלְקוּל הִתְחִיל מֵעֵצוֹת רָעוֹת שֶׁהֵם עֲצַת הַנָּחָשׁ הַקַּדְמוֹנִי בְּחִינַת הַנָּחָשׁ הִשִּׁיאַנִי וְכוּ׳ וּמֵאָז נִתְקַלְקֵל הָעֵצָה וְעִקַּר הַתִּקּוּן הִתְחִיל מֵאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ שֶׁמִּמֶּנּוּ הִתְחִיל הַמְשָׁכַת הַתּוֹרָה בָּעוֹלָם שֶׁנִּקְרֵאת עֵצָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב לִי עֵצָה וְתוּשִׁיָּה. בְּחִינַת תַּרְיַ״ג עֵטִין. כִּי אַבְרָהָם זָכָה שֶׁשְּׁתֵּי כִלְיוֹתָיו נוֹבְעוֹת חָכְמָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה. כִּלְיוֹתָיו דַּיְקָא, כִּי הַכְּלָיוֹת יוֹעֲצוֹת וְשָׁם עִקַּר גְּמַר שְׁלֵמוּת הַחָכְמָה. כְּשֶׁזּוֹכִין עַל יְדֵי הַחָכְמָה לְעֵצוֹת אֲמִתִּיּוֹת שֶׁיִּנָּצֵל עַל יָדָם מֵרַע שֶׁל זֶה הָעוֹלָם וּלְהַצְלִיחַ עַל יָדָם לָנֶצַח.
pairs.en: For the chief corruption began with evil counsels, which are the counsel of the primordial serpent, the aspect of “The serpent deceived me,” etc.; and since then counsel became corrupted. And the chief rectification began with Avraham our forefather, from whom the drawing of Torah into the world began; it is called counsel, as it is written, “Mine are counsel and sound wisdom,” the aspect of the 613 counsels. For Avraham merited that his two kidneys flowed with wisdom, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said. His kidneys specifically, for the kidneys advise, and there is the principal consummation of wisdom’s perfection: when through wisdom one merits true counsels, through which one is rescued from the evil of this world and succeeds through them for eternity.

qualifiedAfter.en: For the chief corruption began with evil counsels, which are the counsel of the primordial serpent, the aspect of “The serpent deceived me,” etc.; and since then counsel became corrupted. pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן אַבְרָהָם זָכָה שֶׁנִּקְרָא יוֹעֵץ לְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא כִּבְיָכוֹל, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב אֶת מִי נוֹעַץ וַיְבִינֵהוּ וְכוּ׳. וּכְתִיב, וְאִישׁ עֲצָתוֹ יוֹדִיעֶנּוּ. שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר עַל אַבְרָהָם. כְּמוֹ שֶׁפֵּרֵשׁ רש״י שָׁם. וְכֵן כָּל הַצַּדִּיקִים נִקְרָאִים יוֹעֲצִים, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, הֵמָּה הַיּוֹצְרִים וְיֹשְׁבֵי נְטָעִים עִם הַמֶּלֶךְ בִּמְלַאכְתּוֹ. כִּי בָּהֶם נִמְלָךְ וְנִתְיַעֵץ בִּבְרִיאַת עוֹלָמוֹ.
pairs.en: And therefore Avraham merited to be called an adviser to the Holy One, blessed be He, as it were, as it is written, “With whom did He take counsel, who gave Him understanding,” etc.; and it is written, “And the man of His counsel shall make it known to Him,” which was said about Avraham, as Rashi explained there. And likewise all the tzaddikim are called advisers, as it is written, “These are the potters and those dwelling among plantations, with the king in his work.” For with them He deliberated and took counsel in creating His world.

qualifiedAfter.en: And therefore Avraham merited to be called an adviser to the Holy One, blessed be He, as it were, as it is written, “With whom did He take counsel, who gave Him understanding,” etc.; and it is written, “And the man of His counsel shall make it known to Him,” which was said about Avraham, as Rashi explained there. And likewise all the tzaddikim are called advisers, as it is written, “These are the potters and those dwelling among plantations, with the king in his work.” For with them He deliberated and took counsel in creating His world.

pairs.he: וְעִקַּר חֻרְבַּן בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וְגָלוּת יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַרְצָם הוּא בְּחִינַת פְּגַם הָעֵצָה שֶׁנֶּחְלְקָה לִשְׁנַיִם, שֶׁבָּא עַל יְדֵי פְּגַם אֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים כַּנַּ״ל, שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה מְגָרְשִׁין יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַרְצָם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר שָׁם. וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה אֵין יְכוֹלִין לְהַמְתִּיק הַדִּין עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים, וְעַל כֵּן עַל יְדֵי זֶה נֶחֱרַב הַבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ.
pairs.en: And the chief destruction of the Holy Temple and Israel’s exile from their land is the aspect of the blemish in counsel, which became divided into two, coming through a blemish in faith in the sages, as above; through this Israel are driven from their land, as explained there. And through this one cannot sweeten judgment through the aspect of the Holy of Holies; and therefore through this the Holy Temple was destroyed.

qualifiedAfter.en: And the chief destruction of the Holy Temple and Israel’s exile from their land is the aspect of the blemish in counsel, which became divided into two, coming through a blemish in faith in the sages, as above; through this Israel are driven from their land, as explained there. And through this one cannot sweeten judgment through the aspect of the Holy of Holies; and therefore through this the Holy Temple was destroyed.

pairs.he: גם צדיקים גדולים מאד יכולים לטעות בענין מחלוקת לחלוק על צדיק אחר ולרדוף אותו
pairs.en: Even very great tzaddikim can err in the matter of controversy, disputing another tzaddik and persecuting him

qualifiedAfter.he: גם צדיקים גדולים מאד יכולים לטעות בענין מחלוקת לחלוק על צדיק אחר ולרדוף אותו
qualifiedAfter.en: Even very great tzaddikim can err in the matter of controversy, disputing another tzaddik and persecuting him

pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת מַחֲלֹקֶת הַשְּׁבָטִים עִם יוֹסֵף שֶׁגָּרַם הַגָּלוּת וְהַחֻרְבָּן, כִּי יוֹסֵף הוּא בְּחִינַת הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת. וְהַשְּׁבָטִים אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהֵם כֻּלָּם קְדוֹשִׁים, אַךְ עַל פִּי כֵן קָפַץ הַשָּׂטָן בֵּינֵיהֶם וְהִטְעָה אוֹתָם בְּעֵצוֹת רָעוֹת כָּאֵלֶּה לִמְכֹּר אֶת יוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of the tribes’ controversy with Yosef, which caused the exile and destruction, for Yosef is the aspect of the true tzaddik. And although the tribes are all holy, nevertheless Satan leapt among them and misled them with such evil counsels, to sell Yosef the tzaddik.

qualifiedAfter.en: And this is the aspect of the tribes’ controversy with Yosef, which caused the exile and destruction, for Yosef is the aspect of the true tzaddik. And although the tribes are all holy, nevertheless Satan leapt among them and misled them with such evil counsels, to sell Yosef the tzaddik.

pairs.he: כִּי גַּם צַדִּיקִים גְּדוֹלִים צְרִיכִים לִשְׁמֹר עַצְמָם מְאֹד וּלְבַקֵּשׁ מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ מְאֹד לְהִנָּצֵל מֵעֵצוֹת נִבְעָרוֹת, בִּפְרָט מֵעִנְיַן מַחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁשָּׁם עִקַּר הִתְגַּבְּרוּת הַשָּׂטָן שֶׁמַּכְנִיס סְבָרוֹת בְּלֵב הַצַּדִּיקִים עַד שֶׁנִּדְמֶה לָהֶם שֶׁהֵם צְרִיכִים לִרְדֹּף אֶת הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת עַד לְחַיָּיו, וְהַכֹּל נִמְשָׁךְ מֵעֲצַת הַנָּחָשׁ שֶׁהִטְעָה אֶת אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן וְהִטְעָה אֶת קַיִן וְהָיָה בַּתְּחִלָּה גָּדוֹל בְּמַעֲלָה מְאֹד, (כמבואר בכתבי האר״י ובחז״ל לברכה) וְהִטְעָה אוֹתוֹ בְּעֵצוֹת רָעוֹת לַהֲרֹג אֶת הֶבֶל. וְכֵן הוּא בְּכָל הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת, וּבִפְרָט הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים קכט.
pairs.en: For even great tzaddikim must guard themselves very carefully and ask Hashem, blessed be He, very earnestly to be rescued from foolish counsels, particularly from the matter of controversy, where Satan’s chief ascendency is: he puts arguments into the hearts of the tzaddikim until it seems to them that they must persecute the true tzaddik to the point of [taking] his life. And it all proceeds from the serpent’s counsel, which misled Adam the first man and misled Kayin, who was initially very great in stature (as explained in the writings of the Ari and in [the words of] our Sages, of blessed memory), and misled him with evil counsels to kill Hevel. And so it is in every controversy, particularly controversy among tzaddikim [printed note marker: 129].

qualifiedAfter.en: For even great tzaddikim must guard themselves very carefully and ask Hashem, blessed be He, very earnestly to be rescued from foolish counsels, particularly from the matter of controversy, where Satan’s chief ascendency is: he puts arguments into the hearts of the tzaddikim until it seems to them that they must persecute the true tzaddik to the point of [taking] his life. pairs.he: וְזֶהוּ ״וְיִשְׁלְחֵהוּ מֵעֵמֶק״. וְדָרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה מֵעֵצָה עֲמֻקָּה שֶׁל הַצַּדִּיק הַקָּבוּר בְּחֶבְרוֹן, כִּי אַתָּה מָרוֹם לְעוֹלָם ה׳ וְיָדוֹ עַל הָעֶלְיוֹנָה תָּמִיד. וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁמָּסַר הַבְּחִירָה לָאָדָם, וְעַל כֵּן הֻכְרַח לַעֲזֹר אֶת הָאָדָם שֶׁיִּבְחַר לוֹ עֵצָה כִּרְצוֹנוֹ, אַךְ עַל פִּי כֵן הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ גּוֹמֵר תָּמִיד כִּרְצוֹנוֹ. (ועין מזה במקום אחר) כִּי עֲצַת ה׳ לְעוֹלָם תַּעֲמֹד וּכְתִיב, כִּי ה׳ צְבָאוֹת יָעָץ וּמִי יָפֵר.
pairs.en: And this is “And he sent him from the valley.” And our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded: from the deep counsel of the tzaddik buried in Chevron, for “You are on high forever, Hashem,” and His hand always has the upper hand. And although He entrusted free choice to man, and therefore was compelled to help the person choose counsel for himself as he wishes, nevertheless Hashem, blessed be He, always brings matters to completion as He wills (and see concerning this elsewhere). For “the counsel of Hashem shall stand forever,” and it is written, “For Hashem of Hosts has counseled, and who shall annul it?”

qualifiedAfter.en: And this is “And he sent him from the valley.” And our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded: from the deep counsel of the tzaddik buried in Chevron, for “You are on high forever, Hashem,” and His hand always has the upper hand. For “the counsel of Hashem shall stand forever,” and it is written, “For Hashem of Hosts has counseled, and who shall annul it?”

pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן כְּשֶׁהִתְוַעֲדוּ הַשְּׁבָטִים עִם יוֹסֵף לֹא הָיָה אֶפְשָׁר לְיוֹסֵף לַחֲזֹר וּלְהִתְחַבֵּר עִמָּהֶם עַד שֶׁהֵבִיאוּ אֶת בִּנְיָמִין, כִּי בִּנְיָמִין הוּא עִקַּר בְּחִינַת תִּקּוּן הָעֵצָה הַשְּׁלֵמָה הָאֲמִתִּית, כִּי רַק הוּא נוֹלַד בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁשָּׁם הַבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ, שֶׁשָּׁם עִקַּר הָעֵצָה כַּנַּ״ל. וְעַל כֵּן נִקְרָא בִּנְיָמִין בֶּן יָמִין, בְּחִינַת עֵצוֹת אֲמִתִּיּוֹת שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת לֵב חָכָם לִימִינוֹ, הֵפֶךְ עֵצוֹת נִבְעָרוֹת, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת לֵב כְּסִיל לִשְׂמֹאלוֹ.
pairs.en: And therefore when the tribes met with Yosef, Yosef could not return and rejoin them until they brought Binyamin, for Binyamin is the chief aspect of the rectification of complete, true counsel; for only he was born in the Land of Israel, where the Holy Temple is, where counsel principally is, as above. And therefore he is called Binyamin, “son of the right,” the aspect of true counsels, which are the aspect of “a wise man’s heart is to his right,” the opposite of foolish counsels, which are the aspect of “a fool’s heart is to his left.”

qualifiedAfter.en: And therefore when the tribes met with Yosef, Yosef could not return and rejoin them until they brought Binyamin, for Binyamin is the chief aspect of the rectification of complete, true counsel; for only he was born in the Land of Israel, where the Holy Temple is, where counsel principally is, as above. And therefore he is called Binyamin, “son of the right,” the aspect of true counsels, which are the aspect of “a wise man’s heart is to his right,” the opposite of foolish counsels, which are the aspect of “a fool’s heart is to his left.”

pairs.he: כִּי י״ב הַשְּׁבָטִים הֵם בְּחִינַת שְׁלֵמוּת כְּלָלִיּוּת הָעֵצָה הַקְּדוֹשָׁה שֶׁהוּא כְּלַל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁנִּקְרֵאת עֵצָה כַּנַּ״ל, כִּי הֵם הֵם הַמִּטָּה שְׁלֵמָה שֶׁהֶעֱמִיד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ שֶׁמֵּהֶם יָצְאוּ כָּל זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁקִּבְּלוּ אֶת הַתּוֹרָה בְּהַר סִינַי שֶׁהוּא עִקַּר הָעֵצָה הַשְּׁלֵמָה כַּנַּ״ל, כִּי י״ב שְׁבָטִים הֵם בְּחִינַת י״ב אַבְנֵי יַעֲקֹב שֶׁנִּכְלְלוּ כֻּלָּם בְּאֶבֶן אַחַת (המובא שם בהתורה הנ״ל, עין שם). שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת מַה שֶּׁנִּכְלָלִים בְּאֶבֶן שְׁתִיָּה בְּחִינַת קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים שֶׁזּוֹכִין עַל יְדֵי אֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִתְרַבִּין הַסְּפָרִים הָאֲמִתִּיִּים שֶׁל הַתּוֹרָה הַקְּדוֹשָׁה, שֶׁכָּל זֶה הוּא בְּחִינַת שְׁלֵמוּת הָעֵצָה הָאֲמִתִּית, (כמבואר שם כל זה, עין שם).
pairs.en: For the twelve tribes are the aspect of the complete totality of holy counsel, which is the totality of the Torah called counsel, as above; for they themselves are the complete progeny that Yaakov our forefather established, from whom all the seed of Israel emerged, who received the Torah at Mount Sinai, which is the principal complete counsel, as above. For the twelve tribes are the aspect of Yaakov’s twelve stones, which were all incorporated into one stone (cited there in the aforesaid teaching; see there). This is the aspect of their being incorporated into the Foundation Stone, the aspect of the Holy of Holies, which one merits through faith in the sages; through this the true books of the holy Torah multiply. All this is the aspect of complete true counsel (as all this is explained there; see there).

qualifiedAfter.en: For the twelve tribes are the aspect of the complete totality of holy counsel, which is the totality of the Torah called counsel, as above; for they themselves are the complete progeny that Yaakov our forefather established, from whom all the seed of Israel emerged, who received the Torah at Mount Sinai, which is the principal complete counsel, as above. For the twelve tribes are the aspect of Yaakov’s twelve stones, which were all incorporated into one stone (cited there in the aforesaid teaching; see there). This is the aspect of their being incorporated into the Foundation Stone, the aspect of the Holy of Holies, which one merits through faith in the sages; through this the true books of the holy Torah multiply. All this is the aspect of complete true counsel (as all this is explained there; see there).

pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן הֶחֱרִיד יַעֲקֹב מְאֹד תֵּכֶף כְּשֶׁנּוֹלַד יוֹסֵף לִבְרֹחַ מִלָּבָן כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יִהְיֶה נִשְׁלָם, חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, מִטָּתוֹ הַקְּדוֹשָׁה בְּחוּץ לָאָרֶץ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ, הַיְנוּ כַּנַּ״ל. כִּי שְׁלֵמוּת מִטָּתוֹ הִיא שְׁלֵמוּת הָעֵצָה הַקְּדוֹשָׁה שֶׁנִּשְׁלְמָה עַל יְדֵי בִּנְיָמִין שֶׁהֻכְרַח שֶׁתִּהְיֶה נִשְׁלֶמֶת בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁשָּׁם הַבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וְקֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים, שֶׁשָּׁם עִקַּר הָעֵצָה הַשְּׁלֵמָה כַּנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And therefore Yaakov was greatly agitated immediately when Yosef was born, to flee from Lavan, so that his holy progeny should not be completed outside the Land, God forbid, as written in the holy Zohar; namely, as above. For the completion of his progeny is the completion of holy counsel, which was completed through Binyamin and had to be completed in the Land of Israel, where the Holy Temple and Holy of Holies are, where the complete counsel principally is, as above.

qualifiedAfter.en: And therefore Yaakov was greatly agitated immediately when Yosef was born, to flee from Lavan, so that his holy progeny should not be completed outside the Land, God forbid, as written in the holy Zohar; namely, as above. For the completion of his progeny is the completion of holy counsel, which was completed through Binyamin and had to be completed in the Land of Israel, where the Holy Temple and Holy of Holies are, where the complete counsel principally is, as above.

pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן כְּשֶׁבָּאוּ אַחֵי יוֹסֵף לְמִצְרַיִם וְרָאָה שֶׁהֵם שָׁבִים בִּתְשׁוּבָה עַל מְכִירָתוֹ וַאֲזַי צְרִיכִים לַחֲזֹר וּלְהִתְחַבֵּר עִמָּהֶם וְאָז הָיָה נִגְמָר וְנִשְׁלָם הָעֵצָה, עַל כֵּן לֹא רָצָה לְהִתְוַדֵּעַ לָהֶם עַד שֶׁהֵבִיאוּ אֶת בִּנְיָמִין. וְגַם אָז הוֹסִיף לְצַעֲרָם כְּדֵי שֶׁיָּשׁוּבוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה בְּיוֹתֵר. וְהָיָה מְצַעֲרָם עַל יְדֵי בִּנְיָמִין דַּיְקָא שֶׁצִּוָּה לְהַטְמִין הַגָּבִיעַ בְּאַמְתַּחְתּוֹ.
pairs.en: And therefore when Yosef’s brothers came to Egypt and he saw that they were repenting of selling him, and then one must return and rejoin them, and then counsel would have been finished and completed, therefore he did not wish to reveal himself to them until they brought Binyamin. And even then he added to their distress so that they would repent most completely. And he distressed them through Binyamin specifically, by commanding that the goblet be hidden in his sack.

qualifiedAfter.en: And therefore when Yosef’s brothers came to Egypt and he saw that they were repenting of selling him, and then one must return and rejoin them, and then counsel would have been finished and completed, therefore he did not wish to reveal himself to them until they brought Binyamin. And even then he added to their distress so that they would repent most completely. And he distressed them through Binyamin specifically, by commanding that the goblet be hidden in his sack.

pairs.he: וְזֶה רָמַז לָהֶם מַה שֶּׁפָּגְמוּ עַל יְדֵי מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת פְּגַם אֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים שֶׁגּוֹרְמִין עַל יְדֵי זֶה פְּגַם הָעֵצָה כַּנַּ״ל. שֶׁעִקַּר הַפְּגַם מַגִּיעַ לְבִנְיָמִין הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁהוּא עִקַּר שְׁלֵמוּת הָעֵצָה, כִּי הַבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בְּחֶלְקוֹ כַּנַּ״ל, כִּי בִּנְיָמִין הָיָה נָקִי לְגַמְרֵי מִפְּגַם הָעֵצוֹת רָעוֹת שֶׁנִּמְשָׁכִין מֵעֲצַת הַנָּחָשׁ כַּנַּ״ל שֶׁגָּרַם מִיתָה לָעוֹלָם, כִּי בִּנְיָמִין הָיָה נָקִי מִכָּל זֶה, כִּי הוּא מֵת בְּעֶטְיוֹ שֶׁל נָחָשׁ לְבַד, אֲבָל הוּא בְּעַצְמוֹ לֹא הָיָה לוֹ שׁוּם חֵלֶק בְּעֶטְיוֹ שֶׁל נָחָשׁ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה, וְעַל כֵּן זָכָה שֶׁנִּבְנָה הַבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ וְקֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים בְּחֶלְקוֹ דַּיְקָא שֶׁשָּׁם עִקַּר תִּקּוּן הָעֵצָה וְכַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And by this he hinted to them at what they had blemished through selling Yosef the tzaddik, which is the aspect of blemishing faith in the sages, whereby they cause the blemish in counsel, as above. The chief blemish reaches Binyamin the tzaddik, who is the chief perfection of counsel, for the Holy Temple is in his portion, as above. For Binyamin was entirely clean of the blemish of evil counsels that proceed from the serpent’s counsel, as above, which caused death to the world, for Binyamin was clean of all this; he died only on account of the serpent, but he himself had no share at all in the serpent’s doing, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said. And therefore he merited that the Holy Temple and Holy of Holies were built specifically in his portion, where the principal rectification of counsel is, as above.

qualifiedAfter.en: And by this he hinted to them at what they had blemished through selling Yosef the tzaddik, which is the aspect of blemishing faith in the sages, whereby they cause the blemish in counsel, as above. The chief blemish reaches Binyamin the tzaddik, who is the chief perfection of counsel, for the Holy Temple is in his portion, as above. For Binyamin was entirely clean of the blemish of evil counsels that proceed from the serpent’s counsel, as above, which caused death to the world, for Binyamin was clean of all this; he died only on account of the serpent, but he himself had no share at all in the serpent’s doing, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said. And therefore he merited that the Holy Temple and Holy of Holies were built specifically in his portion, where the principal rectification of counsel is, as above.

pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן רָמַז לָהֶם יוֹסֵף הַפְּגַם עַל יְדֵי בִּנְיָמִין דַּיְקָא, הַיְנוּ שֶׁהַפְּגַם מַגִּיעַ לִבְחִינַת בִּנְיָמִין, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הַבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ, שֶׁהוּא עִקַּר בְּחִינַת שְׁלֵמוּת הָעֵצָה כַּנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And therefore Yosef hinted to them at the blemish through Binyamin specifically: namely, that the blemish reaches the aspect of Binyamin, which is the aspect of the Holy Temple, the chief aspect of complete counsel, as above.

qualifiedAfter.en: And therefore Yosef hinted to them at the blemish through Binyamin specifically: namely, that the blemish reaches the aspect of Binyamin, which is the aspect of the Holy Temple, the chief aspect of complete counsel, as above.

pairs.he: גַּם הֶרְאָה לָהֶם שֶׁעַל יְדֵי פְּגַם אֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים גּוֹרְמִים שֶׁמַּעֲלִילִים עַל הַצַּדִּיק אֱמֶת שֶׁהֵם בַּעֲלֵי עֵצָה בֶּאֱמֶת, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, וְתָהִין מִמֶּנּוּ עֵצָה, גּוֹרְמִים שֶׁבּוֹדִין עֲלֵיהֶם כְּזָבִים כְּאִלּוּ הֵם גַּנָּבִים וְרַמָּאִים חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, כְּאִלּוּ כָּל הִתְנַהֲגוּתָם בִּשְׁבִיל גְּנֵבָה וְרַמָּאוּת חַס וְשָׁלוֹם. וְאָז הִכִּירוּ הַשְּׁבָטִים גֹּדֶל פְּגָמָם עַד הֵיכָן מַגִּיעַ פְּגָמָם וְאָז שָׁבוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה בִּשְׁלֵמוּת, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, מַה נֹּאמַר מַה נְּדַבֵּר מַה נִּצְטַדָּק וְהָאֱלֹקִים מָצָא אֶת עֲוֹן עֲבָדֶיךָ וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: He also showed them that through a blemish in faith in the sages they cause accusations to be made against the true tzaddik, who are truly possessors of counsel, as it is written, “And take counsel from him”; they cause falsehoods to be fabricated against them, as though they were thieves and deceivers, God forbid, as though all their conduct were for theft and deceit, God forbid. And then the tribes recognized the magnitude of their blemish, how far their blemish reaches, and then repented completely, as it is written, “What shall we say, what shall we speak, how shall we justify ourselves? And God has found the iniquity of your servants,” etc.

pairs.he: וְאָז זָכוּ לְתַקֵּן עַל יְדֵי זֶה וְאָז הִתְוַדַּע לָהֶם יוֹסֵף וְחָזְרוּ וְנִכְלְלוּ יַחַד שֶׁזֶּה מְרַמֵּז עַל סוֹף הַתִּקּוּן הָאַחֲרוֹן כְּשֶׁיָּבוֹא מָשִׁיחַ שֶׁאָז יִתְתַּקֵּן הָעֵצָה בִּשְׁלֵמוּת, שֶׁאָז יַחֲזֹר וְיִתְאַחֵד מַלְכוּת בֵּית דָּוִד שֶׁנֶּחְלְקָה תְּחִלָּה שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת תִּקּוּן פְּגַם הָעֵצָה כַּנַּ״ל, בְּחִינַת וְלֹא יֵחָצוּ לִשְׁתֵּי מַמְלָכוֹת עוֹד, כִּי חֲלֻקַּת מַלְכוּת בֵּית דָּוִד וַחֲלֻקַּת הָעֵצָה הֵם בְּחִינָה אַחַת, (כמו שכתוב במקום אחר).
pairs.en: And then they merited to rectify through this, and then Yosef revealed himself to them, and they returned and were incorporated together; this alludes to the end of the final rectification when the Messiah comes, when counsel will be completely rectified, when the kingdom of the house of Dovid that was initially divided will return and become united, the aspect of rectifying the blemish in counsel, as above, the aspect of “And they shall no longer be divided into two kingdoms.” For the division of the kingdom of the house of Dovid and the division of counsel are one aspect (as written elsewhere).

qualifiedAfter.en: And then they merited to rectify through this, and then Yosef revealed himself to them, and they returned and were incorporated together; this alludes to the end of the final rectification when the Messiah comes, when counsel will be completely rectified, when the kingdom of the house of Dovid that was initially divided will return and become united, the aspect of rectifying the blemish in counsel, as above, the aspect of “And they shall no longer be divided into two kingdoms.” For the division of the kingdom of the house of Dovid and the division of counsel are one aspect (as written elsewhere).

pairs.en: (Halachos of Tishah B’Av and Fasts, Halacha 4, item 5)

This passage only: Native ועצה כזאת and closing ועל כן retain coordination. Eternal success, approach to sages/disciple/books, reversed counsels, the two powers with abbreviated merit/nonmerit and righteous/transgressor quotation, upright people and daily/constant counsel remain. Generic one/he is impersonal, not a named actor.

This passage only: Closing ועל כן retains a coordinated consequence. Destruction/exile, divided counsel, deficient faith, expulsion and inability to sweeten judgment through the Holy of Holies remain. “One cannot” is impersonal plural אין יכולין, not a counted/named-agent assertion.

This passage only: Native ודרשו retains coordinated exposition. Native לעזר supports “help,” not “leave,” despite conceptual tension: Hashem gives human choice and was compelled to help the person choose counsel as he wishes, yet completes matters by His own will. Human he versus divine He and the parenthetical after the second כרצונו remain. Divine counsel/annulment and all quoted clauses are retained; no canonical expansion is implied.

This passage only: Both ועל כן relations remain. Yosef cannot rejoin until Binyamin comes; Binyamin alone was born in the Land. Temple/counsel location, son-of-right and wise/right versus fool/left quotations remain.

This passage only: Native החריד יעקב מאד expresses great agitation/alarm, not merely speed. The purpose of fleeing Lavan immediately at Yosef’s birth, holy progeny/counsel completion through Binyamin, Land/Temple/Holy of Holies and Zohar attribution remain. This is contextual emotional force, not reconstructed Hebrew points.

This passage only: The brothers are antecedent of עמהם; Yosef sees their repentance. Generic צריכים לחזור ולהתחבר עמהם is rendered impersonally “one must,” not as naming Yosef grammatical subject or making the brothers rejoin themselves. Narrative he for seeing, withholding disclosure, intensified distress and goblet is Yosef. Repeated then and conditional would-have-been retain potential counsel-completion, not completion before Binyamin. No actor or optional smoothing is supplied.

This passage only: Final ועל כן retains coordination. בעטיו is rendered “on account of the serpent” and “in the serpent’s doing,” preserving consequence versus personal participation without asserting poison, a new event, specialist gloss or Binyamin’s direct temptation. Binyamin is clean of evil counsels and has no personal share; selling Yosef, faith/counsel blemish, Temple portion, innocence and Holy-of-Holies/counsel conclusion remain.

This passage only: For the affected paragraph, native ונתהין before ממנו עצה includes a nun absent from stored ותהין. Its exact operative meaning, voice and implied actor are unresolved; neither a remembered/canonical verse nor guessed points establishes “And take counsel from him.” The complete English and complete pointed Hebrew remain held, with no full replacement. Native singular הצדיק אמת followed by plural שהם/עליהם remains unharmonized. Thieves/deceivers are fabricated allegations in the paragraph, not narrator facts; repentance and quoted confession remain.

pairs.he: כָּל זֶה הוּא בְּחִינַת הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים וּבֵין הַכְּשֵׁרִים קְצָת, וְהָעִקַּר מֵחֲמַת שֶׁהַכֹּל רוֹצִים שֶׁיָּבִינוּ מִיָּד כָּל דַּרְכֵי הַצַּדִּיק וְהַשָּׂגוֹתָיו. כִּי אִם הָיוּ הַכֹּל רוֹאִים וּמְבִינִים מַה שֶׁהִשִּׂיג הַצַּדִּיק אֲפִלּוּ חֵלֶק אֶחָד מֵאֶלֶף, הָיוּ בְּוַדַּאי כֻּלָּם כְּרוּכִים אַחֲרָיו וְהָיוּ מִתְקָרְבִים אֵלָיו בְּכָל נַפְשָׁם וּמְאֹדָם.
pairs.en: All this is the aspect of the dispute between the tzaddikim and those who are somewhat upright. And the principal cause is that everyone wants to understand immediately all the ways of the tzaddik and his attainments. For if everyone saw and understood even one part in a thousand of what the tzaddik attained, they would certainly all be attached to him and would draw near to him with all their soul and their resources.

qualifiedAfter.en: All this is the aspect of the dispute between the tzaddikim and those who are somewhat upright. And the principal cause is that everyone wants to understand immediately all the ways of the tzaddik and his attainments. For if everyone saw and understood even one part in a thousand of what the tzaddik attained, they would certainly all be attached to him and would draw near to him with all their soul and their resources.

pairs.he: אַךְ הַצַּדִּיק מִתְנַהֵג בְּחָכְמָה בִּשְׁבִיל הַבְּחִירָה וּמַעֲלִים עַצְמוֹ וּמַסְתִּיר עַצְמוֹ מֵהָעוֹלָם, רַק מְגַלֶּה לָהֶם מְעַט מִזְעָר, בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁיֵּדְעוּ וְיָבִינוּ שֶׁהַסּוֹד אֶצְלוֹ. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב שָׁם ז״ל עַל עִנְיַן סוֹד הָעִבּוּר, שֶׁהוּא כְּלַל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּהּ חָכְמָה שֶׁיְּכוֹלִין לְגַלּוֹת לָהֶם מַה שֶּׁמְּגַלִּין, וְאַף עַל פִּי כֵן יִהְיֶה הַסּוֹד נִשְׁאָר אֶצְלוֹ וְכוּ׳ שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת כִּי הוּא חָכְמַתְכֶם וּבִינַתְכֶם לְעֵינֵי הָעַמִּים דַּיְקָא וְכוּ׳. וְרַק עַל יְדֵי שֶׁמְּגַלִּין לָהֶם יָבִינוּ שֶׁהַסּוֹד אֶצְלוֹ, וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יֵשׁ לָהֶם בְּחִירָה.
pairs.en: But the tzaddik conducts himself wisely for the sake of free choice, and conceals himself and hides himself from the world. He only reveals to them a very little, in such a manner that they will know and understand that the secret is with him. And this is as he wrote there, of blessed memory, concerning the mystery of intercalation, which is the general principle of the Torah, that it contains wisdom such that they can reveal to them what they reveal, and nevertheless the secret will remain with him, etc., which is the aspect of “For it is your wisdom and your understanding in the eyes of the nations”—specifically, etc. And only through what they reveal to them will they understand that the secret is with him; and through this they have free choice.

qualifiedAfter.en: But the tzaddik conducts himself wisely for the sake of free choice, and conceals himself and hides himself from the world. He only reveals to them a very little, in such a manner that they will know and understand that the secret is with him. And this is as he wrote there, of blessed memory, concerning the mystery of intercalation, which is the general principle of the Torah, that it contains wisdom such that they can reveal to them what they reveal, and nevertheless the secret will remain with him, etc., which is the aspect of “For it is your wisdom and your understanding in the eyes of the nations”—specifically, etc. And only through what they reveal to them will they understand that the secret is with him; and through this they have free choice.

pairs.he: כִּי בְּוַדַּאי אִם יִרְצוּ בֶּאֱמֶת לַאֲמִתּוֹ יְכוֹלִין לְהָבִין מֵרָחוֹק עַל יְדֵי זֶה שֶׁכְּבָר גִּלָּה לָהֶם שֶׁבְּוַדַּאי יוֹדֵעַ עוֹד מַה שֶּׁיּוֹדֵעַ בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁיִּתְקָרְבוּ לָנֶצַח. אַךְ לֹא יַחְפֹּץ כְּסִיל בִּתְבוּנָה וְכוּ׳. וְכֵן מִתְנַהֵג הַצַּדִּיק בְּכָל הַשָּׂגוֹתָיו עַד שֶׁבֶּאֱמֶת מִתְקָרְבִים הַחֲפֵצִים בֶּאֱמֶת, אֲבָל יֵשׁ שֶׁמַּרְבִּים לְהַקְשׁוֹת קֻשְׁיוֹת עָלָיו כִּי רוֹצִים לְהָבִין הַכֹּל. וַאֲפִלּוּ צַדִּיקִים מִתְגָּרֶה בָּהֶם הַבַּעַל דָּבָר וּמַכְנִיס בְּלִבָּם קֻשְׁיוֹת עָלָיו, כִּי בְּתַלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים וְהַצַּדִּיקִים מִתְגָּרֶה בְּיוֹתֵר שֶׁיַּחְלְקוּ עָלָיו, מֵחֲמַת שֶׁעֲלֵיהֶם מִסְתַּכְּלִים הַרְבֵּה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל.
pairs.en: For certainly, if they truly desire in all truth, they can understand from afar, through what he has already revealed to them, that he certainly knows further what he knows, in such a manner that they will draw near forever. But a fool does not desire understanding, etc. And thus the tzaddik conducts himself in all his attainments, until those who truly desire do indeed draw near. But there are those who raise many difficult questions against him, because they want to understand everything. And even with tzaddikim the baal davar provokes them and introduces difficult questions against him into their hearts, for he provokes Torah scholars and tzaddikim especially to dispute with him, because many of Israel look to them.

qualifiedAfter.en: For certainly, if they truly desire in all truth, they can understand from afar, through what he has already revealed to them, that he certainly knows further what he knows, in such a manner that they will draw near forever. But a fool does not desire understanding, etc. And thus the tzaddik conducts himself in all his attainments, until those who truly desire do indeed draw near. But there are those who raise many difficult questions against him, because they want to understand everything. And even with tzaddikim the baal davar provokes them and introduces difficult questions against him into their hearts, for he provokes Torah scholars and tzaddikim especially to dispute with him, because many of Israel look to them.

pairs.he: וּבֶאֱמֶת יֵשׁ בָּזֶה נִסְתָּרוֹת הַרְבֵּה בְּעִנְיַן הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים בְּעַצְמָם כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר עַל פָּסוּק אֹזֶן שׁוֹמַעַת תּוֹכַחַת חַיִּים וְכוּ׳. כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר בסימן ה׳ לקוטי חלק א.
pairs.en: And in truth there are many hidden matters here concerning the dispute among the tzaddikim themselves, as is explained on the verse “An ear that hears life-giving reproof,” etc., as is explained in section 5 of Likutay, Part One.

qualifiedAfter.en: And in truth there are many hidden matters here concerning the dispute among the tzaddikim themselves, as is explained on the verse “An ear that hears life-giving reproof,” etc., as is explained in section 5 of Likutay, Part One.

pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת שֶׁבֵּין הַשְּׁבָטִים עַל יוֹסֵף שֶׁהוּא גִּלָּה לָהֶם חֲלוֹמוֹתָיו כְּדֵי שֶׁיָּבִינוּ מֵרָחוֹק עֹצֶם גְּדֻלָּתוֹ, וְהֵם הוֹסִיפוּ שְׂנֹא אוֹתוֹ עַל חֲלוֹמוֹתָיו וְכוּ׳. וְכֵן מִתְנַהֵג עַכְשָׁו וְכַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of the dispute among the tribes against Yosef, that he revealed his dreams to them so that they would understand from afar the immensity of his greatness; and they continued to hate him on account of his dreams, etc. And thus it proceeds now, as stated above.

qualifiedAfter.en: And this is the aspect of the dispute among the tribes against Yosef, that he revealed his dreams to them so that they would understand from afar the immensity of his greatness; and they continued to hate him on account of his dreams, etc. And thus it proceeds now, as stated above.

pairs.he: שָׁמַעְתִּי וְהֵבַנְתִּי מִפִּיו הַקָּדוֹשׁ זכר צדיק לברכה שֶׁאָמַר, שֶׁזֶּה יֵצֶר הָרַע גָּדוֹל אֵצֶל כַּמָּה בְּנֵי אָדָם, וּבִפְרָט הַגְּדוֹלִים בְּמַעֲלָה, שֶׁבִּשְׁבִיל דָּבָר אֶחָד שֶׁנִּדְמֶה לָהֶם שֶׁהוּא מִצְוָה, הֵם מַפְקִירִים הַכֹּל וּבָאִים עַל יְדֵי זֶה לְקִלְקוּלִים רַבִּים, וּבִפְרָט כְּשֶׁבָּאִים עַל יְדֵי זֶה לִידֵי מַחֲלֹקֶת.
pairs.en: I heard and understood from his holy mouth, may the memory of the righteous be for a blessing, that he said that this is a great evil inclination among some people, and especially those who are great in spiritual stature: for the sake of one thing that appears to them to be a mitzvah, they abandon everything, and through this they come to many forms of corruption, and especially when through this they come to dispute.

qualifiedAfter.en: I heard and understood from his holy mouth, may the memory of the righteous be for a blessing, that he said that this is a great evil inclination among some people, and especially those who are great in spiritual stature: for the sake of one thing that appears to them to be a mitzvah, they abandon everything, and through this they come to many forms of corruption, and especially when through this they come to dispute.

pairs.he: וּכְשֶׁיְּעַיֵּן בְּכָל הַמַּעֲשִׂיּוֹת שֶׁהָיָה בֵּין הַצַּדִּיקִים בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר הַכֹּל הָיָה בִּבְחִינָה זֹאת, שֶׁהַבַּעַל דָּבָר הִטְעָה אוֹתָם כְּאִלּוּ שֶׁכְּנֶגְדּוֹ פּוֹגֵם הַרְבֵּה וּמִצְוָה לִמְסֹר נֶפֶשׁ לְרָדְפוֹ וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: And when one examines all the accounts that took place among the tzaddikim in every generation, everything was in this aspect: that the baal davar misled them as though the one opposing him caused great damage, and it were a mitzvah to give up one’s life to persecute him, etc.

qualifiedAfter.en: And when one examines all the accounts that took place among the tzaddikim in every generation, everything was in this aspect: that the baal davar misled them as though the one opposing him caused great damage, and it were a mitzvah to give up one’s life to persecute him, etc.

pairs.he: וּבֶאֱמֶת זֶהוּ פְּגָם מְאֹד, כִּי עַל יְדֵי הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת וְהַכַּעַס אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְתַקֵּן בְּשׁוּם אֹפֶן, רַק צְרִיכִין לְהִתְיַשֵּׁב הַרְבֵּה אֵיךְ לְהִתְנַהֵג בָּזֶה. וְהָעִקָּר לְבַקֵּשׁ מֵה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁיַּנְחֵהוּ בְּדֶרֶךְ הָאֱמֶת וּלְהִתְיַשֵּׁב עַצְמוֹ הַרְבֵּה אִם יֵשׁ לוֹ כֹּחַ לְרָדְפוֹ, וְאוּלַי כַּוָּנָתוֹ שֶׁל הַשֵּׁנִי לַשָּׁמַיִם רַק שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהָבִין דְּבָרָיו. וְגַם אָמְרוּ עָלָיו הַרְבֵּה שְׁקָרִים וּכְזָבִים בְּחִינַת אֲשֶׁר לֹא גָזַלְתִּי אָז אָשִׁיב. וְיֵשׁ בָּזֶה הַרְבֵּה לְדַבֵּר.
pairs.en: And in truth this is a very great blemish, for through dispute and anger it is impossible to rectify in any way. One must only deliberate thoroughly about how to conduct oneself in this. And the principal thing is to ask Hashem, blessed be He, to guide him in the way of truth, and to deliberate thoroughly within himself as to whether he has the strength to persecute him. And perhaps the other person’s intention is for the sake of Heaven, but it is impossible to understand his words. And they also said many lies and falsehoods about him, in the aspect of “That which I did not steal, I will then restore.” And there is much to say concerning this.

qualifiedAfter.en: And in truth this is a very great blemish, for through dispute and anger it is impossible to rectify in any way. One must only deliberate thoroughly about how to conduct oneself in this. And the principal thing is to ask Hashem, blessed be He, to guide him in the way of truth, and to deliberate thoroughly within himself as to whether he has the strength to persecute him. And perhaps the other person’s intention is for the sake of Heaven, but it is impossible to understand his words. And they also said many lies and falsehoods about him, in the aspect of “That which I did not steal, I will then restore.” And there is much to say concerning this.

pairs.he: וְזֶה הָיָה בְּחִינַת הַפְּגָם שֶׁל רְאוּבֵן שֶׁכַּוָּנָתוֹ בְּוַדַּאי לַשָּׁמַיִם כִּי קִנֵּא קִנְאַת אִמּוֹ. אַף עַל פִּי כֵן פָּגַם בָּזֶה מְאֹד עַד שֶׁאָבַד עַל יְדֵי זֶה הַכְּהֻנָּה וְהַמַּלְכוּת וְכָל הַפְּגָם הָיָה בִּבְחִינַת דֹּחַק אֶת הַשָּׁעָה בְּחִינַת פַּחְדוֹ כְּמַיִם אַל תּוֹתַר וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: And this was the aspect of Reuven’s blemish, whose intention was certainly for the sake of Heaven, for he was zealous for his mother. Nevertheless, he caused very great damage by this, to the point that through this he lost the priesthood and the kingship. And all the damage was in the aspect of pressing the hour, in the aspect of “His fear, like water; do not exceed,” etc.

pairs.he: וּבִפְרָט שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי פָּגְמוּ בָּזֶה הַרְבֵּה יוֹתֵר, כִּי מָכְרוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף שֶׁהַכֹּל הָיָה בִּבְחִינָה הַנַּ״ל שֶׁדָּחֲקוּ אֶת הַשָּׁעָה, וְסָבְרוּ שֶׁיִּתַּקְּנוּ הָעוֹלָם עַל יְדֵי מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף, כִּי רָאוּ שֶׁמֵּבִיא אֶת דִּבָּתָם רָעָה אֶל אֲבִיהֶם וְרָאוּ שֶׁיֵּצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ יָרָבְעָם וְאַחְאָב, עַל כֵּן לְפִי דַּעְתָּם רָצוּ לְהָרְגוֹ וְכַוָּנָתָם הָיָה בִּשְׁבִיל תִּקּוּן הָעוֹלָם שֶׁלֹּא יֵצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ יָרָבְעָם וְאַחְאָב כַּנַּ״ל. וְכֵן שְׁאָרֵי סְבָרוֹת שֶׁל טָעוּת שֶׁהָיָה לָהֶם בָּזֶה, כִּי בְּוַדַּאי הָיוּ צַדִּיקִים גְּדוֹלִים אַךְ שָׁגוּ הַרְבֵּה וְעִקַּר הַפְּגָם הָיָה בִּבְחִינַת דֹּחַק הַשָּׁעָה.
pairs.en: And especially Shimon and Levi caused much greater damage by this, for they sold Yosef; all of it was in the aspect stated above, that they pressed the hour, and they thought that they would rectify the world through the sale of Yosef. For they saw that he brought an evil report of them to their father, and they saw that Yeravam and Achav would come forth from him. Therefore, in their opinion they wanted to kill him, and their intention was for the rectification of the world, that Yeravam and Achav should not come forth from him, as stated above. And likewise the other mistaken arguments they had in this, for certainly they were great tzaddikim, but they erred greatly, and the principal damage was in the aspect of pressing the hour.

pairs.he: השבטים סברו שרוצה למשול במלוכה דס״א שנמשך מעשירות, ובאמת להיפך ממשלתו על ידי הדעת שזוכין ע״י להארת הרצון שזוכים באכילה, ולכן יהודה הציע שע״י שימכרו אותו יתקנו פגם הארת הרצון לפי דעתם
pairs.en: The tribes thought that he wanted to rule with the kingship of the sitra achra, which proceeds from wealth; but in truth it is the reverse: his rule is through knowledge, through which one merits the illumination of will that is attained in eating. And therefore Yehudah proposed that by selling him they would rectify the blemish in the illumination of will, according to their understanding.

pairs.he: ״מַה בֶּצַע כִּי נַהֲרֹג אֶת אָחִינוּ״ (ל״ז, כו) עַל פִּי הַתּוֹרָה כִּי מְרַחֲמָם יְנַהֲגֵם בְּלִקּוּטֵי תִנְיָנָא סִימָן ז, עַיֵּן שָׁם. מְבֹאָר שָׁם שֶׁעִקַּר הַחִיּוּב מַה שֶּׁהָאָדָם מְחֻיָּב לְהַשְׁאִיר אַחֲרָיו אֶת ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְכוּ׳, עַיֵּן שָׁם מֵעִנְיַן בֵּן וְתַלְמִיד שֶׁעַל יָדָם נִשְׁאָר דַּעְתּוֹ בָּעוֹלָם שֶׁזֶּה עִקַּר הִשָּׁאֲרוּתוֹ, כִּי אֵין נִשְׁאָר מֵהָאָדָם אַחַר מוֹתוֹ שׁוּם דָּבָר כִּי אִם הַדַּעַת שֶׁהֵאִיר בְּבָנִים וְתַלְמִידִים וְכוּ׳, עַיֵּן שָׁם כָּל זֶה הֵיטֵב.
pairs.en: “What profit is there if we kill our brother?” (37:26), according to the teaching “For their compassionate One shall guide them,” in Likutay Tinyana, section 7; see there. It is explained there that the chief obligation, that which a person is obligated to leave after him, is Hashem, blessed be He, etc.; see there concerning a son and a disciple, through whom his knowledge remains in the world, which is his principal enduring remnant. For nothing remains of a person after his death except the knowledge he illuminated in children and disciples, etc.; see all this there carefully.

pairs.he: וּמְבֹאָר שָׁם שֶׁעַל יְדֵי כְּלָלִיּוּת בֵּן וְתַלְמִיד עַל יְדֵי זֶה מִי שֶׁהוּא אִישׁ חַיִל יָכוֹל לְקַבֵּל בְּעֵת הָאֲכִילָה הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן וְכוּ׳, כִּי עִקַּר הַפַּרְנָסָה נִמְשָׁךְ מִיָּם הַחָכְמָה שֶׁנִּמְשָׁךְ עַל יְדֵי בֵּן וְתַלְמִיד וְכוּ׳, עַיֵּן שָׁם כָּל זֶה הֵיטֵב.
pairs.en: And it is explained there that through the incorporation of son and disciple, thereby one who is a man of valor can receive the illumination of will while eating, etc.; for sustenance is principally drawn from the sea of wisdom, which is drawn through son and disciple, etc.; see all this there carefully.

pairs.he: יַעֲקֹב מָסַר הַבְּכוֹרָה לִבְנוֹ לְיוֹסֵף, כִּי בֶן זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ, וְזֶהוּ זָקֵן קָנָה חָכְמָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה. וּמוּבָא בְּפֵרוּשׁ רש״י שֶׁכָּל מַה שֶּׁלָּמַד מִשֵּׁם וְעֵבֶר מָסַר לוֹ. וְעַל כֵּן מֵחֲמַת שֶׁמָּסַר לוֹ חָכְמָתוֹ וְדַעְתּוֹ הַקְּדוֹשָׁה עַל כֵּן מָסַר לוֹ הַבְּכוֹרָה שֶׁהִיא בְּחִינַת קְדֻשַּׁת הַדַּעַת שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק צָרִיךְ לְהַשְׁאִיר לְבָנָיו וּלְתַלְמִידָיו כַּנַּ״ל, כִּי הַבְּכוֹרָה הָיְתָה מַגִּיעַ לִרְאוּבֵן. אַךְ בְּחַלְּלוֹ יְצוּעֵי אָבִיו וְזֶה פְּגַם בְּהַדַּעַת עַל יְדֵי זֶה נָתַן בְּכוֹרָתוֹ לְיוֹסֵף שֶׁזָּכָה לִשְׁמֹר הַדַּעַת בִּשְׁלֵמוּת, כִּי עָמַד בְּנִסָּיוֹן שֶׁל תַּאֲוָה זֹאת שֶׁזֶּה עִקַּר שְׁמִירַת הַדַּעַת.
pairs.en: Yaakov handed the birthright to his son, to Yosef, for “he was a son of old age to him”; and this is “an elder”—one who has acquired wisdom, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said. And it is cited in Rashi’s commentary that everything he learned from Shem and Ever he handed over to him. And therefore, because he handed his wisdom and holy knowledge over to him, therefore he handed the birthright over to him, which is the aspect of the holiness of the knowledge that the tzaddik must leave to his children and disciples, as above. For the birthright was due to Reuven, but when he profaned his father’s couch, and this is a blemish in knowledge, through this he gave his birthright to Yosef, who merited to preserve knowledge completely, for he stood firm in the trial of this desire, which is the chief preservation of knowledge.

qualifiedAfter.en: Yaakov handed the birthright to his son, to Yosef, for “he was a son of old age to him”; and this is “an elder”—one who has acquired wisdom, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said. pairs.he: וְהַשְּׁבָטִים הִתְקַנְּאוּ בוֹ עַל שֶׁהוֹצִיא דִבָּה עֲלֵיהֶם. עַל כֵּן חָשְׁדוּ אוֹתוֹ עַל כָּל הַדְּבָרִים שֶׁדִּבֵּר עֲלֵיהֶם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה כָּל הַפּוֹסֵל בְּמוּמוֹ פּוֹסֵל. גַּם נִסְתַּכְּלוּ בְּרוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ שֶׁיֵּצְאוּ מִמֶּנּוּ יָרָבְעָם וְאַחְאָב שֶׁיַּעֲבִדוּ עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה. עַל כֵּן חָשְׁדוּ אוֹתוֹ שֶׁמַּטְעֶה אֶת אָבִיו כְּמוֹ עֵשָׂו עַד שֶׁהִתִּירוּ אֶת דָּמוֹ.
pairs.en: And the tribes became jealous of him because he brought an evil report about them. Therefore they suspected him of all the things he spoke against them, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said: whoever disqualifies, disqualifies through his own blemish. They also saw through the holy spirit that Yeravam and Achav would emerge from him and would serve idolatry. Therefore they suspected him of misleading his father like Esav, until they permitted his blood [to be shed].

qualifiedAfter.en: And the tribes became jealous of him because he brought an evil report about them. Therefore they suspected him of all the things he spoke against them, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said: whoever disqualifies, disqualifies through his own blemish. pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת הַחֲלוֹם שֶׁסִּפֵּר לָהֶם, וְהִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים וְכוּ׳ וְהִנֵּה קָמָה אֲלֻמָּתִי וְגַם נִצָּבָה וְכוּ׳. וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אֶחָיו הֲמָלֹךְ תִּמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ אִם וְכוּ׳, כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת טָעוּ אֶחָיו בְּיוֹסֵף, כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת הָיָה צַדִּיק גָּדוֹל וְזָכָה לְקַבֵּל עִקַּר הַדַּעַת מֵאָבִיו. וְעַל כֵּן הֶרְאוּ לוֹ בַּחֲלוֹם שֶׁיִּמְלֹךְ וְיִמְשֹׁל, וְהֶרְאוּ לוֹ דַּיְקָא עַל יְדֵי תְּבוּאוֹת הַשָּׂדֶה שֶׁהָיָה מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים, הַיְנוּ עִנְיָן הַנַּ״ל שֶׁעַל יְדֵי הַדַּעַת זוֹכִין לְקַבֵּל הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן עַל יְדֵי הַמְּלוּכָה וְהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of the dream he told them: “And behold, we were binding sheaves,” etc., “and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright,” etc. And his brothers said to him, “Will you indeed reign over us, or,” etc. For in truth his brothers were mistaken about Yosef, for in truth he was a great tzaddik and merited to receive the principal knowledge from his father. And therefore they showed him in a dream that he would reign and rule, and they showed him specifically through the produce of the field, for they were binding sheaves: namely, the aforesaid matter, that through knowledge one merits to receive the illumination of will through kingship and rule.

qualifiedAfter.en: And this is the aspect of the dream he told them: “And behold, we were binding sheaves,” etc., “and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright,” etc. And his brothers said to him, “Will you indeed reign over us, or,” etc. For in truth his brothers were mistaken about Yosef, for in truth he was a great tzaddik and merited to receive the principal knowledge from his father. And therefore they showed him in a dream that he would reign and rule, and they showed him specifically through the produce of the field, for they were binding sheaves: namely, the aforesaid matter, that through knowledge one merits to receive the illumination of will through kingship and rule.

pairs.he: עַל כֵּן הֶרְאוּ לוֹ שֶׁזָּכָה לָזֶה וְרָמְזוּ לוֹ דַּיְקָא בַּאֲלֻמּוֹת הַשָּׂדֶה שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת שֶׁפַע הַפַּרְנָסָה לְהוֹרוֹת שֶׁהוּא זָכָה לְמֶמְשָׁלָה וּמְלוּכָה שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה גְּדֵלִים אֲלֻמּוֹת הַשָּׂדֶה, דְּהַיְנוּ שֶׁפַע הַפַּרְנָסָה וְכוּ׳, וְזָכָה לָזֶה עַל יְדֵי גֹּדֶל הַדַּעַת הַנַּ״ל שֶׁקִּבֵּל מֵאָבִיו כַּנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: Therefore they showed him that he merited this, and hinted to him specifically by the sheaves of the field, which are the aspect of the flow of sustenance, to indicate that he merited rule and kingship, through which the sheaves of the field grow—that is, the flow of sustenance, etc.—and he merited this through the greatness of the aforesaid knowledge that he received from his father, as above.

qualifiedAfter.en: Therefore they showed him that he merited this, and hinted to him specifically by the sheaves of the field, which are the aspect of the flow of sustenance, to indicate that he merited rule and kingship, through which the sheaves of the field grow—that is, the flow of sustenance, etc.—and he merited this through the greatness of the aforesaid knowledge that he received from his father, as above.

pairs.he: וְאֶחָיו הֵבִינוּ דַּעְתּוֹ שֶׁפָּתַר הַחֲלוֹם בְּעִנְיָן זֶה, עַל כֵּן הִתְקַנְּאוּ בוֹ וְאָמְרוּ לוֹ, הֲמָלֹךְ תִּמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ וְכוּ׳. כִּי אָמְרוּ שֶׁהוּא בַּהֵפֶךְ שֶׁמַּטְעֶה אֶת אָבִיו וְרוֹצֶה לִמְשֹׁל וְלִמְלֹךְ בְּמַלְכוּת דְּסִטְרָא אַחֲרָא כְּמוֹ יָרָבְעָם שֶׁיָּצָא מִמֶּנּוּ שֶׁמָּלַךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהֶחֱטִיא אוֹתָם מְאֹד עַל יְדֵי שְׁנֵי עֶגְלֵי זָהָב שֶׁעָשָׂה לָהֶם.
pairs.en: And his brothers understood his intention, that he interpreted the dream in this sense. Therefore they became jealous of him and said to him, “Will you indeed reign over us,” etc. For they said that it was the reverse: that he was misleading his father and wanted to rule and reign with the kingship of the sitra achra, like Yeravam who emerged from him, who reigned over Israel and caused them to sin greatly through the two golden calves he made for them.

qualifiedAfter.en: And his brothers understood his intention, that he interpreted the dream in this sense. Therefore they became jealous of him and said to him, “Will you indeed reign over us,” etc. For they said that it was the reverse: that he was misleading his father and wanted to rule and reign with the kingship of the sitra achra, like Yeravam who emerged from him, who reigned over Israel and caused them to sin greatly through the two golden calves he made for them.

pairs.he: כִּי בְּהַמָּמוֹן וְהָעֲשִׁירוּת בִּקְדֻשָּׁה גָּבֹהַּ מְאֹד מְאֹד, כִּי נִמְשָׁךְ מֵהַיָּדַיִם שֶׁיֵּשׁ בְּיָם הַחָכְמָה וְכוּ׳ וְעַל כֵּן מֵאִיר שָׁם הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן כַּנַּ״ל, אֲבָל זֶה אֵין זוֹכֶה כִּי אִם הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת וְהַנִּלְוִים אֵלָיו בֶּאֱמֶת שֶׁמְּקַבְּלִים דַּעְתּוֹ הַנַּ״ל שֶׁמֵּאִיר בְּבֵן וְתַלְמִיד כַּנַּ״ל, אֲבָל לְהֵפֶךְ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם מִי שֶׁאֵין מְקַבֵּל הַדַּעַת הַנַּ״ל, מִכָּל שֶׁכֵּן מִי שֶׁחוֹלֵק עַל הַצַּדִּיק הַזֶּה שֶׁמֵּאִיר הַדַּעַת הַנַּ״ל כָּל נְפִילָתוֹ הוּא עַל יְדֵי הַמָּמוֹן וְהָעֲשִׁירוּת, כִּי לְמַטָּה נֶאֱחָזִים כָּל הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה בְּהַמָּמוֹן, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר (בסימן כג) כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, וְכֶסֶף הִרְבֵּיתִי לָהֶם וְזָהָב עָשׂוּ לַבָּעַל (עין מזה במקום אחר) וְעַל כֵּן טָעוּ הַשְּׁבָטִים וְאָמְרוּ שֶׁיוֹסֵף רוֹצֶה לִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם בְּמַלְכוּת הַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא הַנַּ״ל עַד שֶׁהִתִּירוּ אֶת דָּמוֹ.
pairs.en: For in money and wealth in holiness [the level] is very, very high, for it proceeds from the hands that are in the sea of wisdom, etc., and therefore the illumination of will shines there, as above. But none merits this except the true tzaddik and those who genuinely join him, who receive his aforesaid knowledge that he illuminates in son and disciple, as above. But conversely, God forbid, whoever does not receive the aforesaid knowledge, and all the more whoever disputes this tzaddik who illuminates the aforesaid knowledge—all his downfall is through money and wealth, for below, this entire world clings to money, as written elsewhere (in section 23), as it is written, “And I increased silver for them, and gold they made for Baal” (see concerning this elsewhere). And therefore the tribes erred and said that Yosef wanted to reign over them with the aforesaid kingship of the sitra achra, until they permitted his blood [to be shed].

pairs.he: וְזֶה שֶׁאָמַר לָהֶם יְהוּדָה, מַה בֶּצַע כִּי נַהֲרֹג אֶת אָחִינוּ וְכוּ׳ לְכוּ וְנִמְכְּרֶנּוּ לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים וְכוּ׳. וְהַדָּבָר תָּמוּהַּ מְאֹד וְכִי עָלָה עַל דַּעַת יְהוּדָה שֶׁרוֹצִים לַהֲרֹג אֶת יוֹסֵף בִּשְׁבִיל בֶּצַע וּמָמוֹן, עַד שֶׁאָמַר לָהֶם מַה בֶּצַע כִּי נַהֲרֹג וְכוּ׳, הֲלֹא יָדַע הָאֱמֶת שֶׁכַּוָּנָתָם לְשָׁמַיִם לְפִי טָעוּתָם שֶׁרוֹצִים לַהֲרְגוֹ שֶׁלֹּא יַטְעֶה אוֹתָם אוֹ אֲחֵרִים מֵהָאֱמוּנָה הָאֲמִתִּית שֶׁקִּבְּלוּ מֵאֲבִיהֶם, אֲבָל עַל כָּל פָּנִים חַס וְשָׁלוֹם אֵין כַּוָּנָתָם כְּלָל בִּשְׁבִיל אֵיזֶה מָמוֹן וּבֶצַע.
pairs.en: And this is what Yehudah said to them: “What profit is there if we kill our brother,” etc., “Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites,” etc. And the matter is most astonishing: did it enter Yehudah’s mind that they wanted to kill Yosef for profit and money, so that he said to them, “What profit is there if we kill,” etc.? Did he not know the truth, that their intention was for Heaven, according to their error, that they wanted to kill him so that he would not mislead them or others away from the true faith they received from their father? But in any event, God forbid, their intention was not at all for any money and profit.

Did he not know the truth, that their intention was for Heaven, according to their error, that they wanted to kill him so that he would not mislead them or others away from the true faith they received from their father? But in any event, God forbid, their intention was not at all for any money and profit.

pairs.he: רַק יְהוּדָה רָמַז לָהֶם עִנְיָן הַנַּ״ל, מֵחֲמַת שֶׁלְּפִי דַּעְתְּכֶם רְצוֹנְכֶם לְבַעֲרוֹ כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יְקַלְקֵל אֶת הַדַּעַת הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁהִתְחִילוּ הָאָבוֹת לְהַמְשִׁיךְ בָּעוֹלָם. וַאֲזַי הוּכְלוּ אַתֶּם לְהַמְשִׁיךְ זֶה הַדַּעַת הַקָּדוֹשׁ, עַל כֵּן אָמַר לָהֶם מַה בֶּצַע וְכוּ׳ לְכוּ וְנִמְכְּרֶנּוּ וְכוּ׳, הַיְנוּ שֶׁלְּפִי זֶה טוֹב לְמָכְרוֹ וּלְקַבֵּל בַּעֲדוֹ מָמוֹן, וְאַתֶּם הַשְּׁבָטִים שֶׁכֻּלְּכֶם קְדוֹשִׁים, כְּשֶׁתְּקַבְּלוּ מָמוֹן בַּעֲדוֹ וּתְקַבְּלוּ עַל יְדֵי זֶה הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן שֶׁמֵּאִיר בְּהַמָּמוֹן כְּשֶׁמְּקַבְּלִים אוֹתוֹ כָּרָאוּי וַאֲזַי תְּתַקְּנוּ הַדָּבָר כָּרָאוּי.
pairs.en: Rather, Yehudah hinted to them at the aforesaid matter: since, according to your understanding, your wish was to remove him so that he would not corrupt the holy knowledge that the forefathers began to draw into the world, and then you would be able to draw this holy knowledge, therefore he said to them, “What profit,” etc., “Come, let us sell him,” etc. That is, according to this it is good to sell him and receive money for him; and you, the tribes, who are all holy, when you receive money for him and thereby receive the illumination of will that shines in money when it is received properly, then you will rectify the matter properly.

pairs.he: כִּי מַה שֶּׁלְּפִי דַּעְתְּכֶם רָצָה יוֹסֵף לִפְגֹּם בְּהַדַּעַת הַנַּ״ל שֶׁהוּא פְּגַם הָרָצוֹן הַמֵּאִיר בְּהַמָּמוֹן שֶׁהוּא פְּגַם הַמַּלְכוּת וְהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה, עַל כֵּן טוֹב שֶׁתִּמְכְּרוּ אוֹתוֹ וּבָזֶה תַּפִּילוּ אוֹתוֹ מֵהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה וְשׁוּב לֹא יוּכַל לִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיכֶם בְּמַלְכוּת דְּסִטְרָא אַחֲרָא חַס וְשָׁלוֹם וּלְקַלְקֵל אֶת הַדַּעַת עַל יְדֵי רִבּוּי הָעֲשִׁירוּת כְּמוֹ יָרָבְעָם וְכוּ׳, אַדְּרַבָּא, תְּקַבְּלוּ דְּמֵי מְכִירָתוֹ וְאָז תּוּכְלוּ לְקַבֵּל וּלְהַעֲלוֹת הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן שֶׁנָּפַל אֵצֶל יוֹסֵף לְפִי טָעוּתָם, וְאַתֶּם תַּעֲלוּ אוֹתוֹ וּתְקַבְּלוּ הֶאָרַת הָרָצוֹן עַל יְדֵי הַמָּמוֹן שֶׁתְּקַבְּלוּ בִּדְמֵי מְכִירָתוֹ.
pairs.en: For what, according to your understanding, Yosef wanted to blemish in the aforesaid knowledge is a blemish in the will that shines in money, which is a blemish in kingship and rule. Therefore it is good for you to sell him, and by this you will cast him down from rule, and he will no longer be able to reign over you with the kingship of the sitra achra, God forbid, and to corrupt knowledge through an abundance of wealth, like Yeravam, etc. On the contrary, you will receive the money from his sale, and then you will be able to receive and raise the illumination of will that fell with Yosef, according to their error; and you will raise it and receive the illumination of will through the money that you will receive as the price of his sale.

pairs.he: במגלה עמוקות (על ואתחנן אופן רנ״ב): זה ענין מכירת יוסף שראו השבטים שעתיד ירבעם לעמוד ממנו שהוא יהיה בסוד מרכבה טמאה, שהיא ׳כלב רע׳ ושמו של ירבעם מוכיח עליו שכן ירבעם עולה בחושבן ׳מרכבה טמאה׳ ׳כלב רע׳ ולכן אמרו ז״ל במדרש על פסוק ׳והנה בעל החלומות׳ שאמרו זה עתיד להשיאנו לבעלים ועתה נהרוג את הכלבים מדה כנגד מדה. וז״ש הפסוק וראו אותו מרחוק ויתנכלו אותו להמיתו, ר״ל שראו מה שלעתיד יצא מאתו, שירבעם יצא ממנו, ועתה לכו ונהרגהו, ר״ל עכשיו נהרגהו קודם שיצא ממנו. ע״כ.
pairs.en: In Megaleh Amukos (on Vaeschanan, exposition 252): This is the matter of the sale of Yosef: the tribes saw that Yeravam was destined to arise from him, who would be in the mystery of an impure chariot, which is an ‘evil dog’; and Yeravam’s name demonstrates this concerning him, for Yeravam amounts, in numerical reckoning, to ‘impure chariot,’ ‘evil dog.’ And therefore our Sages, of blessed memory, said in the Midrash on the verse ‘And behold, the master of dreams’ that they said: This one is destined to lead us astray to the baals, and now let us kill the dogs, measure for measure. And this is what the verse says: “And they saw him from afar, and they conspired against him to put him to death,” meaning that they saw what would come forth from him in the future, that Yeravam would come forth from him; “and now, let us go and kill him,” meaning: Now let us kill him before he comes forth from him. Thus far.

pairs.he: ״וַיִּמְכְּרוּ אֶת יוֹסֵף לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים״ (ל״ז, כח) עַל פִּי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה שֶׁל הַבֶּן מֶלֶךְ שֶׁנִּתְחַלֵּף בְּבֶן הַשִּׁפְחָה וְכוּ׳, עַיֵּן שָׁם כָּל הַמַּעֲשֶׂה כֻּלָּהּ מֵרֹאשָׁהּ לְסוֹפָהּ וְהוּא פֶּלֶא, וְכוּ׳. וְהִנֵּה עִנְיַן הַמַּעֲשֶׂה נוֹרָאָה הַנַּ״ל שֶׁל הַבֶּן מֶלֶךְ שֶׁנִּתְחַלֵּף שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִדְמָה לְהָעוֹלָם שֶׁהוּא בֶּן הַשִּׁפְחָה, וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה הִתְגַּבֵּר עָלָיו הָעֶבֶד הַבֶּן הַשִּׁפְחָה בֶּאֱמֶת וְגֵרְשׁוֹ מִמְּקוֹמוֹ. וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נָפַל הַבֶּן הַמֶּלֶךְ הָאֱמֶת בְּדַעְתּוֹ עַד שֶׁבָּא לִידֵי רָעוֹת וְכוּ׳ וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: “And they sold Yosef to the Ishmaelites” (37:28), according to the story of the king’s son who was exchanged with the maidservant’s son, etc.; see there the entire story, all of it from beginning to end, and it is a wonder, etc. And behold, [this is] the matter of the aforesaid awesome story of the king’s son who was exchanged, through which it seemed to the world that he was the maidservant’s son, and through this the slave, who truly was the maidservant’s son, prevailed over him and drove him from his place; and through this the true king’s son became downcast in his mind until he came to evil things, etc., etc.

pairs.he: כָּל עִנְיָן הַזֶּה מְבֹאָר וּמוּבָן הֵיטֵב לַמֵּבִין מְעַט, שֶׁזֶּה סוֹד כָּל עִנְיַן גָּלוּת יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁהֵם מְגֹרָשִׁים מֵאַרְצָם וּמִמְּקוֹמָם. וְהֵם כַּצִּפּוֹר נוֹדֶדֶת מִן קִנָּהּ כֵּן אִישׁ נוֹדֵד מִמְּקוֹמוֹ, וּמְפֻזָּרִים בֵּין הַגּוֹיִם. וְהַמַּלְכוּת וְהַמֶּמְשָׁלָה הִיא אֶצְלָם וְיִשְׂרָאֵל נֶחְשָׁבִים בַּעֲווֹנוֹתֵינוּ הָרַבִּים כַּעֲבָדִים וּשְׁפָחוֹת, שֶׁכָּל זֶה נִמְשָׁךְ מִבְּחִינַת הַחִלּוּפִין הַנַּ״ל שֶׁל הַבֶּן מֶלֶךְ שֶׁנִּתְחַלֵּף וְכוּ׳ שֶׁזֶּה סוֹד בְּחִינַת הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת שֶׁשָּׁם נִתְחַלְּפִין לִפְעָמִים הַנְּשָׁמוֹת, כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְנוּ מִפִּיו הַקָּדוֹשׁ בְּפֵרוּשׁ קֹדֶם שֶׁסִּפֵּר הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הַנַּ״ל שֶׁדִּבֵּר מִקֹּדֶם מֵעִנְיַן הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת שֶׁנִּתְחַלְּפִין הַנְּשָׁמוֹת חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, וְאַחַר כָּךְ עַל עִנְיָן זֶה סִפֵּר הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הַנַּ״ל. וְאָמַר שֶׁכְּבָר פַּעַם אַחַת הָיָה מַעֲשֶׂה כָּזֹאת וְהִתְחִיל לְסַפֵּר כָּל הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הַנַּ״ל עַד שֶׁגְּמָרָהּ. וְנִמְצָא שֶׁהַמַּעֲשֶׂה הַנַּ״ל שֶׁל הַבֶּן מֶלֶךְ שֶׁנִּתְחַלֵּף, זֶה נִמְשָׁךְ מִבְּחִינַת הֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: This entire matter is explained and well understood by one who understands a little: this is the secret of the entire matter of Israel’s exile, for they are driven from their land and place. And they are “like a bird wandering from her nest, so is a man wandering from his place,” and scattered among the nations. And kingship and rule are with them, and Israel, through our many sins, are considered slaves and maidservants. All this proceeds from the aspect of the aforesaid exchanges of the king’s son who was exchanged, etc., which is the secret of the aspect of the Chambers of Exchanges, where souls are sometimes exchanged, as we heard explicitly from his holy mouth before he told the aforesaid story. He first spoke about the Chambers of Exchanges, where souls are exchanged, God forbid, and afterward concerning this matter he told the aforesaid story. And he said that once before such an incident had occurred, and began to tell the entire aforesaid story until he completed it. And thus the aforesaid story of the king’s son who was exchanged proceeds from the aspect of the Chambers of Exchanges, etc.
